info.title: Convoy V3 API
info.description: # Convoy OS API — Front-end Guide One document per menu of Convoy OS. Each document lists the screen actions and the API call behind each one. | Menu | Document | | --- | --- | | Scheduler (rail icon `calendar_view_week`) and everything it opens | [scheduler.md](scheduler.md) | | Trips (rail icon `assignment`): Trips, Trip History, Notices, Bookings, Rate Cards | [trips.md](trips.md) | | Fleet (rail icon `directions_bus`): Vehicles, Drivers, Bus Attendants, External Vehicles, Fuel & Energy, Maintenance, Vehicle Types, and Transport Operators (Managed Operators, Operator Vehicles, Operator Drivers) | [fleet.md](fleet.md) | | Settings (rail footer icon `settings`): Company Settings, Users, Calendars, and the Profile dialog | [settings.md](settings.md) | | Clients (rail icon `corporate_fare`): Managed Clients, Client Users, and the Client Portal sign-in | [clients.md](clients.md) | | HR (rail icon `badge`): Drivers, Earnings, Pay Schemes, Rate Plans, Bonuses, Points, Rewards, Salary Simulator, Audit Log | [hr.md](hr.md) | | Convoy Admin (Convoy staff only): Transport Companies, Message Terms, Discover, Company Leads | [convoy-admin.md](convoy-admin.md) | | Dashboard (rail icon `dashboard`): the Company Dashboard (widgets, layout per user) | [dashboard.md](dashboard.md) | | Reports (rail icon `insert_chart`): the Shuttle Report for clients | [reports.md](reports.md) | | School Bus › Schools & Year Setup (rail icon `school`): schools, riders, academic years, holidays, levels, sessions, bus attendants | [school-bus-setup.md](school-bus-setup.md) | | School Bus › Fares, Policy, Payment Methods, Operator Pay (Year Setup money steps) | [school-bus-money.md](school-bus-money.md) | | School Bus › Stop Library & Stop Assignment | [school-bus-stops.md](school-bus-stops.md) | | School Bus › Route Plans & Feasibility Studies | [school-bus-routes.md](school-bus-routes.md) | | School Bus › Families & Riders, Bus Service Registration, Bus Service Requests, CCA Rides | [school-bus-parents.md](school-bus-parents.md) | | Ops Control (rail icon `desktop_windows`): runs in the next 2 hours checked against rules, alerts, Acknowledge, Alert Log | [ops-control.md](ops-control.md) | | Live Map (rail icon `map`): every bus now, its device, the run it is on, Trace and Replay | [live-map.md](live-map.md) | | Finance (rail icon `account_balance`): Client Invoices, Documents, Operator Payments, Vehicle Financials, Finance Settings | [finance.md](finance.md) | **Integrating the API (or asking an AI assistant to)?** Start with [integration.md](integration.md): it is the one file to read first, and it points to everything else. **Building a screen?** [screen-map.md](screen-map.md) maps every screen and button of the Convoy OS prototype to its API call and the section that explains it. Read the conventions below first; the menu documents do not repeat them. **Apidog / OpenAPI:** [`convoy-v3-api.openapi.json`](convoy-v3-api.openapi.json) lists every endpoint (OpenAPI 3.0), one folder per resource inside its menu, with the description of the section here that names it and request / response examples recorded from the specs and the seed data. Import it in Apidog (Import → OpenAPI). It is generated, do not edit it by hand: after an API change run `bin/rails api_docs:all` (specs + seed probe + build), or `bin/rails api_docs:openapi` to rebuild from the last recorded examples. --- ## Base URL and format - All endpoints live under `/api/v1`, for example `GET /api/v1/scheduler`. - Request and response bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), except file uploads (multipart, see below). - Keys are **snake_case**: `start_time`, `vehicle_id`, `trip_label`. - Dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. Times of day are `"HH:MM"` (24-hour) in requests and responses. A trip that ends after midnight still returns its end as `"HH:MM"` and sets `ends_next_day: true`. - Timestamps (`starts_at`, `created_at`...) are ISO 8601 with the company's offset, for example `2026-11-02T07:45:00+08:00`. - **Money, decimals and coordinates come back as strings**: `"price": "76.19"`, `"lat": "1.2722"`. Send them as numbers or strings. - Display formats (company Date Format / Time Format) are the front end's job. The only server-formatted text is human sentences such as warnings and summaries, which already follow the company's formats. ## Signing in (Bearer token) `POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request: ``` Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9... ``` - The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again. - Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token. - No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page); mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore. - Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port). | Action | Call | | --- | --- | | Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) | | Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` | | Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` | | Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` | `POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token: ```json { "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00", "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } } ``` `GET /session` response: ```json { "data": { "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg", "mobile": null, "mobile_display": null, "role": "admin", "role_label": "Super Admin", "owner": true, "permissions": ["users", "vehicles", "finance", "..."], "initials": "SO", "avatar": null, "status": "active", "company_id": 1 }, "company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive", "display_name": "SimpleDrive", "code": "SD", "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore", "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "logo": null, "observed_holidays": "off", "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active" } } } ``` - `role`: `convoy_admin` (Convoy staff, **view only**: every write returns `403`), `admin` (every permission), `member` (only `permissions`). `owner` = Super Admin. Show `shown_name` (display name or name) in the top bar. Users and the Profile: [settings.md](settings.md). - `company` is `null` for a Convoy Admin until `PATCH /session` picks one (per token: a new sign-in starts with none); company data then answers `422 "Pick a company first"`. - Sample accounts (seed): `ops@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Admin), `dispatch@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Member, vehicles), `admin@convoy.sg` / `Convoy123!` (Convoy Admin). ## Responses Success: ```json { "data": { "...": "..." } } ``` Lists are paged: ```json { "data": [ "..." ], "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "count": 132, "pages": 3 } } ``` - Paging: `?page=2&limit=100` (default limit 50, max 500). - Some lists add more to `meta` (counts for filter chips and so on); each endpoint says so. - Small lists (vehicle types, teams, holidays...) return every row without paging: `{ "data": [...], "meta": {} }`. - Text filters on lists use ransack keys: `?q[name_i_cont]=goo` (case-insensitive "contains"). Each endpoint lists its filters. ## Errors ```json { "error": { "code": "invalid", "message": "Enter the drop-off point", "details": { "base": ["Enter the drop-off point"] } } } ``` | Status | `code` | When | | --- | --- | --- | | 400 | `bad_request` | A required parameter is missing (`message` names it) | | 401 | `unauthorized` | No / bad / expired / signed-out token (`"Sign in to continue"`), or wrong email / password | | 403 | `forbidden` | Not allowed. Convoy Admin gets `"View only. Convoy Admin cannot change company data"` | | 404 | `not_found` | The record does not exist or belongs to another company | | 409 | `conflict` | Someone else changed the record (see `lock_version`) | | 410 | `gone` | A public tracking link has closed | | 422 | `invalid` / `unprocessable_content` | Validation failed or a business rule was broken; `message` is a sentence to show the user as is; `details` lists field errors | Show `error.message` in the toast. It is written for end users and matches the wording of the Convoy OS prototype. ## Optimistic locking (`lock_version`) Trips and runs carry `lock_version`. Send back the value you loaded when saving (`PATCH /trips/:id`, run actions); if someone else saved in between, the API answers `409` and the screen should reload. Leaving it out skips the check. ## Files (uploads and downloads) - Upload with `multipart/form-data`. Nested fields use bracket names, for example `vehicle[photo]`, `trip[stops_attributes][0][photos_attributes][0][photo]`. - Files are private. Any file in a response looks like: ```json { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/eyJfcmFpbHMi...", "thumb_url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "name": "hiace.png", "size": 9273, "content_type": "image/png" } ``` - `url` / `thumb_url` are signed links valid for **1 hour** that open the file on their own (no `Authorization` header, like a pre-signed URL); use them directly in `` or open them in a new tab. They are paths: put the API host in front (`https://convoy-api-staging.convoy.sg` + `url`). Reload the record to get fresh links. Do not share them. - Images are resized to 1280 px; `thumb_url` is a 320 px square. Documents accept PDF, images, xlsx / xls, csv, doc / docx, txt (10 MB max). ## Reading documents with Claude (background reads) Log cards, insurance papers, workshop invoices, route lists and pasted trip messages are read by Claude in the background: 1. `POST /document_reads` with `kind` and a `file` (multipart) or `input_text` → **202** `{ "data": { "id": 7, "status": "pending", ... } }`. 2. Poll `GET /document_reads/:id` every 2–3 s until `status` is `done` (use `result`) or `failed` (show `error`). 3. When saving the form, send `document_read_id` so the server attaches the same file; there is no second upload. | `kind` | Used by | | --- | --- | | `log_card` | Edit Vehicle > Log Card | | `insurance` | Edit Vehicle > Insurance | | `maintenance_invoice` | Maintenance > Record the Work | | `route_list` | Trip form (School Run) > Import Route List | | `trip_message` | Trip form > Fill from Message (`input_text`) | ```json { "data": { "id": 7, "kind": "log_card", "status": "done", "error": null, "result": { "plate": "PD3318K", "make": "Toyota" }, "file": { "url": "...", "name": "card.pdf" }, "created_at": "...", "finished_at": "..." } } ``` Only the user who started a read can see it. Without an Anthropic key on the server, reads end `failed` with `"Reading with Claude is not set up (API key missing or not allowed)"`. ## Runs ("occurrences") The Scheduler works on **runs**: one row per trip (or School Bus route) per date, per shuttle timing, per vehicle slot. They are already resolved (times, bus, driver, price), so the screens only display them. - Runs exist up to **`meta.horizon` = today + 120 days**. Later dates have no runs yet: the server adds one date each night. Do not let users browse or act past the horizon (grey out those days, stop the › button there). - Changes made for the future are rules, not runs, so they reach later dates on their own as the horizon moves: an assignment From This Date On, Driver Away / Vehicle Down on a date range, Every Run From Today, Change a Day, public holidays, default driver changes, trip edits. Their date pickers may go past the horizon. - `id` identifies a run; `key` is a stable name for the same run across re-syncs: `t||||` or `r||0|1|1`.

tags.name: Common / Banks
tags.description:
Singapore banks for payment details (Managed Operators): the bank picker with branches, and the branch of an
account number as it is typed.

tags.name: Common / Document Reads
tags.description: Read a file or a message with Claude in the background: POST returns 202 with the read; poll GET until done or failed.

tags.name: Common / Downloads
tags.description: Serves private CarrierWave files behind a signed, expiring token (see Download); the link needs no Bearer header.

tags.name: Common / Sessions
tags.description: Sign in (Bearer token), sign out, who am I, and (Convoy Admin) which company to look at.

tags.name: Dashboard / Dashboard
tags.description:
Dashboard (Company Dashboard): the widgets this user may see, their layout (saved per user, Reset to the default) and
the figures of each widget for a period.

tags.name: Ops Control / Ops Control
tags.description:
Ops Control: the board of runs with a first pick-up in the next 2 hours (checked now, alerts kept in step), the Alert Log
of today, and Acknowledge on a run.

tags.name: Live Map / Live Map
tags.description:
Live Map: every bus now (state, position, device, driver, the run it is on), one bus with its device and the stops of
its run, the runs of a bus on a day (Replay) and a run's GPS points (Trace and Replay).

tags.name: Scheduler / Occurrences
tags.description:
Runs for drivers and admins (today, tomorrow, a date or a range; by driver, vehicle, trip, status), the drawer
detail, and what can be done to one run.

tags.name: Scheduler / Public Tracking
tags.description: Trip Tracking page (public, no sign-in): the run a shared link shows, while it is open.

tags.name: Scheduler / Replacements
tags.description:
Replacements: the Replace form (trip drawer: occurrence_id), Driver Away / Vehicle Down (vehicle panel: a date range
on original_vehicle_id), the Replacements list, and a preview of what a replacement would do before saving.

tags.name: Scheduler / Scheduler
tags.description:
The Scheduler grid for a date range (Day or Week): the vehicles (with the Scheduler's filters and sort), every run in
the range (runs exist up to meta.horizon; later dates are empty), the unassigned runs, and the nearest dates with unassigned runs
before and after the range.

tags.name: Scheduler / Trip Assignments
tags.description: Assign page of a trip: every run x vehicle slot with who runs it as of a date, the history, and give or take back.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Attachments
tags.description: Files on a booking (passenger list, itinerary), up to 10.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Cancel Requests
tags.description: A client's request to cancel a booking or one trip: recorded on their behalf, then accepted or declined.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Notifications
tags.description:
The bell for bookings: events of the last 14 days the user wants (new bookings from the Portal or the App, client
approval done or declined, changes accepted, cancellation requests), newest first, and how many are unseen.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Trips
tags.description:
One trip of a booking: Approve & Convert to Trip (or Approve Without Waiting), Reject, and the client's steps
recorded on their behalf (Client Acknowledged, client approval done / declined). Each returns the whole booking.

tags.name: Trips / Bookings
tags.description:
Trips > Bookings: tabs Pending, Approved, Rejected, Completed with search; booking details; Record Booking / Save
Changes; the estimate of a trip while the form is open.

tags.name: Trips / Notice Templates
tags.description: Notices > Templates: the usual wording, picked in the Notice form ({min} and {time} are filled in there).

tags.name: Trips / Notices
tags.description:
Notices page and Send Notice (trip drawer): tabs Active, Scheduled, Ended with search; End Now (active), Edit (scheduled),
Duplicate, Delete (not active).

tags.name: Trips / Rate Card Assignments
tags.description: Trips > Rate Cards > Client Rate Cards: which card each client is priced by (assigned, else the default card).

tags.name: Trips / Rate Cards
tags.description:
Trips > Rate Cards: list, view, new (the standard starting card), create, edit, Make Default, Archive / Unarchive,
warnings while editing; and Price From Rate Card (Corporate Shuttle in the trip form).

tags.name: Trips / Route Lists
tags.description:
Import Route List (School Run trip form): review a read list, apply it onto a saved School Run, the Earlier Lists,
and the Next 12 Months bill.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Attachments
tags.description: Attachments of a trip.

tags.name: Trips / Trip History
tags.description: Trips > Trip History: every run that ran, was cancelled or skipped, with filters, the record of one run and notes.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Run Groups
tags.description: Runs That Move Together (trip drawer): group run slots, or ungroup.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Stop Photos
tags.description: Stop photos from the trip drawer (up to 3 per stop, resized to 1280 px); the same photos the trip form shows.

tags.name: Trips / Trips
tags.description:
Trips (trip templates). Filters: kind, client_id, vehicle_id, from / to (trips that may run in the range), q (title,
client, label or a Trip ID).

tags.name: School Bus / Academic Years
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Terms & Semesters: a school's academic years, New Academic Year, a year's calendar (terms,
CCA periods, holidays, special days), Save Calendar (locks it), Unlock to Edit and Delete Year.

tags.name: School Bus / Bus Requests
tags.description:
School Bus › Bus Service Requests: a school's requests (New Service by academic year, Change of Address / Service, Stop
Service), a request with its history, Add Application, opening one (Under Review), Acknowledge / Move Answer Date for
mid-year requests, Waitlist / Decline and Message (one or many).

tags.name: School Bus / Bus Sessions
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Sessions of an academic year: the list, a copy of another year's as a draft, and
Save & Lock (Unlock: POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "sessions" }).

tags.name: School Bus / Cca Rides
tags.description:
School Bus › CCA Rides of a school: settings (charged per ride, price, days, seats), a week of CCA bus days with the
rides booked in the Convoy App and its figures, and Bus Not Running (each ride that day becomes credit).

tags.name: School Bus / Extra Charges
tags.description:
School Bus › Bus Fares › Extra Charges of an academic year: this year's charges and the ones carried over from earlier
years, add / edit / delete (while Scheduled), Set End (while Active), and a preview of the next 4 bills.

tags.name: School Bus / Families
tags.description:
School Bus › Families & Riders: a school's families (search, unlinked riders), a family with its guardians and riders
(service, where they ride now), add / rename / delete, guardians, link / unlink riders (with the riders it could
take), and the CSV import / export.

tags.name: School Bus / Fare Tables
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Fares of an academic year: the table (as the wizard sends it), its billing periods and
the fares worked out per tier and bill; Save & Lock; another year's table as a draft.
Unlock: POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "fares" }.

tags.name: School Bus / Feasibility Studies
tags.description:
School Bus › Feasibility Studies: studies (school or prospect, pick-up, walk, bus prices, fare tiers), students pasted by
postal code, scenarios (add / copy / change / delete / run in the background) with their cost and fares, Use
Suggested Fares, and a school's real fare table as tiers.

tags.name: School Bus / Rider Assignments
tags.description:
School Bus › Stop Assignment › assigned PUDO points: Set as assigned (by hand), Move All Riders Here (a point takes the
riders assigned to the other points of its stop), and Notify (parents told their assigned PUDO; recorded only).

tags.name: School Bus / Rider Datasets
tags.description:
School Bus › school › Rider Data: the uploaded rider lists (state on a date), a check of a file before importing it,
Import (homes placed by OneMap in the background) and Delete.

tags.name: School Bus / Route Money
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans › route drawer money and bus: the regular bus from a date, the operator's price history, and
Route Charges (school pays per bus): the runs with their bus rate and extra, add a change, remove a scheduled one, and
confirm / move / drop the charges carried to a new plan.

tags.name: School Bus / Routing
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans: the engine's parameters (defaults from the routing service and the company's overrides),
Run Routing for a school's session (a background run: poll it), and a run's state.

tags.name: School Bus / School Attendant Policies
tags.description: School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Attendants: which buses need one and who provides them; Save & Lock.

tags.name: School Bus / School Levels
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › School Levels: the levels (or suggestions from rider data) with rider counts, grades in
rider data that are not levels, the sections, and Save & Lock.

tags.name: School Bus / School Operator Pays
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Operator Pay of a school: settings and default prices per bus size, Save & Lock (Unlock:
POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: "operator_pay" }), and the Break Month Calculator.

tags.name: School Bus / School Payment Methods
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Payment Methods of a school: how parents may pay in the Convoy App, admin fees, and the
account that receives the money (the company's from Finance Settings, or the school's own).

tags.name: School Bus / School Plans
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans: a school's plans of a session, one plan, Draw Routes (an empty plan to draw by hand), rename
/ dates, delete a draft, comments, and Compare Plans (routing service /diff).

tags.name: School Bus / School Policies
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Payment & Refund Policy of a school: every version (Scheduled / In Use / Replaced), the
draft to start a new version from, and Publish. Also the school's collection cycle and who pays (from this year's fares).

tags.name: School Bus / School Registrations
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Service Registration of an academic year: the settings (Convoy OS defaults until saved),
what scheduling needs, Save, Schedule and Unschedule.

tags.name: School Bus / School Riders
tags.description:
School Bus › school › Riders: the riders on a date (the list in use and the ones added by hand) with the All / AM / PM
/ CCA / Unlocated counts and search, Add Rider, and the CSV export.

tags.name: School Bus / School Routes
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans › route drawer and map tools: a route's stops and riders (re-timed), New Route, bus type,
lock / hide, attendant, delete, Reset Route; Route Again on a plan (a background run like Run Routing).

tags.name: School Bus / School Stops
tags.description:
School Bus › Stop Assignment of a school: its stops with their catchments (postal codes, areas, points off) and
riders, Add to School / change the catchment, Unlink, Import from Another School, the riders' PUDO points on a date,
and the hand links (Select Riders / Select Links).

tags.name: School Bus / Schools
tags.description: School Bus › Schools: the list, New School (placed on the map by its postal code), the school record and its Route Labels.

tags.name: School Bus / Stop Photo Requests
tags.description:
School Bus › Stop Library › photo requests: the requests and their photos (sent from the Convoy App), Ask for Photos on
a point, close a request, Accept / Reject a photo, and the automatic requests (drivers / parents).

tags.name: School Bus / Stops
tags.description:
School Bus › Stop Library: the company's stops (as a school sees them when school_id is given: approved stops and its
own; without it, the whole library), one stop, add / change
(with the confirmation for stops other schools use), archive, Nearby in Library, the requests to add stops and their
answers, and a point's photo.

tags.name: Fleet / Attendants
tags.description: Attendants

tags.name: Fleet / Drivers
tags.description:
Own drivers (Fleet > Drivers): tabs by status, invite with name and mobile, edit, the invite lifecycle,
View Details and the customer-facing copy (DriverInviteActions).

tags.name: Fleet / External Share Links
tags.description: External Vehicles > Share Form: the company's link for hired drivers (made on first use) and New link.

tags.name: Fleet / External Vehicle Submissions
tags.description: Share Form answers waiting below the link (Review and Add = POST /vehicles/external with submission_id, or Dismiss).

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel
tags.description: Fuel & Energy: the KPI row and the Usage card.

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel Alerts
tags.description: Fuel & Energy > Needs a Look: unusual fills of the last 90 days (FuelAlerts::Scan), Open / Checked tabs, Mark Checked, Undo.

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel Companies
tags.description:
Fuel Companies window (Fuel & Energy): the list (Singapore defaults on first use) with how many entries use each,
saved at once.

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel Entries
tags.description: Fleet > Fuel & Energy: the monthly log, vehicle cards, the entry form (with receipt reading) and delete.

tags.name: Fleet / Maintenance Visits
tags.description: Maintenance dialog (Scheduler toolbar, empty slot, Fleet > Maintenance): plan a visit, record the work, cancel.

tags.name: Fleet / Operator Drivers
tags.description: Operator Drivers: invited like own drivers (DriverInviteActions); an active one can sit on one bus of their operator.

tags.name: Fleet / Operators
tags.description:
Transport operators: managed (Managed Operators) and external (companies external vehicles are hired from).
The list adds the Routes column (School Bus routes their buses run) and the number of buses.

tags.name: Fleet / Public Share Forms
tags.description:
Share Form page (public, no sign-in): a hired driver sends the bus, their details and the company they drive for.
Throttled per IP in config/initializers/rack_attack.rb.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Driver Schedules
tags.description:
Default driver schedule of an own vehicle: history with periods, change from a date (can be ahead),
remove an upcoming change. Occurrences on the vehicle follow it (sync arrives with the occurrence engine).

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Insurance Documents
tags.description: Insurance files of a vehicle's current policy: add (upload or attach a read; up to 5), change kind, remove.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Insurance Policies
tags.description: Insurance of a vehicle (Edit Vehicle): current policy and Past Policies, edit, Renew Policy, delete a past policy.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Log Cards
tags.description: Log cards of a vehicle (Edit Vehicle): current and past, upload (or attach a read), pick the plate, delete a past card.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Teams
tags.description: Vehicle teams (Manage Teams): renaming keeps its vehicles; deleting a team leaves its vehicles without one.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Type Requests
tags.description: Vehicle Types > Request a New Type (company) and Requests From Companies (Convoy Admin: Add Type / Decline).

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Types
Fleet / Vehicles
tags.description:
Vehicles, with the Scheduler's filters: ownership[] (own managed external), size[] (sedan mpv small medium large),
tags[], vip, team_id, q (plate, make, model, driver, operator), sort (type | smallest | largest).
meta.facets gives the counts for the filter chips (teams: chips of the Vehicles pages, by the ownership picked).

tags.name: Fleet / Workshops
tags.description: Workshops window: name, address, phone. One used by a visit can't be deleted.

tags.name: Clients / Client End Customers
tags.description: A client's end customers (nested under /clients/:client_id).

tags.name: Clients / Client Pickup Points
tags.description: A client's pickup points (nested under /clients/:client_id).

tags.name: Clients / Client Sites
tags.description:
A client's sites (nested under /clients/:client_id): Add Site, Edit Site (school, own billing, Send Invoices To),
Remove (refused while trips use the site).

tags.name: Clients / Client Users
tags.description:
Managed Clients > Client Users (nested under /clients/:client_id): people who sign in to the Client Portal, with their

get.description:
GET /api/v1/session

The account menu's **Profile** dialog. Every signed-in user (Convoy Admin too) edits only their own profile.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open | `GET /profile` |
| Save Profile | `PATCH /profile` (multipart when a picture is sent) |

```
profile[display_name]   optional; empty = use the name
profile[mobile]         optional; "9123 4567" or "+65 9123 4567", saved as +6591234567
profile[avatar]         image file (JPG, PNG, WebP)
profile[remove_avatar]  true to remove the picture
```

The response (also `data.user` of `GET /session`) has `name`, `email` (read only: "set by an Admin in Users"),
`display_name`, `shown_name` (display name or name: use it in the top bar), `initials`, `mobile`, `mobile_display`,
`avatar { url, thumb_url }`, `role_label` (the line under the title, for example "Planner"). `422` when the mobile is not a
possible phone number.

_Source: `settings.md` § 2. Profile_

delete.description:
DELETE /api/v1/session — signs this token out (other devices stay signed in).

`POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request:

```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...
```

- The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again.
- Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token.
- No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page);
  mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore.
- Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) |
| Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` |
| Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` |
| Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` |

`POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token:

```json
{ "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00",
            "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } }
```

`GET /session` response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg",
              "mobile": null, "mobile_display": null, "role": "admin", "role_label": "Super Admin", "owner": true,
              "permissions": ["users", "vehicles", "finance", "..."], "initials": "SO", "avatar": null, "status": "active", "company_id": 1 },
    "company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive", "display_name": "SimpleDrive", "code": "SD", "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore",
                 "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "logo": null, "observed_holidays": "off",
                 "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active" }
  }
}
```

- `role`: `convoy_admin` (Convoy staff, **view only**: every write returns `403`), `admin` (every permission), `member` (only `permissions`).
  `owner` = Super Admin. Show `shown_name` (display name or name) in the top bar. Users and the Profile: [settings.md](settings.md).
- `company` is `null` for a Convoy Admin until `PATCH /session` picks one (per token: a new sign-in starts with none);
  company data then answers `422 "Pick a company first"`.
- Sample accounts (seed): `ops@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Admin), `dispatch@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Member, vehicles),
  `admin@convoy.sg` / `Convoy123!` (Convoy Admin).

_Source: `README.md` § Signing in (Bearer token)_

post.description:
POST /api/v1/session { email, password, device_name } → the Bearer token (JWT, 30 days) with the user and company.

Endpoints that existed before the Settings menu and now behave differently. Check the screens that use them.

| Endpoint | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PATCH /companies/:id` | Admin / Super Admin could save | Needs the `users` permission (`403` otherwise). `company[name]` is ignored for company users. `country` only while `country_locked` is `false`. New: `remove_logo` |
| `GET /companies/:id`, `GET /companies` | Company fields | Also `can_edit`, `country_locked`, `country_set_at`, `country_set_by`, `country_request` |
| `POST`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` on `/calendars`, `/calendars/:id/days`, `/public_holidays` (incl. `import`) | Any company user | Needs the `vehicles` or `finance` permission (`403` otherwise). Reading is unchanged. Change a Day on the Scheduler is affected too |
| `POST /public_holidays` | Added one holiday | A Sunday holiday also adds the Monday after as observed; the response has `meta.observed` (or `null`). Duplicate date message: `Date is already a public holiday` |
| `GET /public_holidays?year=` | `meta: {}` | `meta: { year, count, weekdays, preset_available, preset_missing }` |
| `GET /calendars` | Calendar fields | Also `trips_count` |
| `GET /calendars/:id` | Every day | `?year=` keeps only the days touching that year (no `year` = every day, as before) |
| `POST` / `PATCH /calendars` | | `422` for a duplicate name (any case), the name "Public Holidays", or a changed `kind` |
| `GET /session` (`data.user`) | User fields | Also `display_name`, `shown_name`, `mobile_display`, `role_label`; `initials` come from `shown_name` |
| `POST /session` | | A deleted user cannot sign in |
| Passwords | At least 6 characters | At least 8 characters |

_Source: `settings.md` § 6. Changes to existing endpoints (02/11/2026)_

post.description:
POST /portal/session/lookup { email } → { next: "password" } or { next: "code", purpose: "first" } (code emailed)

| Screen / button | Call | Next |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Work Email → Continue | `POST /portal/session/lookup { email }` | `next: "password"` → Password screen; `next: "code"` → One-Time Code screen (code emailed) |
| Password → Sign In | `POST /portal/session { email, password, device_name }` | Signed in (§ 5.2) |
| Forgot password? Send a code instead | `POST /portal/session/code { email }` | One-Time Code screen (`purpose: "reset"`) |
| One-Time Code → Verify | `POST /portal/session/verify { email, code }` | `{ set_password_token, purpose }` → Set Password screen |
| Set Password and Sign In | `POST /portal/password { set_password_token, password, password_confirmation, device_name }` | Signed in (§ 5.2) |
| Account picker (several clients) | 🔒 `PATCH /portal/session { client_user_id }` | `current` set |
| Page load | 🔒 `GET /portal/session` | Session (§ 5.2) |
| Sign Out | 🔒 `DELETE /portal/session` | `204` |

Lookup / code response: `{ email, next: "code", purpose: "first" | "reset", dev_code? }`.
Texts: first → "First sign-in: we sent a one-time code to your email. Enter it, then set your own password.";
reset → "We sent a one-time code to your email. Enter it to set a new password."

**`dev_code`**: email sending is not set up yet. On staging (and dev with `PORTAL_SHOW_CODE=1`) the response carries the
code: show it like the prototype ("Sample: the code is 123456 until email sending is set up"). Production never sends it.

Errors (`422` unless noted):
- "No client account for this email. Ask your transport company to add you under Managed Clients"
- "That code is not right. Check the email and try again" (5 tries), "That code has expired. Send a new one" (15 minutes, works once)
- "Too many codes asked for. Try again in an hour" (5 codes an hour)
- Set password: `details.password` "Password needs at least 8 characters", `details.password_confirmation` "doesn't match Password";
  "This link has expired. Ask for a new code" (the token works once, for 15 minutes)
- Sign in: `401` "Email or password is incorrect". Too many tries from one IP: `429`.

_Source: `clients.md` § 5.1 The screens_

get.description:
GET /api/v1/companies — Convoy Admin: every company; others: their own.

Endpoints that existed before the Settings menu and now behave differently. Check the screens that use them.

| Endpoint | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PATCH /companies/:id` | Admin / Super Admin could save | Needs the `users` permission (`403` otherwise). `company[name]` is ignored for company users. `country` only while `country_locked` is `false`. New: `remove_logo` |
| `GET /companies/:id`, `GET /companies` | Company fields | Also `can_edit`, `country_locked`, `country_set_at`, `country_set_by`, `country_request` |
| `POST`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` on `/calendars`, `/calendars/:id/days`, `/public_holidays` (incl. `import`) | Any company user | Needs the `vehicles` or `finance` permission (`403` otherwise). Reading is unchanged. Change a Day on the Scheduler is affected too |
| `POST /public_holidays` | Added one holiday | A Sunday holiday also adds the Monday after as observed; the response has `meta.observed` (or `null`). Duplicate date message: `Date is already a public holiday` |
| `GET /public_holidays?year=` | `meta: {}` | `meta: { year, count, weekdays, preset_available, preset_missing }` |
| `GET /calendars` | Calendar fields | Also `trips_count` |
| `GET /calendars/:id` | Every day | `?year=` keeps only the days touching that year (no `year` = every day, as before) |
| `POST` / `PATCH /calendars` | | `422` for a duplicate name (any case), the name "Public Holidays", or a changed `kind` |
| `GET /session` (`data.user`) | User fields | Also `display_name`, `shown_name`, `mobile_display`, `role_label`; `initials` come from `shown_name` |
| `POST /session` | | A deleted user cannot sign in |
| Passwords | At least 6 characters | At least 8 characters |

_Source: `settings.md` § 6. Changes to existing endpoints (02/11/2026)_

get.description:
Open: `GET /companies/:id`. Save: `PATCH /companies/:id`. Use the company id from `GET /session` (`data.company.id`). The response (Company Settings view) has:

| Field | Card |
| --- | --- |
| `can_edit` | `false` → show the "View only. Users with the Users permission can change company settings" banner and disable the inputs |
| `name` | Company Name > Full Name (read only: set when Convoy opens the account) |
| `short_name` | Short Name (max 12) |
| `logo` | `{ url, thumb_url }` or `null` |
| `theme_color` | `#RRGGBB` or `null` (the default theme) |
| `timezone` | IANA name, for example `Asia/Singapore` |
| `date_format` | `dmy` (16/10/2026), `mdy` (10/16/2026), `ymd` (2026-10-16), `dmon` (16 Oct 2026) |
| `time_format` | `24` or `12` |
| `business_units_enabled` | Business Units and Projects switch |
| `country`, `country_locked`, `country_set_at`, `country_set_by { id, name }` | Country card: "Set on <date> by <name>" |
| `country_request` | The pending Request a Country Change (§ 3.3) or `null` |

Save sends only what changed (Save Changes / Discard are front end):

```
PATCH /companies/:id   (multipart when a logo is sent)
company[short_name], company[theme_color], company[timezone], company[date_format], company[time_format],
company[business_units_enabled], company[logo] (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP), company[remove_logo]=true,
company[country] (only while country_locked is false)
```

Needs the `users` permission (`403` otherwise). `name` is ignored for company users. `422` details per field
(for example `theme_color: ["Theme color is invalid"]`).

get.description:
Convoy's own space in the Convoy App (Home banners and the Discover tab). Views, taps and sales are counted by the app.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Advertisers card | `GET /discover/advertisers` |
| Add / Edit Advertiser | `POST /discover/advertisers`, `PATCH /discover/advertisers/:id` `{ advertiser: {...} }` |
| Remove Advertiser | `DELETE /discover/advertisers/:id` (`422` while it has placements not ended) |
| Tabs Live / Scheduled / Draft / Ended, search, KPIs | `GET /discover/placements?tab=live&q=` |
| New Placement / Edit (multipart with a picture) | `POST /discover/placements`, `PATCH /discover/placements/:id` `{ placement: {...} }` |
| Open | `GET /discover/placements/:id` |
| Pause / Resume / End now / Duplicate | `POST /discover/placements/:id/pause` · `/resume` · `/end` · `/duplicate` |
| Delete draft | `DELETE /discover/placements/:id` |

Advertiser: `{ id, name, kind (tc Transport Partner, attr Attraction, prog Programme Provider, brand Brand), kind_label, premier,
country, listing_fee (S$ a month), commission_pct, email, live_count }`. Premier Partner: shown as "From <partner>", not Sponsored.

Placement (body = response):

| Group | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| What it is | `kind`: `trip` Bookable Trip, `prog` Programme or Event, `ad` Advert or Offer, `news` From Convoy (no advertiser); `discover_advertiser_id` |
| Banner | `kicker`, `title`, `subtitle`, `background` (#hex), `image` (file; `remove_image`), `cta` (button label) |
| What people get | trip: `price` (adult), `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `pickup_points`; prog: `price`, `event_on`, `bus_included`; ad: `link`, `promo_code`; `run_by_company_id` (runs the bus), `sold_to_public` |
| Where and who | `show_home`, `show_discover`, `push_once`, `slot` (`std` / `feat` Featured), `audiences[]` (`parents`, `staff`, `bookers`, `public`), `area` (`all`, `east`, `west`, `north`, `ne`, `central`), `school_level` (`any`, `pre`, `primary`, `secondary`) |
| When | `starts_on`, `ends_on`; `status` `draft` (save as draft) or `live` (publish), `paused` |
| Money | `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` (from the advertiser unless sent), `commission` (price × sold × %), `views`, `taps`, `sold` |

`state` (response) = `draft`, `scheduled` (published, not started), `live`, `paused` or `ended` (ended now or past `ends_on`).
`meta { tab, counts, kpis { live, scheduled, views, taps, tap_rate, sold, revenue, listing_fees, commission }, kinds, audiences, areas, levels }`.
`422` (`message`): "Pick the advertiser", "Enter the title", "Check the dates: the end is before the start", "Show it on Home, the
Discover tab or both", "Pick who sees it"; when publishing also "Enter the price", "Pick the transport company that runs the bus",
"Add a link or a promo code". Delete: "Only drafts can be deleted. End it instead". Duplicate → a draft "<title> (copy)".

_Source: `convoy-admin.md` § 3. Discover_

`discover#advertisers`

get.description:
GET /dashboard?period=today|d7|d30|month|last_month&widgets[]=otp — the figures of the widgets (all the user may see).

`GET /dashboard?period=today|d7|d30|month|last_month&widgets[]=otp&widgets[]=rev` (no `widgets` = every widget the user may see):

```json
{ "period": { "key": "today", "from": "2026-11-02", "to": "2026-11-02", "compare": "same day last week" },
  "widgets": { "otp": { "available": true, "value": 50.0, "runs": 2, "on_time": 1, "change": null, "allowance": 5, "series": [...] },
               "noshow": { "available": false, "reason": "Comes with the Driver app" } } }
```

`period`: `today`, `d7` (7 days), `d30` (30 days), `month` (month to date), `last_month`; `change` is against `compare`.
Widgets that look at now or ahead have a `note` ("Shows today, so the period does not change it", …): show it under the widget.
`available: false` → show the `reason` in an empty widget (`noshow` Driver app, `coll` School Bus).

| Widget | Fields |
| --- | --- |

post.description:
POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: levels | attendants }

Levels are set per school, not per year.

`GET /schools/:id/levels`:

```json
{ "saved": false,
  "levels": [ { "name": "P1", "section": "pri", "final": false, "riders": 0 }, { "name": "P6", "section": "pri", "final": true, "riders": 1 } ],
  "locked": null,
  "unknown": [ { "grade": "Pre-U", "riders": 1 } ],
  "sections": [ { "key": "pri", "name": "Primary", "group": null, "description": "P1 to P6", "levels": ["P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6"] } ] }
```

- Before levels are saved (`saved: false`), `levels` are suggestions from rider data. A whole section is suggested when a
  rider's grade matches one of its levels; otherwise the grades found are suggested. The last suggestion is marked final.
- `riders` counts today's riders whose grade matches, ignoring case.
- `unknown` lists grades in rider data that are not levels. Each has a one-click Add.
- `sections` are the "What the School Offers" cards, with their default levels.

**Save & Lock:** `PUT /schools/:id/levels { levels: [{ name, section, final }] }` (send JSON, in order).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Add at least one level" | Empty list |
| "Every level needs a name" | A level has no name |
| "P1 is listed twice" | Duplicate name (ignoring case) |

**Unlock:** `POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: "levels" }` returns 204.

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 5. School Levels_

`schools#unlock`

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/policy

The policy is set per school and published as versions. Each version applies from its `effective_on` date.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/policy` | The versions, the current and scheduled versions, a draft for "New Version", and this year's collection cycle |
| `POST /schools/:id/policy` | Publish (JSON) |

```json
{ "versions": [ { "version": 2, "effective_on": "2027-02-01", "state": "scheduled", "published_by": "…", "published_at": "…" },
                { "version": 1, "effective_on": "2026-11-02", "state": "in_use", … } ],
  "current": { …fields…, "version": 1, "effective_on": "2026-11-02" },
  "scheduled": { … } | null,
  "draft": { …fields…, "reminders": [...], "effective_on": "2027-02-01" },
  "collection": { "year": "2026", "cycle": "period", "months": [...], "payer": "parents", "bill_to_name": null, "bill_to_email": null } }
```

- `state` is `scheduled`, `in_use` or `replaced`.
- `draft` starts from the scheduled version if there is one, otherwise the current one, otherwise the Convoy defaults.
- "Collection cycle" and the school-pays banner ("Due dates, late fees and reminders apply to the school bill…") come from
  `collection`.

**Fields (publish body)**

| Group | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| Due | `due_rule`: `before` (`due_days_before`), `day` (`due_day`, 1–28) or `first` (first school day) |
| Late payment | `late_type`: `none`, `flat` (`late_flat`) or `pct` (`late_pct` per month, optional `late_cap`). Also `late_grace_days` and `late_flag_days` (flag the account for an Admin; service is never stopped automatically) |
| Reminders | `reminders: [{ timing: before\|on\|after, days, email, whatsapp, app, email_subject, email_body, whatsapp_body, app_title, app_body }]`. Tokens: `[Parent Name]`, `[Child Name]`, `[Amount]`, `[Due Date]`, `[Period]`, `[School]`, `[Pay Link]`, `[Late Charge]` |
| Withdrawal | `withdrawal_notice` + `withdrawal_unit` (`days`, `weeks`, `months`); `refund_basis` (`days`, `months`, `term`); `refund_method` (`credit`, `bank`, `parent`); `refund_within_days`; `withdrawal_fee` |
| Change of address | `address_notice_days`; `address_start` (`any`, `mon`, `first`); `address_max_days` (at least the notice) |
| Deposit and fees | `deposit_amount`; `deposit_return` (`offset`, `separate`); `registration_fee` |
| Acknowledgement | `ack_required`, `ack_reaccept`, `ack_text` |

Publishing rules:

- `effective_on` must be today or later.
- Publishing **replaces a version that has not started yet**; that version keeps its number. Otherwise the new version
  gets the next number.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "The effective date cannot be in the past" | `effective_on` before today |
| "Pick a due day from 1 to 28" | `due_day` out of range |
| "Enter the late fee" | `flat` late type without `late_flat` |
| "Keep at least one reminder" | No reminders |
| "3 days after due: pick a channel and fill in each message" | A reminder has no channel or an empty message |
| "Enter the acknowledgement text" | `ack_required` without `ack_text` |

Reminders are set up here only; they are not sent yet.

_Source: `school-bus-money.md` § 4. Payment & Refund Policy_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/policy { effective_on, …fields, reminders: [...] } — publish a version.

The policy is set per school and published as versions. Each version applies from its `effective_on` date.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/policy` | The versions, the current and scheduled versions, a draft for "New Version", and this year's collection cycle |
| `POST /schools/:id/policy` | Publish (JSON) |

```json
{ "versions": [ { "version": 2, "effective_on": "2027-02-01", "state": "scheduled", "published_by": "…", "published_at": "…" },
                { "version": 1, "effective_on": "2026-11-02", "state": "in_use", … } ],
  "current": { …fields…, "version": 1, "effective_on": "2026-11-02" },
  "scheduled": { … } | null,
  "draft": { …fields…, "reminders": [...], "effective_on": "2027-02-01" },
  "collection": { "year": "2026", "cycle": "period", "months": [...], "payer": "parents", "bill_to_name": null, "bill_to_email": null } }
```

- `state` is `scheduled`, `in_use` or `replaced`.
- `draft` starts from the scheduled version if there is one, otherwise the current one, otherwise the Convoy defaults.
- "Collection cycle" and the school-pays banner ("Due dates, late fees and reminders apply to the school bill…") come from
  `collection`.

**Fields (publish body)**

| Group | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| Due | `due_rule`: `before` (`due_days_before`), `day` (`due_day`, 1–28) or `first` (first school day) |
| Late payment | `late_type`: `none`, `flat` (`late_flat`) or `pct` (`late_pct` per month, optional `late_cap`). Also `late_grace_days` and `late_flag_days` (flag the account for an Admin; service is never stopped automatically) |
| Reminders | `reminders: [{ timing: before\|on\|after, days, email, whatsapp, app, email_subject, email_body, whatsapp_body, app_title, app_body }]`. Tokens: `[Parent Name]`, `[Child Name]`, `[Amount]`, `[Due Date]`, `[Period]`, `[School]`, `[Pay Link]`, `[Late Charge]` |
| Withdrawal | `withdrawal_notice` + `withdrawal_unit` (`days`, `weeks`, `months`); `refund_basis` (`days`, `months`, `term`); `refund_method` (`credit`, `bank`, `parent`); `refund_within_days`; `withdrawal_fee` |
| Change of address | `address_notice_days`; `address_start` (`any`, `mon`, `first`); `address_max_days` (at least the notice) |
| Deposit and fees | `deposit_amount`; `deposit_return` (`offset`, `separate`); `registration_fee` |
| Acknowledgement | `ack_required`, `ack_reaccept`, `ack_text` |

Publishing rules:

- `effective_on` must be today or later.
- Publishing **replaces a version that has not started yet**; that version keeps its number. Otherwise the new version
  gets the next number.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "The effective date cannot be in the past" | `effective_on` before today |
| "Pick a due day from 1 to 28" | `due_day` out of range |
| "Enter the late fee" | `flat` late type without `late_flat` |
| "Keep at least one reminder" | No reminders |
| "3 days after due: pick a channel and fill in each message" | A reminder has no channel or an empty message |
| "Enter the acknowledgement text" | `ack_required` without `ack_text` |

Reminders are set up here only; they are not sent yet.

_Source: `school-bus-money.md` § 4. Payment & Refund Policy_

`school_policies#create`

get.description:
This sets how parents pay a school's bills in the Convoy App.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/payment_methods` | The current methods and accounts |
| `PUT /schools/:id/payment_methods { bank: { on, fee_kind, fee }, paynow: {…}, card: {…}, own_account, bank_id, account_number, account_name, paynow_id }` | Save |

```json
{ "saved": true, "bank": { "label": "Bank Transfer", "on": true, "fee_kind": "none", "fee": null },
  "paynow": { "label": "PayNow", "on": true, … }, "card": { "label": "Card", "on": true, "fee_kind": "pct", "fee": "3.0" },
  "own_account": false, "account_bank": null, "account_number": null, "account_name": null, "paynow_id": null,
  "updated_by": "…", "updated_at": "…",
  "company_account": { "bank": { "id": 2, "name": "DBS Bank", "code": "7171" }, "account_number": "…", "account_name": "…", "paynow": "…" } }
```

- Not saved yet means Bank Transfer and PayNow with no fee, paid into the company account. Show "Not saved yet. Parents
  see Bank Transfer and PayNow with no fee".
- `fee_kind` is `none`, `fixed` (S$) or `pct` (up to 10).
- `own_account: true` pays into the school's own account, using `bank_id` (from `GET /banks`), `account_number`,
  `account_name` and `paynow_id`. Otherwise the company's Finance Settings › Payment Details are used (`company_account`).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Turn on at least one way to pay" | Every method is off |
| "Enter the admin fee for Card" | A fee kind is set without a fee |
| "The admin fee for Card looks too high: use a percentage up to 10" | `pct` fee above 10 |
| "Bank Transfer needs the company's bank account: add it in Finance Settings, Payment Details, or use this school's own account" | Bank Transfer is on with no account |
| "PayNow needs the company's PayNow UEN…" | PayNow is on with no PayNow ID |

_Source: `school-bus-money.md` § 5. Payment Methods_

`school_payment_methods#show`

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/operator_pay/calculator { academic_year_id, start_date, price }

This is set per school, and only finance users see it.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/operator_pay` | Settings and prices per bus size |
| `PUT /schools/:id/operator_pay` | Save & Lock |
| `POST /schools/:id/operator_pay/calculator { academic_year_id, start_date, price }` | Break Month Calculator |

```json
{ "saved": true, "locked": { "at": "…", "by": "…" },
  "scheme": "some", "paid_months": [1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,11], "part_pct": "50.0", "part_basis": "school",
  "break_months": [6, 12], "break_pay": "earned", "earn_by": "terms", "grace_start_days": 0, "deduct_days": 0,
  "rates": [ { "bus_type": "MEDIUM_23", "label": "23-seater", "seats": 23, "ba_required": false,
               "fixed_on": true, "monthly": "3600.0", "rider_on": true, "base_price": "3000.0", "riders_included": 15, "per_rider": "60.0",
               "default_mode": "fixed", "ba_operator": null, "ba_us": null } ] }
```

The PUT body has the same fields: `rates: [{ bus_type, fixed_on, monthly, rider_on, base_price, riders_included,
per_rider, default_mode, ba_operator, ba_us }]`.

**Settings**

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `scheme` | `all`: 12 months, full pay. `some`: the `paid_months` only. `part`: `paid_months` in full and the other months at `part_pct` % |
| `part_basis` | Part months count `school` days or `cal` (calendar) days |
| `break_months` | Months paid as a retainer |
| `break_pay` | `full`, or `earned` |
| `earn_by` (when earned) | `terms`: each term the route ran in counts equally; within one term, its halves count. `days`: school days run out of the term's school days, with `grace_start_days` (a start within this many days counts from day 1) and `deduct_days` |
| Prices per size | Fixed Monthly (`fixed_on`, `monthly`) and/or Fixed + Per Rider (`rider_on`, `base_price`, `riders_included`, `per_rider`). Keep at least one; `default_mode` chooses between them when both are on. The bus attendant add-ons are `ba_operator` ("their BA") and `ba_us` ("our BA"); `ba_required` follows the Bus Attendants step |

The Bus Attendants page (`GET /schools/:id/bus_attendants`) shows `ba_operator` / `ba_us` for each bus type.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one paid month" | `some` or `part` with no `paid_months` |
| "Enter a percentage from 0 to 100" | `part_pct` out of range |
| "13-seater: enter the base price, riders included and extra per rider" | Per Rider is partly filled |

**Break Month Calculator.** For each break month of the chosen year, it shows what a route starting on `start_date` at
`price` a month is paid. It uses the settings as they are saved. Part pay is multiplied by the retainer earned in the term
or terms before (terms less than 21 days apart count together).

```json
[ { "month": "2027-06", "label": "Jun 2027", "rate": "0.5", "earned": "0.5", "pct": 25, "amount": "500.0",
    "note": "Ran in 1 of 2 halves of the term, at 50% part pay" } ]
```

_Source: `school-bus-money.md` § 6. Operator Pay_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/stops/import { from_school_id, with_catchments }

Each school has its own catchment on a stop:

- postal codes;
- drawn areas, with optional exclude areas;
- points the school does not use (turned off).

A rider whose home is inside the catchment may use the stop's points.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/stops?attention=1` | The school's stops (the "School Stops N" / "Needs Attention N" chips) |
| `PUT /schools/:id/stops/:stop_id` | Add to School / Use Stop (links it if needed) and change the catchment |
| `DELETE /schools/:id/stops/:stop_id` | Unlink (the school's hand links to its points go too) |
| `POST /schools/:id/stops/import { from_school_id, with_catchments }` | Import from Another School: links its stops that this school can see, with or without their catchments. Returns `{ added: n }` |

```json
{ "data": [ { "stop": { …stop row… }, "postal_codes": ["460100"], "off_point_ids": [],
              "areas": [ { "name": "Blk 2xx", "latlngs": [[1.333, 103.933], …], "exclude": false, "how": "lasso" } ], "riders": 9 } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "school_stops": 8, "needs_attention": 0 }, "stops_changed_at": "2026-11-02T09:00:00+08:00" } }
```

`riders` counts today's riders inside the catchment.

The `PUT` body is `{ postal_codes: [...] | "460101, 460102", areas: [{ name, latlngs, exclude, how: lasso|corners|lot }],
off_point_ids: [...] }`. Send only the parts that change. The response is the row plus:

- `meta.invalid`: tokens that are not 6-digit codes. Show "Not added: …" and keep them in the input.
- `meta.shared`: `[{ postal, stop_code }]` for codes another of the school's stops also covers. Show "Riders here are
  eligible for both stops' PUDOs. Routing assigns one."

An area needs at least 3 corners. A stop with a catchment needs a pick-up and a drop-off point.

_Source: `school-bus-stops.md` § 3. A school's stops and catchments_

`school_stops#import`

              "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2, 4], "starts_on": null, "status": "one",

**Candidates.** A rider's candidate points are worked out like this, as in the prototype:

1. Start with every point of the school's stops whose catchment has the rider's home: by postal code, or inside an area
   and not in an exclude area.
2. Leave out the points turned off for the school.
3. Add the points linked to the rider or their postal code by hand (`how: "manual"`).
4. Leave out the points cut off from the rider.

| --- | --- |
| `one` | Assigned: one stop |
| `conflict` | Points of more than one stop |
| `none` | No stop |

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/routing_runs { session: am|pm|asa, date, params: { preset, effort, … } }

`POST /schools/:id/routing_runs { session: am|pm|asa, date, params: { preset, effort, … } }` returns **202** with the
run. Poll `GET /routing_runs/:id` until `status` is `done` or `failed` (it takes up to the effort time: 15–120 s).

```json
{ "id": 9, "school_id": 3, "session": "am", "plan_date": "2026-11-02", "status": "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed",
  "error": null, "riders": 65, "stops": 7, "no_stop": ["S-1044"], "conflicts": [], "ms": 41250, "plan_id": 21, … }
```

**What the engine is given:**

- The riders on the Plan For `date` who ride the session (AM, PM, or CCA days for ASA).
- Each rider whose PUDO points all belong to **one stop** (from Stop Assignment), grouped by that stop with the stop's
  points the school uses.
- Riders with no stop are listed in `no_stop`; riders with more than one stop are listed in `conflicts`. Neither goes
  into the run. Show "N riders need a stop" / "N riders have more than one stop".
- The current plan of the session, for "Keep Current".
- The company's parameters, the run's `params`, the session, and the school's bus attendant rule.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 422 `routing_blocked` (`details: { no_stop, conflicts }`) | No rider of the session has a stop |
| `failed` with the engine's message | The engine refused, for example no road times |
| `failed` with "The routing service is not available…" | The routing service could not be reached |
| `done` | `plan_id` is the new **draft** plan |

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 2. Run Routing_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/route_charges?date= — runs of the school's adopted plans with their bus rate and charges.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /routes/:id/vehicle { vehicle_id, from }` | The regular bus from a date (empty `vehicle_id` = no bus). The history is in route `vehicles`. One-day or date-range replacements stay on the Scheduler |
| `POST /routes/:id/prices { effective_from, mode: fixed\|rider, monthly \| base_price + riders_included + per_rider }` | The operator's monthly price from a date (`finance`). The history is in route `prices`. With no price, the school's default for the bus size applies (Operator Pay) |
| `GET /schools/:id/route_charges?date=` | Route Charges (when the school pays per bus): each AM / PM run of the adopted plans |
| `POST /routes/:id/charges { starts_on, kind: amt\|pct, value, reason, note }` | A charge change from a date (the 1st of this month or later; it can be mid-month). `value: 0` ends the charge. `reason`: Long route, Peak timing, ERP cover, Extra stop or Other |
| `PATCH /route_charges/:id { school_route_id, status: "ok" }` | Confirm a carried charge, or move it to another run |
| `DELETE /route_charges/:id` | Remove a change that has not started, or drop a carried charge |

`GET /schools/:id/route_charges` returns:

```json
{ "per_bus": true,
  "runs": [ { "route_id": 51, "plan_id": 21, "session": "am", "label": "AM 1", "bus_type": "MEDIUM_23", "rate": "1500.0", "extra": "150.0", "total": "1650.0",
              "now": { "id": 4, "starts_on": "2026-11-02", "kind": "amt", "value": "150.0", "reason": "Long route", "status": "ok", … } | null,
              "next": {…} | null, "history": [...] } ],
  "unmatched": [ …charges with no run… ], "to_check": 1 }
```

When a new plan is adopted, each old run's charge moves to the new run that shares the most riders (then stops) with it,
with `status: "check"`. A charge with no match is listed in `unmatched` ("Charges With No Matching Run").

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/cca_rides/not_running { date, reason: school | weather | bus | other | no_school, note }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/cca_rides?week_of=YYYY-MM-DD` | Settings and one week. Any day picks its Monday; the default is the next week with rides |
| `PUT /schools/:school_id/cca_rides` | `{ enabled, price, days: [1..5], seats }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/cca_rides/not_running` | `{ date, reason: school \| weather \| bus \| other \| no_school, note }`. Every ride booked that day becomes credit for its family, once per day |

**Settings.**

- Errors when on: `Enter the price per ride`, `Pick the days the CCA bus runs`, `Enter the seats per day`.
- `fares_price` is set when this year's Bus Fares has the CCA / ASA bus per trip at a fixed price. That price is then
  used, and the front end locks the field.

**Each day of the week** has:

- `date`, `label`, `phase` (`past`, `today`, `late` or `open`) and `status`, for example "Open until Sat 7 Nov, 23:59",
  "Closed · late adds while seats last", "Bus Not Running" or "No School".
- Seats: `riders`, `taken`, `seats`, `full`.
- Calendar: `off` (`{ reason, by, at, credit }`), `no_school` (not a school day, with the holiday name) and `calendar`
  (a special day: check the bus time).
- Actions: `can_not_running`, and `can_no_school_credit` (give credit for rides booked before the calendar changed).
- `rows[]`: child, class, family, `paid_on`, `method`, `bill_id`, `late`, `not_riding`.

**Week figures (`kpis`).** `rides`, `collected`, `late`, `not_riding`, `credit_given`.

**Booking rules (Convoy App).**

- Parents book next week by Saturday 23:59 and pay to confirm. After that, a ride can be added only while seats are left.
- Paid rides cannot be removed. Not Riding frees the seat; the ride is still charged.
- Credit is used first at the family's next payment.
- Each payment is a School Bus bill (`kind: cca`), with lines per child and a credit line.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 7. CCA Rides_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept { ids: [] } — accept many at their Bus Fares quotes.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | Add Application on a parent's behalf |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/acknowledge` | Mid-year: `{ answer_by, note }`. Under Review; the parent sees the date and the note |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/move_answer` | `{ answer_by, reason }`. The reason is required; every move is kept |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/decide` | Waitlist or Decline one or many: `{ ids: [], to: Waitlisted \| Declined, reason, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/message` | `{ ids: [], text }`. Logged on each request (parent accounts are not live) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/accept` | Accept and Send Quote: `{ amount, start_on, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept` | Accept many at their Bus Fares quotes: `{ ids: [] }`. Also used by the auto-accept and "can now be covered" banners |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/reoffer` | A lapsed offer again: the same quote and invoice number, new hours to pay |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/record_payment` | Record First Invoice Paid: `{ method }`. The request becomes Active |

**Add Application.**

- Body: `{ academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address, postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }`.
- Errors: `Enter the child's name`, `Enter the parent's name`, `Enter a 6-digit postal code`, `Pick AM, PM or both`.
- The postal code is placed on the map with OneMap. `located: false` when OneMap does not know it.

**Reasons.**

- Waitlist: `Route full`, `New area`, `Awaiting bus`.
- Decline: `Outside service area`, `Not eligible`, `Duplicate application`, `Other`.
- An empty reason is allowed.

**Route Fit (`check`, `route_fit`).** Each session the request asks for is checked against the routes running on its
start date. That is the session's plan in use that day, or else the latest plan.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fits` (Fits) | A child already rides from the same block on a route with a free seat |
| `new` (New Stop) | A route with a free seat can add a stop at the child's block, inside the arrival window (AM) and the max journey. `delta` is minutes added; `impact[]` is what changes for the other children; `alts[]` are other routes |
| `full` (Bus Full) | Routes can reach the child, but none has a free seat |
| `area` (New Area) | No route can reach the child |
| `none` (Not Checked) | The session has no route plan yet |

How the check is worked out:

- **Free seats.** Seats, less the riders, less the seats held for accepted requests not yet in the plan, plus riders
  who have left by then.
- **Limits.** The arrival window and max journey come from the year's Bus Sessions. Without them, the plan's own settings apply.
- **Worst session wins.** The row shows the worst session. The order from best to worst is Fits, New Stop, Not Checked,
  Bus Full, New Area. The label gets "(part)" when a session is Not Checked.
- **Other labels.** A renewal whose child already rides shows `Covered` (current route). An accepted request shows `Seat held`.

**Quote (`quote_default`).** This is the Bus Fares tier for the distance from the school.

- **Which table.** The year's locked table, or else the latest locked table before it.
- **Which amount.** The amount of the bill the start date falls in. Both sessions are charged two ways; AM only or PM
  only is charged one way.
- **Unit.** `month`, `term` or `semester`.
- **No table.** Without a table, the quote is the estimate the parent saw.
- **Text.** `text` has the Route Fit summary and how the fare was found.

**Accept checks.**

- `Enter the monthly fare` and `Pick the start date`.
- A fixed start cannot be earlier than the family asked: "The family needs the bus from …".
- A note is required when the fare differs from Bus Fares or the start is later than asked:
  `Add a note for the parent: …`.

**On accept.**

- The request becomes Accepted, with `offer_by` = now + the registration's confirm hours (48 by default).
- The seat is held where Route Fit placed the child (`places[]`).
- **First invoice (`first_bill`).** A real School Bus bill:
  - Numbered from Finance Settings (`INV-2026-000123`).
  - GST as in Finance Settings.
  - Covers the start's billing period, and is due at `offer_by`.
- **A new child** joins the rider list from the start date as Unpaid, and joins a family. The family is the school's
  family with a guardian of the same phone (last 8 digits) or email. Otherwise a new family `<LAST NAME> Family` is
  created, with the parent as guardian.

**After the offer.**

- Not paid by `offer_by`: the request reads `Lapsed`. Use Re-offer, or End Rider (section 5).
- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_

- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/bus_requests?kind=new&academic_year_id=&status=&tag=&level=&session=&deadline=&q=&page=&limit=

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | The Requests page (filters below) |
| `GET /bus_requests/:id` | One request with its history |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/open` | Opening it the first time: Requested → Under Review. A mid-year request waits for Acknowledge |

**Filters.**

- `kind`: `new` (default), `adr`, `svc` or `stop`.
- `academic_year_id`: New Service only. The default is the year after this one.
- `status`: a status, or `Accepted+` for Accepted and Active.
- `tag`, `level`, `session` (`AM` or `PM`).
- `deadline`: `over`, `soon` or `ok`.
- `check`: `covered`, `change`, `new` or `none`.
- `q`: child, parent, code, postal, email or address. Three or more digits also match the phone.
- `page`, `limit` (default 150, max 500).

**Order.**

- New Service: overdue mid-year first, then due soon, then other mid-year requests, then the rest. Renewals come first
  within each group, then the oldest.
- The other tabs: newest first.

**Statuses** use the app's words:

- `Requested`, `Under Review`, `Accepted`, `Active`, `Waitlisted`, `Declined`, `Withdrawn`, `Not Agreed`, `Stopping` and
  `Stopped` are stored.
- `Lapsed` is read, never stored: an accepted request not paid by `offer_by`.
- A `Stopping` request past its last day reads `Stopped`.
- `status_label` shows `Waiting for Parent` while a higher fare waits for the parent to agree.
- `tone` is one of `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `neutral`.

**Tags.**

- Stored on the request: `Renewing` and `Final Level`.
- Worked out on the server:
  - `New`: no current rider, or not a renewal.
  - `Mid-Year`: sent after the year's service started.
  - `Fixed Start`.
  - `From the App` or `Sample`.

**Row fields.**

- What the parent asked for: `code`, `kind`, `source` (`app`, `console` or `sample`), `child_name`, `level`, `am`, `pm`,
  `cca`, the parent fields, `submitted_at`, `start_text` (for example "From 16/11/2026, not earlier (moving house)").
- Where it stands: `status`, `status_label`, `tone`, `tags`, `reason`, `last_event`.
- `deadline` (mid-year only): `{ stage: ack | answer, by, left (working days), tone: ok | soon | over }`.
- `check`: Route Fit (section 4).
- The offer: `offer_by`, `hours_left`, `quote_amount`.
- Links: `rider` (`{ id, rid }`) and `family` (`{ id, code, name }`).
- Changes: `change` (section 5) and `end_action`.

**Meta.**

- The tiles (`label`, `count`, `filter`). Mid-Year and Overdue appear only when there are any.
- `tabs` (`open` counts), `windows` (early and general window state), `years` (cards: This Year, Next Year, Later or Past;
  `to_review`, `requests`, `registration`) and `levels`.
- `mid`: `ack_days`, `plan_weeks`, `service_starts_on`.
- `auto_accept` and `cover` (section 4).

**The detail** adds the following:

- The address and the form answers.
- `ack`: `{ at, by, answer_by, note, moves[] }`.
- `route_fit` per session, `quote`, `quote_default`, `places[]`, `first_bill` and `planned`.
- `events[]`, newest first.
- `can`: `{ acknowledge, move_answer, waitlist, decline, accept, reoffer, record_payment, confirm_change, confirm_stop, not_agreed, end_rider }`.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 3. Bus Service Requests: list and detail_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests { academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address,
  postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | Add Application on a parent's behalf |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/acknowledge` | Mid-year: `{ answer_by, note }`. Under Review; the parent sees the date and the note |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/move_answer` | `{ answer_by, reason }`. The reason is required; every move is kept |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/decide` | Waitlist or Decline one or many: `{ ids: [], to: Waitlisted \| Declined, reason, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/message` | `{ ids: [], text }`. Logged on each request (parent accounts are not live) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/accept` | Accept and Send Quote: `{ amount, start_on, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept` | Accept many at their Bus Fares quotes: `{ ids: [] }`. Also used by the auto-accept and "can now be covered" banners |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/reoffer` | A lapsed offer again: the same quote and invoice number, new hours to pay |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/record_payment` | Record First Invoice Paid: `{ method }`. The request becomes Active |

**Add Application.**

- Body: `{ academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address, postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }`.
- Errors: `Enter the child's name`, `Enter the parent's name`, `Enter a 6-digit postal code`, `Pick AM, PM or both`.
- The postal code is placed on the map with OneMap. `located: false` when OneMap does not know it.

**Reasons.**

- Waitlist: `Route full`, `New area`, `Awaiting bus`.
- Decline: `Outside service area`, `Not eligible`, `Duplicate application`, `Other`.
- An empty reason is allowed.

**Route Fit (`check`, `route_fit`).** Each session the request asks for is checked against the routes running on its
start date. That is the session's plan in use that day, or else the latest plan.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fits` (Fits) | A child already rides from the same block on a route with a free seat |
| `new` (New Stop) | A route with a free seat can add a stop at the child's block, inside the arrival window (AM) and the max journey. `delta` is minutes added; `impact[]` is what changes for the other children; `alts[]` are other routes |
| `full` (Bus Full) | Routes can reach the child, but none has a free seat |
| `area` (New Area) | No route can reach the child |
| `none` (Not Checked) | The session has no route plan yet |

How the check is worked out:

- **Free seats.** Seats, less the riders, less the seats held for accepted requests not yet in the plan, plus riders
  who have left by then.
- **Limits.** The arrival window and max journey come from the year's Bus Sessions. Without them, the plan's own settings apply.
- **Worst session wins.** The row shows the worst session. The order from best to worst is Fits, New Stop, Not Checked,
  Bus Full, New Area. The label gets "(part)" when a session is Not Checked.
- **Other labels.** A renewal whose child already rides shows `Covered` (current route). An accepted request shows `Seat held`.

**Quote (`quote_default`).** This is the Bus Fares tier for the distance from the school.

- **Which table.** The year's locked table, or else the latest locked table before it.
- **Which amount.** The amount of the bill the start date falls in. Both sessions are charged two ways; AM only or PM
  only is charged one way.
- **Unit.** `month`, `term` or `semester`.
- **No table.** Without a table, the quote is the estimate the parent saw.
- **Text.** `text` has the Route Fit summary and how the fare was found.

**Accept checks.**

- `Enter the monthly fare` and `Pick the start date`.
- A fixed start cannot be earlier than the family asked: "The family needs the bus from …".
- A note is required when the fare differs from Bus Fares or the start is later than asked:
  `Add a note for the parent: …`.

**On accept.**

- The request becomes Accepted, with `offer_by` = now + the registration's confirm hours (48 by default).
- The seat is held where Route Fit placed the child (`places[]`).
- **First invoice (`first_bill`).** A real School Bus bill:
  - Numbered from Finance Settings (`INV-2026-000123`).
  - GST as in Finance Settings.
  - Covers the start's billing period, and is due at `offer_by`.
- **A new child** joins the rider list from the start date as Unpaid, and joins a family. The family is the school's
  family with a guardian of the same phone (last 8 digits) or email. Otherwise a new family `<LAST NAME> Family` is
  created, with the parent as guardian.

**After the offer.**

- Not paid by `offer_by`: the request reads `Lapsed`. Use Re-offer, or End Rider (section 5).
- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_
