post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/families/import { file | text }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families?q=&page=` | The list, with search and the count of riders not in a family (`meta.unlinked_riders`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families` | Add a family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode }, guardian: { first_name, last_name, relationship, phone, email } }` |
| `GET /families/:id` | One family, with its guardians and its riders (sessions, dates, the routes they ride) |
| `PATCH /families/:id` | Change the family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode } }` |
| `DELETE /families/:id` | Delete the family |
| `POST /families/:id/guardians` | Add a guardian: `{ guardian: {…} }` |
| `PATCH /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Change a guardian |
| `DELETE /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Remove a guardian |
| `POST /families/:id/riders` | Link riders: `{ school_id, rids: [] }` (a rider leaves any other family at the school) |
| `DELETE /families/:id/riders/:rid?school_id=` | Unlink a rider |
| `GET /families/:id/candidates?school_id=&q=` | Link Existing Rider: parent matches first, then the same last name (`match: parent \| last_name`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families/import` | CSV import (`file`, or `text`), with warnings |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families/export` | CSV export |

How families work:

- **Codes.** Codes run `FAM-0001`, `FAM-0002` and so on.
- **Automatic names.** With `name_mode: auto`, the name comes from a guardian's last name: Father first, then Mother, then
  the first guardian. For example, `TAN Family`.
- **Add Rider.** `POST /schools/:id/riders` accepts `family_id` to put the new rider in that family.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 1. Families & Riders_

POST /schools/:school_id/rider_assignments/move { stop_point_id }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /plans/:id/adopt { from }` | Adopt the plan from a date |
| `POST /plans/:id/cancel_adoption` | A scheduled plan goes back to draft; the plan it would have replaced runs on |

**Adopt rules:**

- `from` must be the 1st of this month or later, and after the current plan's start.
- The plan runs on the **Scheduler** from that date: `scheduled` before the date, `current` from it.
- The plan of the same session in use on that date ends the day before. A plan scheduled after the date is cancelled.
- Runs are re-synced in the background.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick a date from the 1st of this month" | `from` before the 1st of this month |
| "Pick a date after 2 Nov 2026, when the current plan started" | `from` not after the current plan's start |
| "The plan has no routes" | Empty plan |
| "This plan is already adopted" | Plan already in use |

**Rider assignments.** Adopting an **AM** plan assigns each of its riders the PUDO point they use. Stop Assignment
(`GET /schools/:id/stop_assignment`) then shows `assigned` for each rider, and `meta.counts.assigned` / `notified`.
Riders set by hand keep their point.

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments { rids: [], stop_point_id }` | Set as assigned (by hand) |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/move { stop_point_id }` | Move All Riders Here: the riders assigned to the other points of that stop move to this one. Returns `{ moved }` |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/notify` | Notify: returns `{ notified: n }`. Show "Assigned PUDO sent to N riders". Recorded only; sending comes with the app |

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 5. Adopt Plan and rider assignments_

GET /schools/:school_id/plans?session=am

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/plans?session=am` | The plan list, newest first |
| `GET /plans/:id` | One plan (fields below) |
| `POST /schools/:id/plans { session }` | **Draw Routes**: an empty plan (`source: "manual"`) to draw routes on |
| `PATCH /plans/:id { plan: { name, effective_from, effective_to } }` | Rename, or change the run dates |
| `DELETE /plans/:id` | Delete a draft (only drafts) |
| `POST /plans/:id/comments { body }` / `DELETE /plans/:id/comments/:comment_id` | Comments |

POST /schools/:school_id/rider_links { stop_point_id, rids: [], postals: [] } — Select Riders › link as an alternative.

`GET /schools/:id/stop_assignment?date=` returns the riders on that date (the Plan For date) and the PUDO points each one
may use:

```json
{ "data": [ { "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Wei Ling", "grade": "P3", "postal": "460100", "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.92,
              "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2, 4], "starts_on": null, "status": "one",
              "candidates": [ { "stop_id": 12, "stop_code": "BDSZ03-0001", "point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "usage": "both",
                                "how": "postal" | "area" | "manual", "manual": false, "metres": 52 } ] } ],
  "meta": { "date": "2026-11-02", "counts": { "riders": 65, "with_pudo": 65, "conflicts": 0, "no_stop": 0 },
            "stops_changed_at": "…" } }
```

**Candidates.** A rider's candidate points are worked out like this, as in the prototype:

1. Start with every point of the school's stops whose catchment has the rider's home: by postal code, or inside an area
   and not in an exclude area.
2. Leave out the points turned off for the school.
3. Add the points linked to the rider or their postal code by hand (`how: "manual"`).
4. Leave out the points cut off from the rider.

Rider colours on the map follow `status`:

| `status` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `one` | Assigned: one stop |
| `conflict` | Points of more than one stop |
| `none` | No stop |

**Tools:**

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_links { stop_point_id, rids: [...], postals: [...] }` | Select Riders (S): link the picked riders or postal codes to a point as an alternative |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_links/remove { links: [{ rid, point_id }] }` | Select Links (L) › Remove: a hand link is deleted; a link from the catchment is cut off for that rider |

Reload the assignment after either call.

_Source: `school-bus-stops.md` § 4. Stop Assignment_

POST /schools/:school_id/rider_datasets/preview (multipart file)

`GET /schools/:id/rider_datasets?date=` returns the lists (oldest first):

```json
{ "id": 7, "effective_from": "2026-01-02", "file_name": "SSS riders 2026.csv", "riders_count": 65, "unlocated_count": 0,
  "status": "ready", "state": "in_use", "uploaded_by": "Ops Admin", "created_at": "…",
  "file": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/<token>", "name": "SSS_riders_2026.csv", "size": 4210, "content_type": "text/csv" } }
```

- `state` is `in_use`, `scheduled` or `replaced`.
- `status` is `locating` while homes are being placed on the map, then `ready`.
- `unlocated_count` is the number of riders OneMap did not find (No Location).

**Check a file before importing:** `POST /schools/:id/rider_datasets/preview` (multipart, `file` = CSV or XLSX).

```json
{ "riders": 3, "problems": 3, "errors": [ { "line": 4, "message": "Row 4: no student name" } ], "sample": [ { "rid": "S-1", "name": "…" } ] }
```

Show "N riders ready to import | M problems (those rows are skipped)" and the first errors.

Columns are found by name, in any order, as in the prototype's template:

| Column | Also accepted |
| --- | --- |
| `student_id` | Student ID / ID |
| `student_name` (required) | Name |
| `gender` | |
| `grade_class` | Grade / Class / Level |
| `address` (required) | |
| `postal_code` (required) | Postal / Postcode |
| `am` | |
| `pm` | |
| `cca_days` | |
| `start_date` | |
| `end_date` | |
| `parent_name` | |
| `parent_contact` | |
| `remarks` | |

Value rules:

- `am` / `pm`: `Y` / `Yes` / `1` / `x`. If the column is missing, everyone rides that session.
- `cca_days`: days such as `Mon;Wed`.
- Dates: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `DD/MM/YYYY`.
- An empty student ID becomes `S-<row number>`.
- A student ID used twice keeps only its first row.
- Postal codes shorter than 6 digits are padded with leading zeros.

**Import:** `POST /schools/:id/rider_datasets` (multipart `file`, `effective_from`).

- The response (201) is the new list (`status: "locating"`), plus `meta.skipped` (up to 50) and `meta.skipped_count`.
- Homes are placed in the background. Poll the list until `status` is `ready`.
- Show "N addresses not found; they show as No Location" from `unlocated_count`.
- Every row with a problem returns 422.

**Delete:** `DELETE /schools/:id/rider_datasets/:dataset_id`. Ask for confirmation first: "Riders from it will no longer
be planned".

The CSV and XLSX templates are built by the FE, as in the prototype.

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 2.1 Rider Data tab_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/riders/export?date= — CSV in the upload template's columns.

`GET /schools/:id/riders?date=&filter=all|am|pm|cca|unlocated&q=&page=&limit=` returns a paged list:

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 41, "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Wei Ling", "first_name": null, "last_name": null, "name_order": "last",
              "gender": "F", "grade": "P3", "address": "…", "postal": "460100", "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.92, "located": true,
              "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2, 4], "starts_on": null, "ends_on": null,
              "parent_name": "Tan Ah Kow", "parent_contact": "91234000", "remarks": null, "source": "csv", "rider_dataset_id": 7 } ],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 20, "count": 65, "pages": 4, "date": "2026-11-02",
            "counts": { "all": 65, "am": 65, "pm": 57, "cca": 13, "unlocated": 0 }, "dataset": { "file_name": "SSS riders 2026.csv", … } } }
```

- `date` is the Plan For date.
- `q` searches name, rider ID, grade, address and postal code.
- `counts` follow `q` but not `filter`; they drive the chips.
- `cca_days` are ISO weekdays (1 = Mon).
- `located: false` means no map location. Show "(no location)" in red.
- The sub-line reads "On <date> | dataset "<file>" effective <date>", or "no dataset in effect on this date" when
  `meta.dataset` is `null`.

**Add Rider:**

```
POST /schools/:id/riders { rider: { first_name, last_name, name_order: first|last, rid, gender, grade, address, postal,
                                    am, pm, cca_days: "Mon;Wed" | [..], starts_on, ends_on, parent_name, parent_contact, remarks } }
```

- `first_name` or `last_name` is required.
- The postal code must have 6 digits.
- At least one of AM, PM or CCA is required.
- An empty `rid` becomes `M-0001`, `M-0002`, and so on.
- The home is placed now. When OneMap does not know the postal code, the rider is saved with `located: false`. Show
  "Postal code not found, so they have no map location".

**Export CSV:** `GET /schools/:id/riders/export?date=` returns the template's columns for the riders on that date.

  `meta.dataset` is `null`.

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/academic_years

An academic year runs for 12 months from its start month.

- Its `key` is `"2026"` when it starts in January, otherwise `"2026/27"`.
- Its calendar has operating days and either 2 Semesters or 3–4 Terms.
- Each term has a CCA / ASA period: the term's own dates when `cca_same_as_terms`, otherwise its own dates.
- A **school day** is an operating day, inside a term, and not a holiday.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/academic_years` | The years, oldest first (the year selector) |
| `POST /schools/:id/academic_years { start_year, start_month, copy_from_id }` | New Academic Year (see below) |
| `GET /academic_years/:id` | One year with its terms, holidays and special days |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar` | Save Calendar: validates, saves and **locks** |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "calendar" }` | Unlock to Edit |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id` | Delete Year |

**New Academic Year:**

- With `copy_from_id`, it copies the operating days, structure and CCA setting of that year, but not its dates.
- Otherwise it starts with Mon–Fri and 2 Semesters.
- The empty terms are created.
- 422 "This overlaps AY 2027" when the 12 months overlap another year.

`GET /academic_years/:id`:

```json
{ "id": 5, "key": "2027", "start_year": 2027, "start_month": 1, "starts_on": "2027-01-01", "ends_on": "2027-12-31",
  "structure": "term", "period_count": 4, "period_label": "Term", "operating_days": [1,2,3,4,5], "cca_same_as_terms": true,
  "started": false, "calendar_locked": { "at": "…", "by": "Ops Admin" },
  "terms": [ { "position": 1, "label": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-03-12", "school_days": 50,
               "cca_starts_on": "2027-01-04", "cca_ends_on": "2027-03-12" } ],
  "school_days": 200,
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 3. Terms & Semesters (academic years)_

`academic_years#index`

parameters.description: The years, oldest first (the year selector)

get.description:
GET /routing_runs/:id

`POST /schools/:id/routing_runs { session: am|pm|asa, date, params: { preset, effort, … } }` returns **202** with the
run. Poll `GET /routing_runs/:id` until `status` is `done` or `failed` (it takes up to the effort time: 15–120 s).

```json
{ "id": 9, "school_id": 3, "session": "am", "plan_date": "2026-11-02", "status": "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed",
  "error": null, "riders": 65, "stops": 7, "no_stop": ["S-1044"], "conflicts": [], "ms": 41250, "plan_id": 21, … }
```

**What the engine is given:**

- The riders on the Plan For `date` who ride the session (AM, PM, or CCA days for ASA).
- Each rider whose PUDO points all belong to **one stop** (from Stop Assignment), grouped by that stop with the stop's
  points the school uses.
- Riders with no stop are listed in `no_stop`; riders with more than one stop are listed in `conflicts`. Neither goes
  into the run. Show "N riders need a stop" / "N riders have more than one stop".
- The current plan of the session, for "Keep Current".
- The company's parameters, the run's `params`, the session, and the school's bus attendant rule.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 422 `routing_blocked` (`details: { no_stop, conflicts }`) | No rider of the session has a stop |
| `failed` with the engine's message | The engine refused, for example no road times |
| `failed` with "The routing service is not available…" | The routing service could not be reached |
| `done` | `plan_id` is the new **draft** plan |

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 2. Run Routing_

| Call | What it does |

| `GET /bus_requests/digest` | The 08:00 email as it would go today: `{ to: [names], subject, groups: [{ school, rows: [{ who, text, tone }] }] }` |

**Alert items.** Each item has:

- `request_id`, `code`, `child_name`, `level`, `school`.
- `tab`: the Requests tab to open.
- `kind`: `new`, `adr`, `svc`, `stop` or `end`.
- `what`: for example "New bus request", "Answer due", "Renewal", "Change of address", "Leaving" or "Offer lapsed".
- `text`: for example "Acknowledge was due Fri 23/10", or "Moves Mon 16/11. Not opened yet".

- The counts: `count`, `overdue`, `to_acknowledge`, `answers_due`, `changes`, `to_end`.
- `parts[]`, and `text` (the strip subtitle).

post.description:
POST /bus_requests/:id/open — the first time a request is opened it is Under Review (mid-year ones wait for Acknowledge).

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | The Requests page (filters below) |
| `GET /bus_requests/:id` | One request with its history |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/open` | Opening it the first time: Requested → Under Review. A mid-year request waits for Acknowledge |

**Filters.**

- `kind`: `new` (default), `adr`, `svc` or `stop`.
- `academic_year_id`: New Service only. The default is the year after this one.
- `status`: a status, or `Accepted+` for Accepted and Active.
- `tag`, `level`, `session` (`AM` or `PM`).
- `deadline`: `over`, `soon` or `ok`.
- `check`: `covered`, `change`, `new` or `none`.
- `q`: child, parent, code, postal, email or address. Three or more digits also match the phone.
- `page`, `limit` (default 150, max 500).

**Order.**

- New Service: overdue mid-year first, then due soon, then other mid-year requests, then the rest. Renewals come first
  within each group, then the oldest.
- The other tabs: newest first.

**Statuses** use the app's words:

- `Requested`, `Under Review`, `Accepted`, `Active`, `Waitlisted`, `Declined`, `Withdrawn`, `Not Agreed`, `Stopping` and
  `Stopped` are stored.
- `Lapsed` is read, never stored: an accepted request not paid by `offer_by`.
- A `Stopping` request past its last day reads `Stopped`.
- `status_label` shows `Waiting for Parent` while a higher fare waits for the parent to agree.
- `tone` is one of `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `neutral`.

**Tags.**

- Stored on the request: `Renewing` and `Final Level`.
- Worked out on the server:
  - `New`: no current rider, or not a renewal.
  - `Mid-Year`: sent after the year's service started.
  - `Fixed Start`.
  - `From the App` or `Sample`.

**Row fields.**

- What the parent asked for: `code`, `kind`, `source` (`app`, `console` or `sample`), `child_name`, `level`, `am`, `pm`,
  `cca`, the parent fields, `submitted_at`, `start_text` (for example "From 16/11/2026, not earlier (moving house)").
- Where it stands: `status`, `status_label`, `tone`, `tags`, `reason`, `last_event`.
- `deadline` (mid-year only): `{ stage: ack | answer, by, left (working days), tone: ok | soon | over }`.
- `check`: Route Fit (section 4).
- The offer: `offer_by`, `hours_left`, `quote_amount`.
- Links: `rider` (`{ id, rid }`) and `family` (`{ id, code, name }`).
- Changes: `change` (section 5) and `end_action`.

- The tiles (`label`, `count`, `filter`). Mid-Year and Overdue appear only when there are any.

- `auto_accept` and `cover` (section 4).

- The address and the form answers.
- `ack`: `{ at, by, answer_by, note, moves[] }`.
- `route_fit` per session, `quote`, `quote_default`, `places[]`, `first_bill` and `planned`.
- `events[]`, newest first.

post.description:
POST /bus_requests/:id/acknowledge { answer_by, note }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | Add Application on a parent's behalf |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/acknowledge` | Mid-year: `{ answer_by, note }`. Under Review; the parent sees the date and the note |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/move_answer` | `{ answer_by, reason }`. The reason is required; every move is kept |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/decide` | Waitlist or Decline one or many: `{ ids: [], to: Waitlisted \| Declined, reason, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/message` | `{ ids: [], text }`. Logged on each request (parent accounts are not live) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/accept` | Accept and Send Quote: `{ amount, start_on, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept` | Accept many at their Bus Fares quotes: `{ ids: [] }`. Also used by the auto-accept and "can now be covered" banners |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/reoffer` | A lapsed offer again: the same quote and invoice number, new hours to pay |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/record_payment` | Record First Invoice Paid: `{ method }`. The request becomes Active |

**Add Application.**

- Body: `{ academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address, postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }`.
- Errors: `Enter the child's name`, `Enter the parent's name`, `Enter a 6-digit postal code`, `Pick AM, PM or both`.
- The postal code is placed on the map with OneMap. `located: false` when OneMap does not know it.

**Reasons.**

- Waitlist: `Route full`, `New area`, `Awaiting bus`.
- Decline: `Outside service area`, `Not eligible`, `Duplicate application`, `Other`.
- An empty reason is allowed.

**Route Fit (`check`, `route_fit`).** Each session the request asks for is checked against the routes running on its
start date. That is the session's plan in use that day, or else the latest plan.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fits` (Fits) | A child already rides from the same block on a route with a free seat |
| `new` (New Stop) | A route with a free seat can add a stop at the child's block, inside the arrival window (AM) and the max journey. `delta` is minutes added; `impact[]` is what changes for the other children; `alts[]` are other routes |
| `full` (Bus Full) | Routes can reach the child, but none has a free seat |
| `area` (New Area) | No route can reach the child |
| `none` (Not Checked) | The session has no route plan yet |

How the check is worked out:

- **Free seats.** Seats, less the riders, less the seats held for accepted requests not yet in the plan, plus riders
  who have left by then.
- **Limits.** The arrival window and max journey come from the year's Bus Sessions. Without them, the plan's own settings apply.
- **Worst session wins.** The row shows the worst session. The order from best to worst is Fits, New Stop, Not Checked,
  Bus Full, New Area. The label gets "(part)" when a session is Not Checked.
- **Other labels.** A renewal whose child already rides shows `Covered` (current route). An accepted request shows `Seat held`.

**Quote (`quote_default`).** This is the Bus Fares tier for the distance from the school.

- **Which table.** The year's locked table, or else the latest locked table before it.
- **Which amount.** The amount of the bill the start date falls in. Both sessions are charged two ways; AM only or PM
  only is charged one way.
- **Unit.** `month`, `term` or `semester`.
- **No table.** Without a table, the quote is the estimate the parent saw.
- **Text.** `text` has the Route Fit summary and how the fare was found.

**Accept checks.**

- `Enter the monthly fare` and `Pick the start date`.
- A fixed start cannot be earlier than the family asked: "The family needs the bus from …".
- A note is required when the fare differs from Bus Fares or the start is later than asked:
  `Add a note for the parent: …`.

**On accept.**

- The request becomes Accepted, with `offer_by` = now + the registration's confirm hours (48 by default).
- The seat is held where Route Fit placed the child (`places[]`).
- **First invoice (`first_bill`).** A real School Bus bill:
  - Numbered from Finance Settings (`INV-2026-000123`).
  - GST as in Finance Settings.
  - Covers the start's billing period, and is due at `offer_by`.
- **A new child** joins the rider list from the start date as Unpaid, and joins a family. The family is the school's
  family with a guardian of the same phone (last 8 digits) or email. Otherwise a new family `<LAST NAME> Family` is
  created, with the parent as guardian.

**After the offer.**

- Not paid by `offer_by`: the request reads `Lapsed`. Use Re-offer, or End Rider (section 5).
- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_

| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/message` | `{ ids: [], text }`. Logged on each request (parent accounts are not live) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/accept` | Accept and Send Quote: `{ amount, start_on, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept` | Accept many at their Bus Fares quotes: `{ ids: [] }`. Also used by the auto-accept and "can now be covered" banners |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/reoffer` | A lapsed offer again: the same quote and invoice number, new hours to pay |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/record_payment` | Record First Invoice Paid: `{ method }`. The request becomes Active |

**Add Application.**

- Body: `{ academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address, postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }`.
- Errors: `Enter the child's name`, `Enter the parent's name`, `Enter a 6-digit postal code`, `Pick AM, PM or both`.
- The postal code is placed on the map with OneMap. `located: false` when OneMap does not know it.

**Reasons.**

- Waitlist: `Route full`, `New area`, `Awaiting bus`.
- Decline: `Outside service area`, `Not eligible`, `Duplicate application`, `Other`.
- An empty reason is allowed.

**Route Fit (`check`, `route_fit`).** Each session the request asks for is checked against the routes running on its
start date. That is the session's plan in use that day, or else the latest plan.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fits` (Fits) | A child already rides from the same block on a route with a free seat |
| `new` (New Stop) | A route with a free seat can add a stop at the child's block, inside the arrival window (AM) and the max journey. `delta` is minutes added; `impact[]` is what changes for the other children; `alts[]` are other routes |
| `full` (Bus Full) | Routes can reach the child, but none has a free seat |
| `area` (New Area) | No route can reach the child |
| `none` (Not Checked) | The session has no route plan yet |

How the check is worked out:

- **Free seats.** Seats, less the riders, less the seats held for accepted requests not yet in the plan, plus riders
  who have left by then.
- **Limits.** The arrival window and max journey come from the year's Bus Sessions. Without them, the plan's own settings apply.
- **Worst session wins.** The row shows the worst session. The order from best to worst is Fits, New Stop, Not Checked,
  Bus Full, New Area. The label gets "(part)" when a session is Not Checked.
- **Other labels.** A renewal whose child already rides shows `Covered` (current route). An accepted request shows `Seat held`.

**Quote (`quote_default`).** This is the Bus Fares tier for the distance from the school.

- **Which table.** The year's locked table, or else the latest locked table before it.
- **Which amount.** The amount of the bill the start date falls in. Both sessions are charged two ways; AM only or PM
  only is charged one way.
- **Unit.** `month`, `term` or `semester`.
- **No table.** Without a table, the quote is the estimate the parent saw.
- **Text.** `text` has the Route Fit summary and how the fare was found.

**Accept checks.**

- `Enter the monthly fare` and `Pick the start date`.
- A fixed start cannot be earlier than the family asked: "The family needs the bus from …".
- A note is required when the fare differs from Bus Fares or the start is later than asked:
  `Add a note for the parent: …`.

**On accept.**

- The request becomes Accepted, with `offer_by` = now + the registration's confirm hours (48 by default).
- The seat is held where Route Fit placed the child (`places[]`).
- **First invoice (`first_bill`).** A real School Bus bill:
  - Numbered from Finance Settings (`INV-2026-000123`).
  - GST as in Finance Settings.
  - Covers the start's billing period, and is due at `offer_by`.
- **A new child** joins the rider list from the start date as Unpaid, and joins a family. The family is the school's
  family with a guardian of the same phone (last 8 digits) or email. Otherwise a new family `<LAST NAME> Family` is
  created, with the parent as guardian.

**After the offer.**

- Not paid by `offer_by`: the request reads `Lapsed`. Use Re-offer, or End Rider (section 5).
- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_

post.description:
POST /bus_requests/:id/confirm_change { amount, note, stop } — Change of Address (stop needed) or Service; Change the Fare when Not Agreed.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/confirm_change` | Change of Address: `{ amount, stop, note }` (the new pick-up point is required). Change of Service: `{ amount, note }`. From Not Agreed, this is Change the Fare |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/confirm_stop` | `{ last_on, note }`. Stopping. A last day before the notice ends stops the bus earlier, but fees run to `pay_to` (the earliest last day) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/not_agreed` | `{ choice: keep \| stop }`. Keep the old pick-up (Declined), or stop the service from the move date (Stopped) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/end_rider` | End Rider / Remove from Rider List, on the day in `end_action.end` |

**Fare changes.** When the fare goes up, the request is Accepted and waits for the parent to agree in the app. Otherwise
it is Active from its date.

**`change` on the row.**

- When: `effective_on`.
- Fares: `current_fare`, `agree`, `waiting_for_parent`.
- Address: `old_address`, `new_address`, `new_stop`.
- Service: `from_service`, `to_service` (for example "Two ways", "Morning only + CCA bus"), `adds`.
- Stop: `last_on`, `stop_reason`, `notice`, `earliest_on`, `early`, `pay_to`.
- Confirmation: `confirmed_at`, `confirm_note`, `ended_on`.

**Plan versions (`planned`).** A confirmed request goes into the route plans of its session from its date, once:

| Request | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| New child paid | joins |
| Address Active | moves |
| Address Stopped | leaves |
| Service | joins or drops each session that changed |
| Stop | leaves from the day after the last day |

How it works:

- **Split.** The plan in use that day is split. The old version ends the day before; a copy with the change runs from the date.
- **Later plans.** Every later adopted plan of the session gets the change too.
- **Name.** The new version is named `<plan> · from dd/mm/yyyy · N changes`.
- **Placing the child.** Joins and moves use Route Fit. The child goes to the same block's stop, or to a new stop with
  the times around it moved.
- **No fit.** When the child does not fit, nothing changes. The line says why.
- **Result.** `planned: { at, ok, lines[] }`. The Scheduler runs are re-synced.

**`end_action`.** It is `{ end, why, button, label, text }`, and set when the child should come off the rider list:

| `why` | When |
| --- | --- |
| `lapsed` | The offer lapsed |
| `withdrawn` | Withdrawn before paying |
| `stop` | The last day has passed |
| `adr` | The service stopped from the move date |
| `declined` | A renewal was declined and the new year has started |

Nothing leaves the list by itself.

**Daily job (12:30am).**

- Confirmed changes of service and address reach the rider record on their date.
- Renewed riders move to their new level when the new year starts.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 5. Change of Address, Change of Service, Stop Service_

get.description:
| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | The Requests page (filters below) |
| `GET /bus_requests/:id` | One request with its history |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/open` | Opening it the first time: Requested → Under Review. A mid-year request waits for Acknowledge |

**Filters.**

- `kind`: `new` (default), `adr`, `svc` or `stop`.
- `academic_year_id`: New Service only. The default is the year after this one.
- `status`: a status, or `Accepted+` for Accepted and Active.
- `tag`, `level`, `session` (`AM` or `PM`).
- `deadline`: `over`, `soon` or `ok`.
- `check`: `covered`, `change`, `new` or `none`.
- `q`: child, parent, code, postal, email or address. Three or more digits also match the phone.
- `page`, `limit` (default 150, max 500).

**Order.**

- New Service: overdue mid-year first, then due soon, then other mid-year requests, then the rest. Renewals come first
  within each group, then the oldest.
- The other tabs: newest first.

**Statuses** use the app's words:

- `Requested`, `Under Review`, `Accepted`, `Active`, `Waitlisted`, `Declined`, `Withdrawn`, `Not Agreed`, `Stopping` and
  `Stopped` are stored.
- `Lapsed` is read, never stored: an accepted request not paid by `offer_by`.
- A `Stopping` request past its last day reads `Stopped`.
- `status_label` shows `Waiting for Parent` while a higher fare waits for the parent to agree.
- `tone` is one of `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `neutral`.

**Tags.**

- Stored on the request: `Renewing` and `Final Level`.
- Worked out on the server:
  - `New`: no current rider, or not a renewal.
  - `Mid-Year`: sent after the year's service started.
  - `Fixed Start`.
  - `From the App` or `Sample`.

**Row fields.**

- What the parent asked for: `code`, `kind`, `source` (`app`, `console` or `sample`), `child_name`, `level`, `am`, `pm`,
  `cca`, the parent fields, `submitted_at`, `start_text` (for example "From 16/11/2026, not earlier (moving house)").
- Where it stands: `status`, `status_label`, `tone`, `tags`, `reason`, `last_event`.
- `deadline` (mid-year only): `{ stage: ack | answer, by, left (working days), tone: ok | soon | over }`.
- `check`: Route Fit (section 4).
- The offer: `offer_by`, `hours_left`, `quote_amount`.
- Links: `rider` (`{ id, rid }`) and `family` (`{ id, code, name }`).
- Changes: `change` (section 5) and `end_action`.

**Meta.**

- The tiles (`label`, `count`, `filter`). Mid-Year and Overdue appear only when there are any.
- `tabs` (`open` counts), `windows` (early and general window state), `years` (cards: This Year, Next Year, Later or Past;
  `to_review`, `requests`, `registration`) and `levels`.
- `mid`: `ack_days`, `plan_weeks`, `service_starts_on`.
- `auto_accept` and `cover` (section 4).

**The detail** adds the following:

- The address and the form answers.
- `ack`: `{ at, by, answer_by, note, moves[] }`.
- `route_fit` per session, `quote`, `quote_default`, `places[]`, `first_bill` and `planned`.
- `events[]`, newest first.
- `can`: `{ acknowledge, move_answer, waitlist, decline, accept, reoffer, record_payment, confirm_change, confirm_stop, not_agreed, end_rider }`.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 3. Bus Service Requests: list and detail_

post.description:
POST /families/:id/guardians { guardian: {…} } · PATCH / DELETE /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families?q=&page=` | The list, with search and the count of riders not in a family (`meta.unlinked_riders`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families` | Add a family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode }, guardian: { first_name, last_name, relationship, phone, email } }` |
| `GET /families/:id` | One family, with its guardians and its riders (sessions, dates, the routes they ride) |
| `PATCH /families/:id` | Change the family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode } }` |
| `DELETE /families/:id` | Delete the family |
| `POST /families/:id/guardians` | Add a guardian: `{ guardian: {…} }` |
| `PATCH /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Change a guardian |
| `DELETE /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Remove a guardian |
| `POST /families/:id/riders` | Link riders: `{ school_id, rids: [] }` (a rider leaves any other family at the school) |
| `DELETE /families/:id/riders/:rid?school_id=` | Unlink a rider |
| `GET /families/:id/candidates?school_id=&q=` | Link Existing Rider: parent matches first, then the same last name (`match: parent \| last_name`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families/import` | CSV import (`file`, or `text`), with warnings |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families/export` | CSV export |

How families work:

- **Codes.** Codes run `FAM-0001`, `FAM-0002` and so on.
- **Automatic names.** With `name_mode: auto`, the name comes from a guardian's last name: Father first, then Mother, then
  the first guardian. For example, `TAN Family`.
- **Add Rider.** `POST /schools/:id/riders` accepts `family_id` to put the new rider in that family.

_Source: `school-bus-parents.md` § 1. Families & Riders_

get.description:
GET /feasibility_studies/fare_source?school_id= — the school's locked distance fares as monthly tiers.

Feasibility Studies are a sandbox: nothing touches real riders, stops or plans.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /feasibility_studies` | The studies: `id`, `name`, `school`, `students`, `scenarios`, `updated_at`, `best` (fewest runs: `buses`, `runs`, `total`, `break_even`) |
| `POST /feasibility_studies { study: { name, school_mode: existing\|prospect, school_id \| prospect_name + prospect_postal, pickup: door\|lib, walk_m } }` | New study. A prospect's postal code is placed on OneMap. The study starts with "Scenario 1" |
| `GET /feasibility_studies/:id` | The study, with its scenarios worked out (below) |
| `PATCH /feasibility_studies/:id { study: {…}, bus_prices: [{ bus_type, monthly, attendant }], fare_tiers: [{ max_km, fare, one_way_fare }] }` | Change the study, its bus prices (monthly per bus size plus the attendant add-on) or its fare tiers (monthly; the last tier has no `max_km`) |
| `POST /feasibility_studies/:id/rows { text }` | Paste or upload students |
| `DELETE /feasibility_studies/:id/rows` | Clear the students |
| `POST /feasibility_studies/:id/scenarios { from_id }` | Add Scenario, or copy one |
| `PATCH /feasibility_scenarios/:id { scenario: { name, sizes: ["MEDIUM_23"], attendant: STATUTORY\|ALL_BUSES, hard_cap, target_cap, margin_pct, extra_buses: { AM: { SMALL_13: 1 } }, params: {…} } }` | Change a scenario. `params` blank = company parameters |
| `DELETE /feasibility_scenarios/:id` | Delete a scenario (keep at least one) |
| `POST /feasibility_scenarios/:id/run` | Plans AM and PM in the background (202). Poll the study until the scenario's `status` is `done` or `failed` (with `error`) |
| `POST /feasibility_scenarios/:id/use_suggested_fares` | The study's tiers take the suggested fares |
| `GET /feasibility_studies/fare_source?school_id=` | A school's locked distance fares as monthly tiers ("Use the school's fares") |

**Students (`rows`):**

- Each line holds a postal code, in any column, with an optional count, AM / PM / both, and level. For example
  `460101, 3, AM, P4`.
- Columns are separated by commas, tabs or semicolons.
- Lines without a postal code are skipped and counted in `meta.skipped`.
- The same postal code, session and level add up.
- Adding students marks scenarios that already ran as `stale`.

**Each scenario in `GET /feasibility_studies/:id`:**

```json
{ "id": 3, "name": "Big buses", "status": "done", "stale": false, "error": null, …settings…,
  "result": { "need": 44, "served": 42, "sv": { "460101|both": 9 },
              "AM": { "summary": {…}, "routes": [ { "type": "LARGE_45", "label": "45-seater", "attendant": true, "load": 38, "seats": 44, "minutes": 46,
                                                    "startT": "06:30", "endT": "07:16", "stops": [ { "ll": [1.32, 103.92], "n": 9, "time": "06:30", "name": "…", "postals": "460100 x9" } ] } ],
                      "unassigned": [ { "n": 2, "reason": "…", "label": "…" } ] },
              "PM": {…} },
  "cost": { "buses": 2, "runs": 4, "buffer": 1, "total": "12400.0", "attendant_cost": "1350.0", "served": 42, "margin": "0.25",
            "break_even": "295.24", "target_fare": "393.65", "missing": [], "by_session": { "AM": { "buses": {…}, "attendants": {…}, "buffer": {…}, "n": 2 }, "PM": {…} } },
  "fares": { "tiers": [ { "max_km": "3.0", "n": 20, "n2": 15, "n1": 5, "fare": "150.0", "one_way": "100.0", "revenue": "2750.0", "suggested": 170, "suggested_one_way": 114 } ],
             "revenue": "…", "missing": false, "exact": true, "scaled": true, "students": 42, "fare_margin": "0.21" } }
```

How the figures are worked out:

| Figure | How |
| --- | --- |
| Monthly cost | Each session's buses (plus buffer buses) × price, plus attendants at their add-on. `missing` lists sizes with no price |
| Buses | The larger session's count |
| Break-even | Cost ÷ students served |
| Target fare | Cost ÷ (1 − margin) ÷ served |
| Fares | Students per tier by straight-line km from the school: 2-way for both sessions, 1-way otherwise |
| Suggested fares | Scale the tier fares to reach the target, or one flat fare when a fare is missing |

The map view, "Compare Scenarios" and Export are built by the FE from this data.

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 7. Feasibility Studies_

patch.description:
PATCH /route_charges/:id { school_route_id, status: "ok" } — confirm a carried charge, or move it to another run.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /routes/:id/vehicle { vehicle_id, from }` | The regular bus from a date (empty `vehicle_id` = no bus). The history is in route `vehicles`. One-day or date-range replacements stay on the Scheduler |
| `POST /routes/:id/prices { effective_from, mode: fixed\|rider, monthly \| base_price + riders_included + per_rider }` | The operator's monthly price from a date (`finance`). The history is in route `prices`. With no price, the school's default for the bus size applies (Operator Pay) |
| `GET /schools/:id/route_charges?date=` | Route Charges (when the school pays per bus): each AM / PM run of the adopted plans |
| `POST /routes/:id/charges { starts_on, kind: amt\|pct, value, reason, note }` | A charge change from a date (the 1st of this month or later; it can be mid-month). `value: 0` ends the charge. `reason`: Long route, Peak timing, ERP cover, Extra stop or Other |
| `PATCH /route_charges/:id { school_route_id, status: "ok" }` | Confirm a carried charge, or move it to another run |
| `DELETE /route_charges/:id` | Remove a change that has not started, or drop a carried charge |

`GET /schools/:id/route_charges` returns:

```json
{ "per_bus": true,
  "runs": [ { "route_id": 51, "plan_id": 21, "session": "am", "label": "AM 1", "bus_type": "MEDIUM_23", "rate": "1500.0", "extra": "150.0", "total": "1650.0",
              "now": { "id": 4, "starts_on": "2026-11-02", "kind": "amt", "value": "150.0", "reason": "Long route", "status": "ok", … } | null,
              "next": {…} | null, "history": [...] } ],
  "unmatched": [ …charges with no run… ], "to_check": 1 }
```

When a new plan is adopted, each old run's charge moves to the new run that shares the most riders (then stops) with it,
with `status: "check"`. A charge with no match is listed in `unmatched` ("Charges With No Matching Run").

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 6. Route bus and money_

put.description:
PUT /routes/:id/stops { stops: [{ stop_point_id, riders: [rid] }], vias: [[[lat, lng], …], …] }

Each edit is re-timed by the engine on the server. Every call returns the whole plan, with the route's new times,
`badges` (including "Edited") and `summary`.

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `PUT /routes/:id/stops { stops: [{ stop_point_id, riders: [rid] }], vias: [[[lat, lng], …], …] }` | Reorder stops, move a stop or a rider here, add or remove riders, via points (one list per leg) |
| `POST /plans/:plan_id/routes { bus_type, stops: [...] }` | New Route (R): the route is locked and badged "Manual" |
| `PATCH /routes/:id { route: { bus_type, locked, hidden, attendant_id } }` | Bus Type, Lock, Hide, Attendant |
| `DELETE /routes/:id` | Delete a route |
| `POST /routes/:id/reset` | Reset Route to the engine's version |
| `POST /plans/:plan_id/route_again { params: {…}, fleet: { MEDIUM_23: 2, SMALL_13: 0 } }` | Route Again |

Rules:

- A rider placed on a route leaves any other route of the plan. A route left without riders goes.
- A rider taken off a route goes to `unassigned`, with the reason "Removed by hand", "Route deleted" or
  "Taken off by Reset Route".
- A route drawn by hand cannot be reset.
- Routes of an **adopted** plan can be edited (their runs on the Scheduler follow) but not deleted ("Make a new plan to
  remove a route").

**Route Again** plans again every rider not on a locked route. Its result replaces the unlocked routes of the same plan.

- `fleet` caps buses of a size; 0 turns a size off.
- It returns 202 `{ id, status, kind: "again", plan_id }`. Poll `GET /routing_runs/:id`, then reload the plan.
- 422 "Every rider is on a locked route. Unlock a route to route again".

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 4. Hand edits and Route Again_

- A rider taken off a route goes to `unassigned`, with the reason "Removed by hand", "Route deleted" or
  "Taken off by Reset Route".
- A route drawn by hand cannot be reset.
- Routes of an **adopted** plan can be edited (their runs on the Scheduler follow) but not deleted ("Make a new plan to
  remove a route").

**Route Again** plans again every rider not on a locked route. Its result replaces the unlocked routes of the same plan.

- `fleet` caps buses of a size; 0 turns a size off.
- It returns 202 `{ id, status, kind: "again", plan_id }`. Poll `GET /routing_runs/:id`, then reload the plan.
- 422 "Every rider is on a locked route. Unlock a route to route again".

post.description:
POST /plans/:id/adopt { from }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /plans/:id/adopt { from }` | Adopt the plan from a date |
| `POST /plans/:id/cancel_adoption` | A scheduled plan goes back to draft; the plan it would have replaced runs on |

**Adopt rules:**

- `from` must be the 1st of this month or later, and after the current plan's start.
- The plan runs on the **Scheduler** from that date: `scheduled` before the date, `current` from it.
- The plan of the same session in use on that date ends the day before. A plan scheduled after the date is cancelled.
- Runs are re-synced in the background.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick a date from the 1st of this month" | `from` before the 1st of this month |
| "Pick a date after 2 Nov 2026, when the current plan started" | `from` not after the current plan's start |
| "The plan has no routes" | Empty plan |
| "This plan is already adopted" | Plan already in use |

**Rider assignments.** Adopting an **AM** plan assigns each of its riders the PUDO point they use. Stop Assignment
(`GET /schools/:id/stop_assignment`) then shows `assigned` for each rider, and `meta.counts.assigned` / `notified`.
Riders set by hand keep their point.

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments { rids: [], stop_point_id }` | Set as assigned (by hand) |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/move { stop_point_id }` | Move All Riders Here: the riders assigned to the other points of that stop move to this one. Returns `{ moved }` |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/notify` | Notify: returns `{ notified: n }`. Show "Assigned PUDO sent to N riders". Recorded only; sending comes with the app |

_Source: `school-bus-routes.md` § 5. Adopt Plan and rider assignments_

put.description:
PUT /stop_photo_requests/auto { driver, parent }

**A point's photo:**

```
POST /stops/:id/points/:point_id/photo   (multipart: photo = the image to show, with arrows and crop applied by the FE;
                                           photo_original; photo_annotations = JSON of the arrows / crop; photo_credit)
DELETE /stops/:id/points/:point_id/photo
```

Both return the point. Use `photo_annotations` with `photo_original` to reopen the editor.

**Photo requests** ask parents or drivers for a photo through the Convoy App. Photos sent from the app are seed data
until the app exists.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /stop_photo_requests?status=open\|closed\|all` | The requests with their photos |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests { stop_point_id, audience, school_rider_id, max_submissions }` | Ask for Photos |
| `DELETE /stop_photo_requests/:id` | Close the request |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/submissions/:id/accept` | Accept a photo |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/submissions/:id/reject` | Reject a photo |
| `PUT /stop_photo_requests/auto { driver, parent }` | Automatic requests on / off. Returns how many requests changed |

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 4, "stop_id": 12, "stop_point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "stop_name": "…", "audience": "both",
              "parent_of": null, "max_submissions": 4, "status": "open", "auto": false, "created_by": "…", "created_at": "…", "live": 2,
              "submissions": [ { "id": 7, "by": "Mrs Tan Mei Ling", "role": "parent", "status": "pending", "submitted_at": "…",
                                 "street_view_url": null, "annotations": null, "photo": { "url": "…", "thumb_url": "…" } } ] } ],
  "meta": { "pending_photos": 2, "auto": { "driver": false, "parent": false } } }
```

- `meta.pending_photos` is the badge on the photo-requests button.
- `live` counts photos that are not rejected.

**Ask for Photos:**

- `audience` is `parents` (parents at the stop), `driver`, `both`, or `parent` with `school_rider_id` (one parent).
- `max_submissions` is 1–12; the default is 6.
- Each point has one open request: "BDSZ03-0001A already has an open photo request".

**Accept:**

- Optional multipart `photo` is the edited image, and `annotations` is the JSON of the arrows.
- The photo becomes the point's photo, credited "Name (role)". The original is kept.
- The point keeps its Street View link, or takes the photo's link when it has none.
- Any photo accepted earlier goes back to pending.

**Automatic requests:** points of stops that schools use and that have no photo get an open request (driver, parents or
both). When turned off, automatic requests nobody answered are removed.

_Source: `school-bus-stops.md` § 5. Photos and photo requests_

GET /stops/nearby?lat=&lng=&school_id= — library stops within 600 m that the school does not use yet.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /stops?school_id=&q=&status=&not_linked=1&page=` | The list. With `school_id`, the stops as that school sees them; without it, the whole company library |
| `GET /stops/:id?school_id=` | One stop with the schools that use it and the coverage table |
| `POST /stops` | Add a stop |

`GET /stops/:id` adds two fields:

```json

              { "usage": "dropoff", "sizes": { … }, "any": true } ],
"schools": [ { "id": 3, "name": "St. Stephen's School", "riders": 12 } ]
```

messages such as "No point serves Large buses for pick-up".

**Add / change a stop:**

```

                school_id, in_library }
PATCH /stops/:id { stop: { name, points: [{ id, … }] }, school_id, confirmed }
```

- Send the whole list of points. A point with `id` is changed. A point without `id` is new and gets the next free
  letter. A point left out is removed (retired).
- Exactly one point is primary. If none is marked, the first point is.
- `street_view_url` must be a Google Maps link.
- On the Library page, send no `school_id` (or `in_library: true`). The stop is then `approved`.

  (`library_status: "school"`) and is linked to it. Then ask "Add to the Stop Library?" (§2).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Enter a stop name" | No name |
| "Add at least one PUDO point" | No points |
| "Point A needs at least one bus size" | A point has no size |
| "Stops with postal codes or areas need both pick-up and drop-off points" | A school has a catchment on the stop |
| "No URA subzone found for Point A. Move it inside Singapore" | The new stop's primary point is outside every subzone |

**Changing a stop other schools use.** When points of a stop that other schools use are moved, added or removed, or
their use or sizes change, the API answers 422 with `code: "confirm_required"`:

```json

             "details": { "schools": [ { "id": 5, "name": "Opera Estate Primary", "riders": 8 } ] } } }
```

Show the dialog with those schools and their riders, then send the same request again with `confirmed: true`. Every
school using the stop gets its "Stops changed since routing" time updated (`stops_changed_at`, §3).

**Archive:** `DELETE /stops/:id` works only when no school uses the stop ("Unlink BDSZ03-0001 from every school first").

get.description:
GET /academic_years/:academic_year_id/fares/copy?from_id= — another year's table as a draft (not saved).

There is one fare table per academic year. It needs that year's **Terms & Semesters locked** first.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/fares` | The table, its billing periods, the worked-out fares and the bus types |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/fares` | Save & Lock the whole table, as the wizard's Review step sends it (JSON) |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/fares/copy?from_id=` | "Copy AY X Fares": another year's table as a draft. Nothing is saved. |

`GET` returns:

```json
{ "table": { …the table, same shape as the PUT body below; tiers also carry their "id"… } | null,
  "locked": { "at": "…", "by": "…" } | null, "calendar_locked": true,
  "periods": [ { "label": "Term 1", "short": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2026-01-02", "ends_on": "2026-03-13", "school_days": 50, "cca_days": 50 } ],
  "fares": [ …see §2… ],
  "bus_types": [ { "key": "SMALL_13", "label": "13-seater", "seats": 13 } ] }
```

The PUT body is the whole table. Send only the parts that apply:

```json
{ "payer": "parents" | "school" | "bus",
  "bill_to": { "name": "SSS Finance", "contact": "…", "email": "fin@sss.edu.sg" },
  "basis": "distance" | "zone",
  "trip": "both" | "one" | "ampm",
  "cycle": "period" | "month", "months": [1, 2, 3],
  "distribution": "equal" | "prorated" | "bill" | "billpro" | "custom",
  "one_way": { "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 60 },
  "by_size": false, "size_columns": [ { "max_seats": 15 }, { "max_seats": null } ],
  "tiers": [ { "max_km": 3, "name": null, "sectors": ["45", "46"], "area": null,
               "fare": 1680, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [],
               "small_fare": null, "express_fare": null, "cca_fare": null,
               "sizes": [ { "fare": 1800, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [] } ] } ],
  "surcharges": [ { "name": "Sentosa", "sectors": ["09"], "area": null, "kind": "flat" | "pct" | "fixed", "amount": 200,
                    "one_way_kind": "same" | "pct" | "fixed", "one_way_value": null } ],
  "small": { "on": true, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 10, "seats": 15 },
  "express": { "on": false, "type": "pct", "value": null },
  "cca": { "on": true, "per": "trip" | "period", "price": "fixed" | "tier", "fixed": 8, "split": "equal" | "days", "with_services": false,
           "riders": { "non": { "on": false, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "fixed", "amount": null }, "am": {…}, "pm": {…} } },
  "bus_count": "plan" | "booked",
  "bus_rates": [ { "bus_type": "SMALL_13", "rate": 1500, "booked_runs": null } ] }
```

**Who pays (`payer`)**

| `payer` | Meaning | Extra fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parents` | Each family is billed | — |
| `school` | The school pays per rider | `bill_to` (name and email) |
| `bus` | The school pays per bus | `bill_to`, plus `bus_rates` (a rate per bill for each bus size) and `bus_count` (by the plan, or `booked` runs) |

The wizard's steps for `bus` are Who Pays, Billing, Bus Rates and Review.

**How the fares are set (`payer: parents` or `school`)**

| Field | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `basis` | `distance`: `tiers` by `max_km`, in increasing order; the last tier is open-ended. `zone`: each tier has a `name`, postal `sectors` (first 2 digits) and/or a drawn `area`; the first matching zone applies. |
| `trip` | `both`: one 2-way fare plus a 1-way rule. `one`: 1-way only. `ampm`: AM and PM fares, where 2-way = AM + PM. |
| `cycle` | `period`: one bill per term or semester. `month`: one bill per month listed in `months`, where 1 = January. |
| `distribution` | How the annual fare is spread over the bills (table below) |
| `one_way.type` | `pct`: % of the 2-way fare. `flat`: amount off the 2-way fare. `custom`: each tier's `one_way_fare`. |
| `by_size` | Adds price columns by bus size (`size_columns`). The first column uses the tier's own fares; each tier's `sizes[k]` holds the prices for column k + 2. |
| `small`, `express` | `pct` / `flat` extra on the standard fare, or `custom`, which uses each tier's `small_fare` / `express_fare` |
| `cca` | Optional CCA / ASA fares; see the wizard |

`distribution` values:

| `distribution` | Bill amounts |
| --- | --- |
| `equal` | The annual fare split evenly over the bills |
| `prorated` | The annual fare split by each bill's school days |
| `bill` | `fare` is the amount of every bill |
| `billpro` | `fare` per bill, scaled by the bill's school days against the average |
| `custom` | Each bill is typed in: `period_fares`, plus `period_pm_fares` when `trip` is `ampm` |

`sectors` may be sent as an array or as text such as `"45, 46"`. `area` is the polygon drawn on the map (a list of
`[lat, lng]`), stored as it is sent.

**Checks (422).** The error messages are the wizard's, step by step. Examples:

| Step | Example message |
| --- | --- |
| Who Pays | "Enter who the school bill goes to", "Enter a billing email for the school" |
| Billing | "Pick at least one billing month", "Enter the 1-way fare percentage", "The 1-way percentage cannot be more than 100" |
| Fares | "Tier 2 must end further out than tier 1", "Above 3 km: enter the 2-way fare", "Zone 1 needs a name" |
| Bus sizes | "Size column 2 must have a higher seat limit than the one before" |
| Surcharges | "Sentosa: enter the surcharge amount" |
| Services | "Small Bus: enter the extra percentage" |
| CCA / ASA | "CCA / ASA: enter the fare" |
| Bus Rates | "13-seater: enter a rate above 0", "Enter how many runs the school booked" |
| Before saving | "Save and lock the Terms & Semesters first", "Bus Fares is locked. Unlock to edit" |

**Frozen school days.** When the table is locked, each bill's school days and CCA days are frozen, so holidays added later
do not change the bills. `periods` shows the frozen numbers while the table is locked. When it is unlocked, they are
counted again from the calendar.

_Source: `school-bus-money.md` § 1. Bus Fares_

post.description:
POST /academic_years/:academic_year_id/extra_charges/:id/end { to_month } — last month to charge.

Extra Charges are added on top of a **locked** fare table, such as a fuel surcharge. Adding one does not unlock the table.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/extra_charges` | This year's charges, then the ones carried over from earlier years |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges` | Add a charge |
| `PATCH /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id` | Edit (Scheduled only) |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id` | Delete (Scheduled only) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id/end { to_month }` | Set End (Active and not one-off): the last month charged |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/preview` | The next 4 bills before and after the draft charge |

The add and edit body is `{ name, kind: pct|amt|once, value, from_month: "2027-01", to_month, targets: [], note }`.

```json
{ "id": 4, "name": "Fuel Surcharge", "kind": "pct", "value": "5.0", "from_month": "2026-12", "to_month": null,
  "targets": [], "note": "…", "state": "scheduled", "created_by": "Ops Admin", "created_at": "…",
  "carried_from": null, "can_edit": true, "can_delete": true, "can_end": false }
```

**How a charge works**

| `kind` | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `pct` | Adds a % of the fare to every bill |
| `amt` | Adds an amount to every bill |
| `once` | Adds an amount to the one bill raised in `from_month` |

- Every bill is raised in the month of its term start, or in its chosen month.
- `to_month: null` means no end. Such a charge carries into later academic years, where it shows with `carried_from` set
  to the year it came from. It is read only there.
- `targets` lists the tiers it applies to (tier ids from `table.tiers[].id`), or `"bus:<type>"` when the school pays per
  bus. An empty list means all riders.
- `from_month` must be this month or later ("The first month cannot be in the past").

**States and messages**

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `state` | `scheduled` (not started), `active`, or `ended` |
| `meta.warning` (on save) | "No bill falls in these months, so no one is charged yet" |

The preview body is the draft charge. Add `id` when editing, so the old version of that charge is left out. The response:

```json
[ { "bill": "Term 1", "before": "420.0", "after": "441.0", "change": "21.0" } ]
```

_Source: `school-bus-money.md` § 3. Extra Charges_

put.description:
PUT /academic_years/:academic_year_id/sessions { sessions: [{ name, direction, cca, service, max_journey_minutes, days,
  arrive_from, arrive_to, dismissal, depart, notes, variants: [{ days, arrive_from, arrive_to, dismissal, depart }] }] }

Bus Sessions belong to an academic year and need that year's calendar to be locked.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/sessions` | `data` = the sessions; `meta.locked` and `meta.calendar_locked` |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/sessions/copy?from_id=` | "Copy AY X Sessions": another year's sessions as a draft (not saved); days that are not operating days are dropped |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/sessions { sessions: [...] }` | Save & Lock (send JSON) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "sessions" }` | Unlock |

```json
{ "position": 2, "name": "PM Departure", "direction": "to_home", "cca": false, "service": "d2d", "max_journey_minutes": 60,
  "days": [1,2,3,4,5], "arrive_from": "14:00", "arrive_to": "15:00", "dismissal": "13:30", "depart": "13:45", "notes": null,
  "variants": [ { "days": [3], "arrive_from": "12:30", "arrive_to": "13:30", "dismissal": "12:00", "depart": "12:15" } ] }
```

The add buttons create these defaults:

| Button | `direction` | `service` | `cca` | Default name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Add To School | `to_school` | `d2d` | false | "AM Arrival" |
| Add To Home | `to_home` | `d2d` | false | "PM Departure" |
| Add CCA/ASA | `to_home` | `p2p` | true | — |

`max_journey_minutes` defaults to 60.

Rules (422 messages name the session):

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Save and lock the Terms & Semesters first" | The year's calendar is not locked |
| "Add at least one session" | Empty list |
| "Session names must be different" | Duplicate names |
| "pick at least one day" / "pick operating days only" | Bad `days` |
| "set the arrival window" / "the arrival window must end after it starts" | Bad arrival window |
| "set the dismissal and departure times" | To-home session without them |
| "departure must be at or after dismissal" | `depart` before `dismissal` |
| "arrival home cannot start before departure" | `arrive_from` before `depart` |
| "Different Timing N: pick days the session runs" | Variant uses days outside the session |
| "Different Timing N: a day is in two timings" | Two variants share a day |

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 6. Bus Sessions_

post.description:
POST /academic_years/:academic_year_id/registration/schedule { …settings }

There is one registration per school academic year.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/registration` | The settings. Before a save, these are the defaults (`saved: false`) |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/registration` | Save Draft, or Save Changes once scheduled |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/registration/schedule` | Save and schedule. Takes the same body |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/registration/unschedule` | Back to draft: messages stop and the form closes to parents |

put.description:
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure, period_count, cca_same_as_terms,
  terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }

An academic year runs for 12 months from its start month.

- Its `key` is `"2026"` when it starts in January, otherwise `"2026/27"`.
- Its calendar has operating days and either 2 Semesters or 3–4 Terms.
- Each term has a CCA / ASA period: the term's own dates when `cca_same_as_terms`, otherwise its own dates.
- A **school day** is an operating day, inside a term, and not a holiday.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/academic_years` | The years, oldest first (the year selector) |
| `POST /schools/:id/academic_years { start_year, start_month, copy_from_id }` | New Academic Year (see below) |
| `GET /academic_years/:id` | One year with its terms, holidays and special days |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar` | Save Calendar: validates, saves and **locks** |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "calendar" }` | Unlock to Edit |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id` | Delete Year |

**New Academic Year:**

- With `copy_from_id`, it copies the operating days, structure and CCA setting of that year, but not its dates.
- Otherwise it starts with Mon–Fri and 2 Semesters.
- The empty terms are created.
- 422 "This overlaps AY 2027" when the 12 months overlap another year.

`GET /academic_years/:id`:

```json
{ "id": 5, "key": "2027", "start_year": 2027, "start_month": 1, "starts_on": "2027-01-01", "ends_on": "2027-12-31",
  "structure": "term", "period_count": 4, "period_label": "Term", "operating_days": [1,2,3,4,5], "cca_same_as_terms": true,
  "started": false, "calendar_locked": { "at": "…", "by": "Ops Admin" },
  "terms": [ { "position": 1, "label": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-03-12", "school_days": 50,
               "cca_starts_on": "2027-01-04", "cca_ends_on": "2027-03-12" } ],
  "school_days": 200,
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 3. Terms & Semesters (academic years)_

`academic_years#update_calendar`

get.description:
GET /academic_years/:id/public_holidays — Import Public Holidays: the company's public holidays inside the year
that are not on its list yet (the screen adds them to the draft).

This page is always editable; the calendar lock does not apply. It saves the whole list, like the prototype's Save
Changes.

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/holidays { holidays: [{ name, starts_on, ends_on, public_holiday_id }],
                                   special_days: [{ date, kind, time, description }] }
```

- Holidays need a `name` and `starts_on`. `ends_on` defaults to `starts_on` and must not be before it.
- Special day `kind` is `early_dismissal`, `late_dismissal`, `early_arrival`, `late_arrival` or `other`. `time` is
  "HH:MM".
- The response is the year (§3), which includes "N operating days off" as `operating_days_off`.
- Errors name the row, e.g. "Holiday 1: Ends on must be on or after the start".

**Import Singapore Public Holidays:** `GET /academic_years/:id/public_holidays` returns the company's public holidays
inside the year (Settings › Calendars) that are not on the list yet:

```json
[ { "public_holiday_id": 12, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06" } ]
```

Add them to the draft, then save.

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 4. Holidays & Special Days_

`academic_years#public_holidays`

GET /academic_years/:id/setup — the Year Setup steps (done = locked) for the strip and the Summary.

`GET /academic_years/:id/setup`:

```json
{ "year": "2026", "done": 4, "total": 7, "complete": false,
  "steps": [ { "number": 1, "key": "levels", "label": "School Levels", "scope": "school", "available": true, "done": true, "locked_at": "…", "locked_by": "…" },
             { "number": 4, "key": "fares", "label": "Bus Fares", "scope": "year", "available": false, "done": false },
             { "number": 8, "key": "holidays", "label": "Holidays & Special Days", "scope": "year", "available": true, "done": null, "always_editable": true } ] }
```

- Show "`done` of `total` done" on the strip.
- `available: false` marks the steps still to come (Fares, Policy, Operator Pay). Show them as not set up.
- The Summary page reads each step's own endpoint: §3, §5, §6 and §7.

| `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar` | Save Calendar: validates, saves and **locks** |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "calendar" }` | Unlock to Edit |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id` | Delete Year |

**New Academic Year:**

- With `copy_from_id`, it copies the operating days, structure and CCA setting of that year, but not its dates.
- Otherwise it starts with Mon–Fri and 2 Semesters.
- The empty terms are created.
- 422 "This overlaps AY 2027" when the 12 months overlap another year.

`GET /academic_years/:id`:

```json
{ "id": 5, "key": "2027", "start_year": 2027, "start_month": 1, "starts_on": "2027-01-01", "ends_on": "2027-12-31",
  "structure": "term", "period_count": 4, "period_label": "Term", "operating_days": [1,2,3,4,5], "cca_same_as_terms": true,
  "started": false, "calendar_locked": { "at": "…", "by": "Ops Admin" },
  "terms": [ { "position": 1, "label": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-03-12", "school_days": 50,
               "cca_starts_on": "2027-01-04", "cca_ends_on": "2027-03-12" } ],
  "school_days": 200,
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

_Source: `school-bus-setup.md` § 3. Terms & Semesters (academic years)_
