GET /ops_control?tab=needs_action|all|not_started|running|ended&client_id=&q=&sort=asc|desc

`GET /ops_control?tab=needs_action&client_id=&q=&sort=asc`

| Param | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `tab` | `needs_action` (default), `all`, `not_started`, `running`, `ended` |
| `client_id` | a client from `data.clients` |
| `q` | plate, driver, trip title, TID or client |
| `sort` | `asc` (earliest first pick-up first, default) or `desc` |

```json
{ "data": {
    "kpis": { "next_2_hours": 3, "window_until": "2026-11-02T10:00:00+08:00", "running": 3, "action_now": 3, "unacknowledged": 3,
              "at_risk": 1, "on_time_today": 50, "on_time_count": 1, "started_today": 2, "late_today": 1 },
    "banner": { "count": 3, "more": 0,
                "trips": [ { "occurrence_id": 40, "first_pickup_at": "2026-11-02T07:30:00+08:00", "plate": "SBA0004D",
                             "message": "No GPS for 7 min", "title": "WEN Shuttle", "trip_label": "TID000004", "client": "Google",
                             "route": "Boon Lay MRT to Mapletree Business City", "raised_at": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00",
                             "escalated": false, "driver": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "phone": "+6591234471" } } ] },
    "tab": "needs_action",
    "counts": { "needs_action": 4, "all": 5, "not_started": 2, "running": 3, "ended": 0 },
    "clients": [ { "id": 3, "name": "Google" } ],
    "rows": [ {
      "id": 37, "key": "t12|2026-11-02|0|1|1", "date": "2026-11-02", "trip_label": "TID000001", "title": "WEN Shuttle",
      "client": { "id": 3, "name": "Google" }, "route": "Boon Lay MRT to Mapletree Business City",
      "vehicle_id": 48, "plate": "SBA0001A", "driver": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "phone": "+6591234471" },
      "first_pickup_at": "2026-11-02T08:10:00+08:00", "ends_at": "2026-11-02T10:00:00+08:00", "timeline_from": "2026-11-02T07:55:00+08:00",
      "state": "action_now", "severity": 2, "arrived_at": null,
      "app": { "status": "not_logged_in", "started_at": null, "ended_at": null, "signed_in_at": null, "last_seen_at": "2026-11-01T18:30:00+08:00" },
      "gps": { "status": "to_first_pickup", "last_ping_at": "2026-11-02T07:59:50+08:00", "distance_m": 300, "stops_reached": 0, "stops": 2 },
      "eta": { "at": null, "late_minutes": null },
      "alerts": [ { "id": 21, "kind": "login", "severity": 2, "message": "Driver not logged in to the Convoy Driver app",
                    "raised_at": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00", "acknowledged_at": null, "acknowledged_by": null, "escalated": false },
                  { "id": 22, "kind": "start", "severity": 1,
                    "message": "Trip not started. First pick-up in 10 min. Driver is 300 m away but has not started", "…": "…" } ],
      "can_acknowledge": true, "acknowledged": null } ] },
  "meta": { "now": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00", "duty": "Nur Aisyah",
            "rules": { "login_minutes": [20, 10], "start_minutes": [15, 5], "eta_late_minutes": [2, 5], "miss_after_minutes": 2,
                       "late_after_minutes": 2, "gps_minutes": [3, 6], "escalate_after_minutes": 3,
                       "window_ahead_minutes": 120, "window_behind_minutes": 15 } } }
```

**Which runs are listed:** runs with a bus, not cancelled, whose first pick-up is up to 2 hours from now and that ended
less than 15 minutes ago. A run without a bus belongs to the Scheduler's Unassigned list.

**KPIs** (cover all runs, not filtered):

| Tile | Field |
| --- | --- |
| Trips in Next 2 Hours | `next_2_hours` ("First pick-up before `window_until`") |
| Running Now | `running` |
| Action Now | `action_now`, with "`unacknowledged` alerts not acknowledged" or "All acknowledged" |
| At Risk | `at_risk` |
| On-Time Starts Today | `on_time_today` % (`null` → N/A); "`on_time_count` of `started_today` at first pick-up on time" |
| Late Starts Today | `late_today`: more than 2 min late, or not at the first pick-up at all |

**Banner:** "`count` trips need action now". It lists `trips` (up to 3) with Call (`tel:` the driver's phone) and
Acknowledge. Add "+`more` more in the table below" when `more` > 0. `escalated: true` means it went to the Ops Manager.

**Tabs:** use `counts`. They follow the client and search filters, as in the prototype.

**Row fields:**

- `state` drives the status chip and row colour:

  | `state` | Chip | Tone |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `action_now` | Action Now | danger |
  | `at_risk` | At Risk | warning |
  | `on_route` | On Route | success |
  | `on_the_way` | On the Way | success |
  | `ready` | Ready (logged in, not started) | info |
  | `scheduled` | Scheduled | info |
  | `completed` | Completed (row faded) | neutral |

- Time and countdown:
  - Show `first_pickup_at`.
  - Countdown before the pick-up: "in N min". After it: "N min overdue".
  - Once arrived (`arrived_at` set): "Arrived on time", or "Arrived N min late" when more than 2 min late.
- `app.status` (Driver App column):

  | `app.status` | Label and sub-line |
  | --- | --- |
  | `not_logged_in` | Not Logged In, "Last seen" `last_seen_at`. Red within 20 min of the pick-up. |
  | `not_started` | Not Started |
  | `started` | Started at `started_at` |
  | `running` | Running, "Started" `started_at` |
  | `ended` | Trip Ended |
  | `no_account` | No App: the driver was typed in, with no app account |

- `gps.status` (GPS column):

  | `gps.status` | Label and sub-line |
  | --- | --- |
  | `to_first_pickup` | `distance_m` to the first pick-up (show km above 1000), plus how long ago `last_ping_at` was |
  | `on_route` | Stop `stops_reached` of `stops` |
  | `no_signal` | No signal, "Last ping N min ago" |
  | `at_drop_off` | At drop-off |

- `eta` (ETA column):
  - `eta.at` is set once the driver has started.
  - It is a straight line at 30 km/h from the last position.
  - Show `+late_minutes min` when more than 2, otherwise "On time".
  - Not started shows N/A; arrived shows "At first pick-up".
- Timeline bar:
  - The bar runs from `timeline_from` (15 min before the first pick-up) to `ends_at`.
  - The marker is at `first_pickup_at`.
  - Draw the scale from now − 15 min to now + 2 h; the "now" line uses `meta.now`.
- Issue column:
  - Show `alerts[0].message`, and "(+N more)" when there are more alerts.
  - `alerts` is ordered most severe first. Their messages are live: the minutes update on every load.
- Acknowledge:
  - Show the button when `can_acknowledge` is true.
  - Once every open alert is acknowledged, `acknowledged` = `{ at, by }`. Show "Acknowledged HH:MM by Name".
- Call: `tel:` + `driver.phone`.

_Source: `ops-control.md` § 1. The board_

post.description:
POST /ops_control/runs/:id/acknowledge

`POST /ops_control/runs/:id/acknowledge` (`:id` = the row `id` or the banner `occurrence_id`) returns:

```json
{ "acknowledged": 2, "at": "2026-11-02T08:04:00+08:00", "by": "Nur Aisyah" }
```

- It acknowledges every open alert of the run, as the signed-in user (the person on duty, `meta.duty`).
- It stops the alarm and the escalation. The trip **stays flagged** until the problem clears.
- Returns 422 "Nothing to acknowledge on this trip" when nothing is open and unacknowledged.
- Reload the board afterwards.

_Source: `ops-control.md` § 3. Acknowledge_

get.description:
GET /live_map?q=&state=on_trip|available|offline&team_id=

`GET /live_map?q=&state=&team_id=` returns the Fleet panel, the markers and the counts:

```json
{ "data": [
    { "id": 4, "plate": "SBA3546A", "make": "Mitsubishi", "model": "Rosa", "seats": 29, "ownership": "own", "operator": null,
      "team": { "id": 1, "name": "East", "color": "#008C95" },
      "driver": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "phone": "+65 9123 4471" },
      "state": "on_trip", "online": true, "on_map": true,
      "position": { "lat": 1.2801, "lng": 103.8102, "speed_kmh": 38, "heading": 90, "recorded_at": "2026-11-02T08:19:55+08:00" },
      "last_reported_at": "2026-11-02T08:19:55+08:00", "road": null,
      "device": { "kind": "gps_tracker", "name": "OTW GPS T-8 tracker" },
      "run": { "id": 492, "trip_label": "TID103716-3", "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "client": "Google Asia Pacific",
               "date": "2026-11-02", "key": "t8|2026-11-02|2|1|1", "kind": "corporate_shuttle", "kind_name": "Corporate Shuttle",
               "trip_id": 8, "school_route_id": null,
               "starts_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:00+08:00", "ends_at": "2026-11-02T08:30:00+08:00",
               "points": 3, "points_done": 1,
               "next_stop": { "position": 1, "number": 2, "last": false, "name": "Alexandra Road (Opp Blk 1)",
                              "planned_at": "2026-11-02T08:22:00+08:00", "at_stop": false, "arrived_at": null,
                              "eta_at": "2026-11-02T08:24:00+08:00", "late_minutes": 2 } },
      "next_run": { "id": 494, "trip_label": "TID103716-5", "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "client": "Google Asia Pacific",
                    "starts_at": "2026-11-02T08:45:00+08:00" },
      "last_run": null } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "on_trip": 6, "available": 5, "offline": 2 }, "now": "2026-11-02T08:20:00+08:00",
            "teams": [ { "id": 1, "name": "East", "color": "#008C95" } ], "offline_after_minutes": 15 } }
```

- Every kept bus is listed (own, managed and external), sorted by plate. `q` matches the plate or the driver's name;
  `state` and `team_id` filter. `meta.counts` covers all buses and is not filtered, which suits the On Trip / Available /
  Offline chips. Group by team on the FE with `team` (no team = "No Team", grey).
- `state`:
  - `on_trip`: the bus has a run that has started and not ended.
  - `available`: the device reported in the last `offline_after_minutes`.
  - `offline`: no report for that long, or no device at all.
  
  A bus on a trip whose device went quiet keeps `on_trip` with `online: false`.
- An offline bus stays on the map at its last position (grey marker), however long ago that was. `on_map: false` only
  when the bus has never reported (`position: null`); the row shows "Not on map". `position` is the last report. `speed_kmh` is 0 when offline.
- `driver`: the run's driver, or the bus's default driver today.
- Row text:
  - **On a trip:** `run.client | run.title | to Point {next_stop.number} of {run.points}`. The right side shows
    `ETA {next_stop.eta_at}`, or `Arrived {arrived_at}` when `next_stop.at_stop` is true (the chip then reads "Arrived";
    otherwise "On the way"). "Last Point" when `next_stop.last`.
  - **Available:** "Next trip starts {next_run.starts_at}", or `{last_run.title} | ended {last_run.ended_at}`.
  - **Offline:** "Since {last_reported_at}" plus how long ago.
- `eta_at` is estimated as a straight line at 30 km/h from the last position. It is the planned time when there is no
  fresh position. `late_minutes` = ETA (or arrival) minus the planned time, never below 0.
- `road` is always `null` for now (road names need a map service). Hide the Road line.

get.description:
GET /live_map/vehicles/:id

`GET /live_map/vehicles/:id` is used when a bus is clicked (the Vehicle and Device window and the trip drawer). It
returns the same row plus:

```json
{ "device": { "id": 4, "kind": "gps_tracker", "name": "OTW GPS T-8 tracker", "sharing_enabled": true,
              "report_interval_seconds": 10, "battery_pct": 78, "gps_signal": "good", "gsm_bars": 2 },
  "run": { "…": "as in the board",
           "on_board": 6, "eta_last": "2026-11-02T08:32:00+08:00",
           "stops": [ { "position": 0, "name": "Labrador Park MRT Exit A", "use": "pu", "lat": 1.2722, "lng": 103.8025,
                        "planned_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:00+08:00", "arrived_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:00+08:00",
                        "departed_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:40+08:00", "skipped": false, "state": "done",
                        "students": [ { "key": "…", "name": "Aiden Tan", "class_name": "P3A", "status": "boarded",
                                        "boarded_at": "…", "alighted_at": null } ] } ] } }
```

- Vehicle and Device rows:

  | Row | Source |
  | --- | --- |
  | Vehicle | `plate`, `make` / `model` |
  | Current Driver | `driver.name` |
  | Speed | `position.speed_kmh`; N/A when offline |
  | Current Trip | `run.title`, `run.trip_label`, `run.client` |
  | Timestamp / Last Online | `last_reported_at` |
  | Device | `device.name` |
  | GPS Signal | `device.gps_signal`: good / fair / poor / none ("No fix" when none) |
  | GSM Signal | `device.gsm_bars` of 4 |
  | Battery Level | `device.battery_pct` ("at last report" when offline) |

- Location Sharing is "Enabled" when `device.sharing_enabled` and the bus is online. The note under it reads "GPS tracker
  reporting every {report_interval_seconds} s" for `gps_tracker`, or "Driver app sharing in the background" for
  `driver_app`. The **Check** button has no API yet (it needs the driver app). Hide it, or refetch this endpoint.
- Trip drawer:
  - Points `points_done` of `points`, `on_board` (boarded minus alighted so far), ETA Last `eta_last`.
  - Stops in travel order. `state` is `done` (reached or skipped), `current` (heading there) or `upcoming`. Show
    `arrived_at` for done stops and `planned_at` for the rest.
  - `students` is filled only for School Run trips (matched by stop name). `status` is `boarded` / `alighted` / `absent`
    / `not_marked`. The label depends on the stop:
    - at a pick-up that is done: Picked up / Absent
    - at the current stop: Waiting
    - otherwise: Not yet
    - at the last stop: Dropped off / On board
- Draw the route line through the stops' `lat` / `lng` (the API has no road geometry).
- `run` is `null` when the bus is not on a trip. In that case show "No trip running now" with the available / offline
  text from section 1.

_Source: `live-map.md` § 2. One bus_

`GET /reports/shuttle/options` →

```json
{ "clients": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Google Asia Pacific", "on_time_allowance": 3,
                 "routes": [ { "id": 12, "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "ref": "T-000012" } ] } ],
  "periods": [ { "value": "m|2026-10", "label": "October 2026" }, { "value": "q|2026-4", "label": "Q4 2026" }, { "value": "y|2026", "label": "2026" } ] }
```

Clients with Corporate Shuttle routes; periods = the last 12 months, 5 quarters, 2 years. Empty `clients` → "No shuttle routes
yet. Add a Corporate Shuttle trip with a timetable in the Scheduler and its report builds itself".

`reports#options`

GET /reports/shuttle?trip_id=&period=m|2026-10

`GET /reports/shuttle?trip_id=12&period=m|2026-10` (no period = last month) →

```json
{ "trip": { "id": 12, "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "client": "Google Asia Pacific" },
  "period": { "from": "2026-10-01", "to": "2026-10-31", "label": "October 2026" },
  "on_time_allowance": 3, "early_minutes": 5, "has_data": true,
  "kpis": { "utilisation": 54.1, "utilisation_change": -0.1, "riders": 2437, "riders_change": 416, "avg_per_day": 110.8,
            "on_time": 81.3, "on_time_change": -1.6, "service_days": 22, "runs": 196, "seats": 23 },
  "timings": [ { "dep": "07:30", "direction": 1, "direction_label": "To MBC Tower 1", "utilisation": 71.2, "riders": 344, "avg": 15.6, "max": 21, "tag": "Busiest" } ],
  "stop_activity": [ { "direction": 1, "label": "To MBC Tower 1", "stops": [ { "name": "Labrador MRT", "boarded": 812, "pct": 60.2 } ] } ],
  "trend": [ { "month": "2026-10", "riders": 2437, "utilisation": 54.1, "on_time": 81.3, "in_period": true } ] }
```

- Utilisation = riders ÷ seats offered (each run's bus seats). Percentages to one decimal; `*_change` = against the period
  before of the same length (points for percentages, riders for riders); `null` when either has no data.
- On time = a stop reached from `early_minutes` (5) before the timetable to `on_time_allowance` minutes after it.
  Early (more than 5 minutes before) still counts on time; **Left Early** (left a pick-up before the timetable) and Late count
  against; skipped stops are left out. Change the allowance with `PATCH /clients/:id { client: { on_time_allowance } }` (0–15, −1 / +1).
- `timings`: Utilisation by Shuttle Timing, busiest first (`tag` Busiest / Quietest). `stop_activity`: boardings per pick-up per
  direction (routes with 3 or more stops; the destination is left out). `trend`: the 12 months to the period's end (`in_period` = shaded).

_Source: `reports.md` § 2. The report_

GET /reports/shuttle/grid?trip_id=&month=2026-10

`GET /reports/shuttle/grid?trip_id=12&month=2026-10` → Riders per Timing per Day and the On Time Report of one month:

```json
{ "month": "2026-10", "dates": ["2026-10-01", "…"],
  "rows": [ { "timing": { "key": "1-0", "direction": 1, "position": 0, "dep": "07:30" },
              "cells": [ { "date": "2026-10-01", "occurrence_id": 5512, "riders": 16, "amended": false }, null ],
              "total": 344, "avg": 15.6, "max": 21, "util": 71.2,
              "stops": [ { "name": "Labrador MRT", "planned": "07:30" } ],
              "on_time": [ { "date": "2026-10-01", "occurrence_id": 5512,
                             "stops": [ { "status": "ok", "arrived": "07:29", "amended": false } ] } ] } ],
  "on_time": { "ok": 640, "early": 21, "late": 118, "edep": 3, "skip": 9, "pct": 84.5 },
  "worst_timing": "17:30", "worst_day": "2026-10-14" }
```

- `cells` / `on_time` follow `dates` (a `null` = the timing did not run that day). Stop `status`: `ok` (On Time), `early`
  (Early, pale green), `late`, `edep` (Left Early), `skip` (Skipped); `amended` = changed by Correct Record (badge).

GET /finance/invoices/summary?month= — KPIs and aging.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| KPIs and Aging card | `GET /finance/invoices/summary?month=2026-11` |
| Clients card (balance by billing entity) | `GET /finance/invoices/clients` |
| Statement (print) | `GET /finance/invoices/statement?client_id=&client_site_id=` |
| Record Payment | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/payments { paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Credit Note | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/credit_note { amount, reason }` |
| Email | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/send { to: [], cc: [] }` (recorded only) |

All three need an issued invoice (`422` "Only an issued invoice can take this") and return the invoice.

- **Payments**: `method` one of `Bank Transfer`, `PayNow`, `GIRO`, `Cheque`, `Cash`; `paid_on` defaults to today, `amount` to the balance on the
  front end. `422` "Enter the amount received", "More than the balance of S$x", "Pick how it was paid".
  Shown as "<paid_on> | <method> <reference>".
- **Credit note**: a document of its own (`kind: credit_note`, `CN-2026-000001`, no GST breakdown) that reduces the invoice's balance.
  `422` "Enter the credit amount", "More than the balance of S$x", "Enter the reason". Listed in the Credit Notes tab and in the invoice's `credit_notes`.
- **Email**: no email is sent yet; `to` / `cc` default to the billing people (To / CC). `422` "Add who the invoice goes To in Billing Details".
  `sends [{ at, to, cc, by }]` → "Emailed to <to> on <date> (recorded)".
- Invoice amounts: `paid`, `credited`, `balance` = total − paid − credit notes (not below 0).

Summary: `{ owed, overdue, invoiced, collected, month, aging [{ key, label, amount, count }] }` — Owed to You (open balances),
Overdue (past due), Invoiced <Mon> (issued that month), Collected <Mon> (payments that month). Aging buckets: `current`
(not past due), `1_30`, `31_60`, `61_90`, `over_90` (days past due).

get.description:
GET /finance/operator_pay/requests

Everything the company owes operators. Finance approves requests and sets the pay date; approvals with the same pay date
pool into one batch, which makes one bank file and one payment notice per operator. Approving, changing pay dates and
recording payments need an approver of Finance Settings (`422` "Only approvers in Finance Settings can approve requests,
set pay dates and record payments"); when no approver is set, anyone with `finance` can.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Payment Requests tab, KPIs | `GET /finance/operator_pay/requests` |
| Set a run's cost | `PUT /finance/operator_pay/costs { ref, amount }` (`422` "Enter a cost of 0 or more") |
| Add Item for <operator> | `POST /finance/operator_pay/items { operator_id, sign: pay \| deduct, description, item_on, amount }` |
| Delete an item | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/items/:id` |
| Approve and Set Pay Date | `POST /finance/operator_pay/approve { refs: [], pay_date }` or `{ refs: [], batch_id }` (Or add to an open batch) |
| Ad Hoc Payment / Pay Now | `POST /finance/operator_pay/ad_hoc { operator_id, pay_date, refs: [], extra: { description, amount } }` |
| Batches tab | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches` |
| A batch | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Change Pay Date (pool into another batch) | `PATCH /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id { pay_date, merge: true }` |
| Cancel Batch | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Pay (one operator) | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/payments { batch_operator_id, paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Mark All Paid | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/mark_paid` |
| Make Bank File | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file { transfer_type: FAST \| GIRO }` → the batch + `csv`, `filename` |
| Download Again | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file.csv` (CSV file) |

put.description:
PUT /finance/operator_pay/costs { ref: "run:<id>:<date>", amount }

Everything the company owes operators. Finance approves requests and sets the pay date; approvals with the same pay date
pool into one batch, which makes one bank file and one payment notice per operator. Approving, changing pay dates and
recording payments need an approver of Finance Settings (`422` "Only approvers in Finance Settings can approve requests,
set pay dates and record payments"); when no approver is set, anyone with `finance` can.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Payment Requests tab, KPIs | `GET /finance/operator_pay/requests` |
| Set a run's cost | `PUT /finance/operator_pay/costs { ref, amount }` (`422` "Enter a cost of 0 or more") |
| Add Item for <operator> | `POST /finance/operator_pay/items { operator_id, sign: pay \| deduct, description, item_on, amount }` |
| Delete an item | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/items/:id` |
| Approve and Set Pay Date | `POST /finance/operator_pay/approve { refs: [], pay_date }` or `{ refs: [], batch_id }` (Or add to an open batch) |
| Ad Hoc Payment / Pay Now | `POST /finance/operator_pay/ad_hoc { operator_id, pay_date, refs: [], extra: { description, amount } }` |
| Batches tab | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches` |
| A batch | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Change Pay Date (pool into another batch) | `PATCH /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id { pay_date, merge: true }` |
| Cancel Batch | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Pay (one operator) | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/payments { batch_operator_id, paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Mark All Paid | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/mark_paid` |
| Make Bank File | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file { transfer_type: FAST \| GIRO }` → the batch + `csv`, `filename` |
| Download Again | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file.csv` (CSV file) |

GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file.csv — Download Again

Everything the company owes operators. Finance approves requests and sets the pay date; approvals with the same pay date
pool into one batch, which makes one bank file and one payment notice per operator. Approving, changing pay dates and
recording payments need an approver of Finance Settings (`422` "Only approvers in Finance Settings can approve requests,
set pay dates and record payments"); when no approver is set, anyone with `finance` can.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Payment Requests tab, KPIs | `GET /finance/operator_pay/requests` |
| Set a run's cost | `PUT /finance/operator_pay/costs { ref, amount }` (`422` "Enter a cost of 0 or more") |
| Add Item for <operator> | `POST /finance/operator_pay/items { operator_id, sign: pay \| deduct, description, item_on, amount }` |
| Delete an item | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/items/:id` |
| Approve and Set Pay Date | `POST /finance/operator_pay/approve { refs: [], pay_date }` or `{ refs: [], batch_id }` (Or add to an open batch) |
| Ad Hoc Payment / Pay Now | `POST /finance/operator_pay/ad_hoc { operator_id, pay_date, refs: [], extra: { description, amount } }` |
| Batches tab | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches` |
| A batch | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Change Pay Date (pool into another batch) | `PATCH /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id { pay_date, merge: true }` |
| Cancel Batch | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Pay (one operator) | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/payments { batch_operator_id, paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Mark All Paid | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/mark_paid` |
| Make Bank File | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file { transfer_type: FAST \| GIRO }` → the batch + `csv`, `filename` |
| Download Again | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file.csv` (CSV file) |

_Source: `finance.md` § 4. Operator Payments_

`operator_payments#download_bank_file`

GET /finance/vehicles/pl?period=month|ytd|this_year|last_year|last_12|all&basis=profit|cash&month=2026-10

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Period, basis, fleet totals, profit by vehicle, categories, 12-month chart, cost per km by bus size | `GET /finance/vehicles/pl?period=&basis=&month=2026-10` |
| A vehicle's P&L, break-even, manual entries | `GET /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/pl?period=&basis=&month=` |
| Cost Spikes / Mark Checked | `GET /finance/vehicles/spikes?month=`, `POST /finance/vehicles/spikes/ack { vehicle_id, category, month: "2026-10" }` |
| Due in the next 90 days | `GET /finance/vehicles/due` |
| Add a manual revenue / cost | `POST /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries { entry: { kind, category, entry_on, amount, repeats_monthly, note } }` |
| Stop a repeat from a month / edit | `PATCH /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries/:id { entry: { repeat_until: "2026-12-31" } }` |
| Delete an entry (repeating: "Delete <cat> from every month it repeats in?") | `DELETE /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries/:id` |

`period`: `month` (the `month` given), `ytd` (Year to Date), `this_year`, `last_year`, `last_12` (Last 12 Months), `all` (All Time).
`basis`: `profit` (depreciation and loan interest) or `cash` (purchase / down payment and loan instalments when paid out).

Fleet: `{ period, basis, from, to, revenue, cost, profit, margin, vehicles [{ vehicle_id, plate, seats, revenue, cost, profit }] (weakest first),
categories [{ kind, category, amount }], chart [{ month, revenue, cost, profit }] (12 months to `month`),
cost_per_km [{ size: Minibus | Medium Bus | Coach, vehicles, km, cost_per_km, revenue_per_km, profit_per_km }] }`.
Vehicle: the same totals, `categories`, `chart`, `break_even { revenue, cost, trip_revenue, runs, per_run, runs_needed, gap }`
("Short by" when `gap` > 0, else "Covered by") and `entries`.

What is counted (each month):

| Category | Kind | From |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "<Trip kind> (auto)", e.g. "Ad Hoc / Charter (auto)", "Shuttle (auto)" | revenue | Client price of runs on the bus, not cancelled, up to today |
| Manual entries | revenue / cost | Once in the month of `entry_on`, or every month from it until `repeat_until` |
| "Insurance Premium (auto)" | cost | Each policy's premium (before GST) spread over its cover months |
| "Fuel and Energy (auto)" | cost | Fuel & Energy entries |
| "Maintenance (auto)" | cost | Completed maintenance visits (with GST) |
| "Driver Salary (auto)", "Employer CPF (auto)" | cost | Each default driver's pay scheme for the month with no trips (fixed pay and top-up), × the share of the month they were the bus's default driver; CPF for Citizens / PR by age band (KYC) |
| "Depreciation" (profit) | cost | Purchase price over the months to COE expiry (else 120 months) from the buying month |
| "Loan Interest" (profit) | cost | Interest of each instalment in its due month |
| "Purchase" / "Down Payment", "Loan Instalments" (cash) | cost | In the buying month / each instalment's due month |

Manual categories: revenue `School Bus`, `Charter and Trips`, `Contract`, `Other Revenue`; cost `Road Tax`, `Parking and ERP`,
`Cleaning`, `Other Cost`. `422`: "Enter an amount above zero", "Pick the date", "Category is not a <kind> category".
The "Is This Already Counted?" question before adding revenue is front end only.

Cost spike: `{ vehicle_id, plate, category, amount, usual, month, checked }` — a cost this month above 1.5 × its median of the six
months before (present in at least three) and S$100 over it.

Due: `[{ vehicle_id, plate, date, kind: instalment | insurance | road_tax | coe, text, amount }]` — unpaid instalments (also overdue),
insurance renewals (last premium total), road tax expiry (estimated from the Road Tax entries), COE expiry.

_Source: `finance.md` § 7. Vehicle Financials: profit and loss_

| Period, basis, fleet totals, profit by vehicle, categories, 12-month chart, cost per km by bus size | `GET /finance/vehicles/pl?period=&basis=&month=2026-10` |
| A vehicle's P&L, break-even, manual entries | `GET /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/pl?period=&basis=&month=` |
| Cost Spikes / Mark Checked | `GET /finance/vehicles/spikes?month=`, `POST /finance/vehicles/spikes/ack { vehicle_id, category, month: "2026-10" }` |
| Due in the next 90 days | `GET /finance/vehicles/due` |
| Add a manual revenue / cost | `POST /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries { entry: { kind, category, entry_on, amount, repeats_monthly, note } }` |
| Stop a repeat from a month / edit | `PATCH /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries/:id { entry: { repeat_until: "2026-12-31" } }` |
| Delete an entry (repeating: "Delete <cat> from every month it repeats in?") | `DELETE /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries/:id` |

`period`: `month` (the `month` given), `ytd` (Year to Date), `this_year`, `last_year`, `last_12` (Last 12 Months), `all` (All Time).
`basis`: `profit` (depreciation and loan interest) or `cash` (purchase / down payment and loan instalments when paid out).

Fleet: `{ period, basis, from, to, revenue, cost, profit, margin, vehicles [{ vehicle_id, plate, seats, revenue, cost, profit }] (weakest first),
categories [{ kind, category, amount }], chart [{ month, revenue, cost, profit }] (12 months to `month`),
cost_per_km [{ size: Minibus | Medium Bus | Coach, vehicles, km, cost_per_km, revenue_per_km, profit_per_km }] }`.
Vehicle: the same totals, `categories`, `chart`, `break_even { revenue, cost, trip_revenue, runs, per_run, runs_needed, gap }`
("Short by" when `gap` > 0, else "Covered by") and `entries`.

What is counted (each month):

| Category | Kind | From |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "<Trip kind> (auto)", e.g. "Ad Hoc / Charter (auto)", "Shuttle (auto)" | revenue | Client price of runs on the bus, not cancelled, up to today |
| Manual entries | revenue / cost | Once in the month of `entry_on`, or every month from it until `repeat_until` |
| "Insurance Premium (auto)" | cost | Each policy's premium (before GST) spread over its cover months |
| "Fuel and Energy (auto)" | cost | Fuel & Energy entries |
| "Maintenance (auto)" | cost | Completed maintenance visits (with GST) |
| "Driver Salary (auto)", "Employer CPF (auto)" | cost | Each default driver's pay scheme for the month with no trips (fixed pay and top-up), × the share of the month they were the bus's default driver; CPF for Citizens / PR by age band (KYC) |
| "Depreciation" (profit) | cost | Purchase price over the months to COE expiry (else 120 months) from the buying month |
| "Loan Interest" (profit) | cost | Interest of each instalment in its due month |
| "Purchase" / "Down Payment", "Loan Instalments" (cash) | cost | In the buying month / each instalment's due month |

Manual categories: revenue `School Bus`, `Charter and Trips`, `Contract`, `Other Revenue`; cost `Road Tax`, `Parking and ERP`,
`Cleaning`, `Other Cost`. `422`: "Enter an amount above zero", "Pick the date", "Category is not a <kind> category".
The "Is This Already Counted?" question before adding revenue is front end only.

Cost spike: `{ vehicle_id, plate, category, amount, usual, month, checked }` — a cost this month above 1.5 × its median of the six
months before (present in at least three) and S$100 over it.

Due: `[{ vehicle_id, plate, date, kind: instalment | insurance | road_tax | coe, text, amount }]` — unpaid instalments (also overdue),
insurance renewals (last premium total), road tax expiry (estimated from the Road Tax entries), COE expiry.

_Source: `finance.md` § 7. Vehicle Financials: profit and loss_

get.description:
GET /finance/vehicles?filter=all|loan|cash|none&q=

Own vehicles only. Needs the `vehfin` permission.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List, filter All / Loan / Paid in Full / No Details, search, KPIs | `GET /finance/vehicles?filter=all\|loan\|cash\|none&q=` |
| A vehicle (purchase, loan, schedule) | `GET /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id` |
| Edit form → Save | `PATCH /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id { financial: {...} }` (multipart with `financial[schedule_file]`) |
| Upload the lender's schedule (Claude) | `POST /document_reads` `kind=vehicle_loan_schedule`, poll, then Save with `document_read_id` |
| Tick instalments paid / unpaid | `POST /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/instalments { numbers: [1, 2], paid: true, paid_on }` |
| Financials on the vehicle record | `financials` of `GET /vehicles/:id` (users with `vehfin`) |

Row: `{ vehicle_id, plate, make, model, status, funding, lender, purchase_price, owed, monthly, due_this_month }`;
`meta { purchase_cost, owed, monthly, due_this_month }` (Fleet Purchase Cost, Still Owed on Loans, Monthly Instalments, Due This Month).
`status`: `no_details` (No Details), `paid_in_full`, `incomplete` (loan terms missing), `overdue`, `loan_paid_off`, `loan_active`.

Vehicle adds `financial` (the form fields + `schedule_file { url, name }`), `schedule` and `rows`:

- Form fields: `funding` (`loan` / `cash` = Paid in Full), `purchase_price`, `down_payment` (empty = price − loan), `bought_on`, `lender`,
  `account_number`, `loan_amount`, `rate` (% a year), `tenure_months`, `term_charge`, `first_due_on`, `first_instalment`,
  `monthly_instalment`, `last_instalment` (empty = worked out). A loan needs Loan Amount, Tenure and First Instalment Due.
- `schedule`: `{ loan, rate, tenure, term_charge, term_charge_auto, total, scheduled, first, monthly, monthly_auto, last, last_auto, down,
  valid, paid_count, paid_amount, owed, principal_owed, interest_paid, interest_owed, next_due, overdue_count, ends_on, check }`.
  Auto values: term charge = loan × rate × tenure / 12 (flat rate); monthly = (loan + term charge) / tenure rounded up; last = the rest.
  `check` = "The instalments add up to S$x, but loan plus term charge is S$y. Check the figures against the schedule" (or `null`).
- `rows`: `[{ n, due_on, amount, interest, principal, balance, paid_on, status: paid | overdue | due | upcoming }]` (interest spread evenly).
- Reading a schedule fills only empty fields and marks the instalments it shows as paid. A schedule for another plate:
  `422` "This schedule is for PD1234A, not PC7475L. Use Anyway or Remove File first" → resend with `use_anyway: true`.

Vehicle record `financials`: `{ status, funding, purchase_price, bought_on, lender, loan_amount, monthly, owed, ends_on }`, `{ status: "no_details" }`,
or `null` for users without `vehfin` and operator buses.

_Source: `finance.md` § 6. Vehicle Financials: purchase and loan_

get.description:
GET /pay/earnings?month=2026-10&q=

What each driver earned in a month from the trips on the Scheduler. A run counts once it has run and no issue is raised
on it; cancelled, skipped and upcoming runs earn nothing.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Month select, Search, the driver list and totals | `GET /pay/earnings?month=2026-10&q=` |
| Open a driver | `GET /pay/earnings/:driver_id?month=2026-10` |
| Raise an Issue / Clear Issue on a run | `POST /occurrences/:id/issue { reason }` / `DELETE /occurrences/:id/issue` ([scheduler](scheduler.md)), then reload |
| Confirm Month (confirm text in the prototype) | `POST /pay/earnings/:driver_id/confirm?month=2026-10` |
| Reopen Month (Admin; confirm "Reopen <Month> for <driver>?") | `DELETE /pay/earnings/:driver_id/confirm?month=2026-10` |
| Click a Trip ID | Scheduler day view of that run (`date`, run `id`) |

List row: `{ driver_id, name, month, total, completed, held, vehicle { id, plate }, status, confirmed }`;
`meta { month, completed, held, total, confirmed, drivers }` ("<confirmed> of <drivers> confirmed").
`status`: `confirmed` (badge Confirmed), `held` (a run has an issue: Held), `to_confirm` (month ended: To Confirm), `open` (Open).
`confirmed`: `{ by, at, total }` or `null`. A confirmed month shows the frozen `total`.

Driver (`GET /pay/earnings/:driver_id`, and the answer of Confirm / Reopen) adds:

| Field | |
| --- | --- |
| `schemes` | `[{ from, to, id, name, rate_plan }]` — "<scheme> \| <rate plan>" (two when the scheme changed mid-month) |
| `counts` | `{ completed, issue, cancelled, upcoming, running }` (KPIs) |
| `can_confirm`, `why` | `why`: "The month can be confirmed from 1 Dec 2026", "No pay scheme assigned. Pick one in Drivers", "1 trip has an issue raised. Clear them first" |
| `breakdown` | Per part of the month: `{ from, to, scheme, rows, amounts, weeks }` (same rows as the simulator; a confirmed month: the frozen rows) |
| `runs` | `[{ id, date, start_time, end_time, trip_id, trip_label, kind, plate, trip_value, hours, status, issue { reason, at }, amount }]` |

Run `status`: `completed` (Completed), `issue` (Issue Raised: pay held), `running`, `upcoming`, `cancelled`. `amount` = what the
run earned (completed runs only). `hours` is set for runs paid by the hour (disposal, or trips priced by the hour), to the
quarter hour (rounded as the trip says: up by default); others show `trip_value`.

Confirm `422`: the `why` texts, "<Month> is already confirmed". Once a month is confirmed, raising or clearing an issue on
its runs answers `422` "Driver pay for October 2026 is confirmed. Reopen it in HR, Earnings first".

**Export Statement** is printed by the front end from this data (header "Earnings Statement", the breakdown, the runs;
"Provisional, not yet confirmed" until confirmed).

_Source: `hr.md` § 5. Earnings_

`status`: `confirmed` (badge Confirmed), `held` (a run has an issue: Held), `to_confirm` (month ended: To Confirm), `open` (Open).
`confirmed`: `{ by, at, total }` or `null`. A confirmed month shows the frozen `total`.

Driver (`GET /pay/earnings/:driver_id`, and the answer of Confirm / Reopen) adds:

| Field | |
| --- | --- |
| `schemes` | `[{ from, to, id, name, rate_plan }]` — "<scheme> \| <rate plan>" (two when the scheme changed mid-month) |
| `counts` | `{ completed, issue, cancelled, upcoming, running }` (KPIs) |
| `can_confirm`, `why` | `why`: "The month can be confirmed from 1 Dec 2026", "No pay scheme assigned. Pick one in Drivers", "1 trip has an issue raised. Clear them first" |
| `breakdown` | Per part of the month: `{ from, to, scheme, rows, amounts, weeks }` (same rows as the simulator; a confirmed month: the frozen rows) |
| `runs` | `[{ id, date, start_time, end_time, trip_id, trip_label, kind, plate, trip_value, hours, status, issue { reason, at }, amount }]` |

Run `status`: `completed` (Completed), `issue` (Issue Raised: pay held), `running`, `upcoming`, `cancelled`. `amount` = what the
run earned (completed runs only). `hours` is set for runs paid by the hour (disposal, or trips priced by the hour), to the
quarter hour (rounded as the trip says: up by default); others show `trip_value`.

Confirm `422`: the `why` texts, "<Month> is already confirmed". Once a month is confirmed, raising or clearing an issue on
its runs answers `422` "Driver pay for October 2026 is confirmed. Reopen it in HR, Earnings first".

**Export Statement** is printed by the front end from this data (header "Earnings Statement", the breakdown, the runs;
"Provisional, not yet confirmed" until confirmed).

_Source: `hr.md` § 5. Earnings_

get.description:
GET /pay/audit_log?q=&action_type=&item=&page=

`GET /pay/audit_log?q=&action_type=&item=&page=` — every change to rate plans, pay schemes, bonuses, rewards, driver
assignments, points and confirmed months, newest first (the latest 500 changes). Entries can't be edited.

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 62, "at": "2026-11-02T09:00:00+08:00", "user": "Olivia Owner", "action": "award", "item": "points",
              "item_label": "Points", "name": "Eric Pang", "details": "Awarded 20 points: Good conduct" } ],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "count": 6, "pages": 1,
            "actions": ["create", "update", "delete", "lock", "unlock", "award", "deduct", "confirm", "reopen"],
            "items": { "rate_plan": "Rate Plan", "pay_scheme": "Pay Scheme", "campaign_bonus": "Bonus", "reward": "Reward",
                       "driver_assignment": "Driver", "driver_pay": "Driver Pay", "points": "Points" } } }
```

- Filters: `q` (user, name or details), `action_type` (one of `meta.actions`; labels Created, Updated, Deleted, Locked, Unlocked,
  Awarded, Deducted, Confirmed, Reopened), `item` (a key of `meta.items`).
- Columns: When (`at`, local date and HH:MM) | Who | Action (chip) | Item (`item_label` + `name`) | Details.

_Source: `hr.md` § 8. Audit Log_

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Driver list with balances | `GET /pay/points` → `[{ id, name, plate, balance }]` |
| Balance card and History | `GET /pay/points/:driver_id` |
| Award Points / Deduct Points | `POST /pay/points/:driver_id { kind: "award" \| "deduct", points, reason }` (`201`, the driver's points) |

```json
{ "driver": { "id": 4, "name": "Eric Pang" }, "balance": 230, "earned": 350, "used": 120, "expired": 0, "expiring_soon": 0,
  "history": [ { "kind": "deduct", "id": 2, "points": -120, "reason": "S$10 Grab voucher", "on": "2026-11-02", "by": "SimpleDrive Ops", "status": "used" },
               { "kind": "award", "id": 7, "points": 300, "remaining": 180, "reason": "Safe driving, Q3 2026", "source": "manual",
                 "on": "2026-11-02", "expires_on": "2028-11-02", "by": "SimpleDrive Ops", "status": "active" } ] }
```

- Points are kept as lots: each award lasts 24 months; a deduction takes points from the lots expiring first, so an expired
  lot only loses what was left of it. `status` of an award: `active`, `used` (nothing left), `expired` (some left and expired).
- Texts: "{expiring_soon} points expire in the next 60 days"; "Awarded points expire after 24 months"; "Deducted points come off
  the balance now, up to {balance}". `source: "bonus"` = points of a bonus paid in a confirmed month ("Bonus: <name>, Oct 2026").
- `422`: "Enter the number of points", "Enter a reason", "Eric Pang has only 30 points".

_Source: `hr.md` § 7.1 Points_

  lot only loses what was left of it. `status` of an award: `active`, `used` (nothing left), `expired` (some left and expired).
- Texts: "{expiring_soon} points expire in the next 60 days"; "Awarded points expire after 24 months"; "Deducted points come off
  the balance now, up to {balance}". `source: "bonus"` = points of a bonus paid in a confirmed month ("Bonus: <name>, Oct 2026").
- `422`: "Enter the number of points", "Enter a reason", "Eric Pang has only 30 points".

get.description:
Own drivers (active), with the pay scheme and vehicle type used to work out their pay. Operator drivers are paid by
their operator and are not listed.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List, Search (name) | `GET /pay/drivers?q=` |
| Open a driver | `GET /pay/drivers/:id` |
| Assign Scheme | `POST /pay/drivers/:id/schemes { assignment: { pay_scheme_id, starts_on, ends_on } }` |
| Change a scheme row (scheme, start, end) | `PATCH /pay/drivers/:id/schemes/:assignment_id { assignment: {...} }` |
| Remove a scheme row (confirm "Remove this assignment?") | `DELETE /pay/drivers/:id/schemes/:assignment_id` |
| Assign Vehicle Type / change / remove | Same on `/pay/drivers/:id/vehicle_types` with `vehicle_type_id` |

Row: `{ id, name, phone, photo, age, vehicle { id, plate }, vehicle_type { id, name }, scheme_today { id, name } | null, warning }`.
Sub line: "<plate | No vehicle> | <scheme_today.name | No pay scheme>"; "Age <age>" (from the driver's KYC, `null` when not shared).
Each change saves at once and returns the driver.

Driver (`GET /pay/drivers/:id` and every change) adds:
- `pay_schemes [{ id, pay_scheme { id, name }, starts_on, ends_on, tag }]`, `tag` = `upcoming` / `current` / `ended`.
- `vehicle_types [{ id, vehicle_type { id, name }, starts_on, ends_on, tag, warning }]`.
- `min_start` (start dates can go back up to 1 month: "Start dates can go back up to 1 month, to <date>").
- `default_scheme { id, name }`: no scheme rows → "No scheme assigned yet, so <name> is paid on the default scheme, <default>".

Rules: rows never overlap — a new row ends the one before it on the day before (`ends_on` is set for you). A driver with
scheme rows that don't cover a date has **no scheme** that day (paid S$0 → "No pay scheme today"). Without vehicle type
rows, each job is paid at the type of its bus (by seats). `warning`: "Rate plan <plan> of <scheme> has no rates for <type>,
so these jobs are paid S$0". `422`: `details.starts_on` "Starts on can go back up to 1 month, to 2 Oct 2026",
"Starts on already has an assignment"; `details.ends_on` "Ends on is before the start date".

```json
{ "user": { "name": "Paula Planner", "email": "paula@example.com", "password": "secret123",
```

2. `result`:

```json
{ "client_id": 3, "client_name": "DBS Bank", "client_raw": "DBS",
  "contact": { "name": "Daniel Ng", "phone": "98765432", "email": null, "org": "DBS" }, "notes": null,
  "assume": ["tmr read as Tue 3 Nov 2026"], "miss": ["Drop-off time"],
  "trips": [ "one cleaned trip per request found" ],
  "forms": [ { "trip": { "kind": "ad_hoc", "client_id": 3, "starts_on": "2026-11-03", "start_time": "09:00",
                         "stops_attributes": [ { "position": 0, "name": "DBS Asia Central", "use": "pu" }, { "position": 1, "name": "Changi Business Park", "use": "do" } ],
                         "vehicle_requirements_attributes": [ { "vehicle_type_id": 3, "count": 1 } ], "vehicles_count": 1, "pax": 10,
                         "requestor_name": "Daniel Ng", "requestor_phone": "98765432" },
               "return_trip": null, "filled": ["trip_type", "client", "date", "time", "route", "passengers", "vehicles", "requestor"],
               "notes": ["S$900.00 for each vehicle"] } ] }
```

get.description:
GET /client_users/roles

People at the client who sign in to the Client Portal. The same email can be a user of several clients (one Portal
account, an account picker at sign-in).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List | `GET /clients/:client_id/users` |
| Add User | `POST /clients/:client_id/users { client_user: { name, title, email, role, site_ids: [] } }` |
| Edit (dialog: title, role, site access) | `PATCH /clients/:client_id/users/:id { client_user: { title, role, site_ids: [] } }` |
| Remove | `DELETE /clients/:client_id/users/:id` (confirm "Remove <name>?") |
| Role select, Role Permissions window | `GET /client_users/roles` |

User: `{ id, client_id, name, title, email, role, role_label, wide, sites [{ id, name }], created_by { id, name }, created_at,
portal { password_set, last_sign_in_at } }`. Sub line: "Added <created_at> by <created_by.name>"; sites text: `wide` or no
sites → "All sites", else the site names. The list's Users column: `users_count` on `GET /clients`.

- **Site Access**: `wide` roles (Super Admin, Admin, Finance Admin) cover every site: hide the pills, `site_ids` is ignored.
  Site roles need at least one site when the client has sites (`422` "Pick at least one site for a Site Admin").
  Hint: no sites → "This client has no sites, so access covers everything".
- On edit, leave `site_ids` out to keep the sites. Name and email are not changed after adding.
- `422`: "Email is already a user of this client", "<email> belongs to a Convoy OS user of your company",
  "Keep at least one Super Admin for <client>" (changing or removing the last one), "Some sites are not sites of <client>".
- After adding: "They sign in to the Client Portal with this email, get a one-time code the first time and set their own password."

_Source: `clients.md` § 3. Client Users_

`client_users#roles`

The address and pin come from OneMap on the front end (search the typed address or postal code, send `address`, `lat`, `lng`;
no pin found → send the typed text only: "No pin found; stops are matched by name").

Site: `{ id, client_id, name, address, lat, lng, school { id, name }, own_billing, billing_name, billing_uen, billing_address,
billing_contacts [{ id, name, email, send_as, attention }], shuttle_trips_count, created_at }`.
Row text: "Billed to <billing_name> | UEN <billing_uen>" when `own_billing`, else "Billed to <client name>";
sub line "On 2 shuttle trips" (`shuttle_trips_count`), else "Pin set" / "No pin".

Edit Site body:

```json
{ "client_site": { "school_id": 4, "own_billing": true, "billing_name": "Bright Steps (Punggol) Pte Ltd",
                   "billing_uen": "201912345K", "billing_address": "1 Punggol Field",
                   "billing_contacts": [ { "name": "Accounts", "email": "ap@bs.sg", "send_as": "to", "attention": false },
                                         { "name": "Mr Lim", "email": "", "send_as": "to", "attention": true } ] } }
```

- **This Site Is a School**: `school_id` (or `null`). One school per client or site: `422` "School is already linked to <client>".
- **Billed as its own legal entity**: `own_billing: true` needs `billing_name`. `own_billing: false` clears the billing fields and people.
- **Send Invoices To**: send the whole list (up to 6, empty rows are dropped). Each person needs an email unless ticked under
  Attention; an Attention person needs a name; when anyone has an email, at least one must be `to`
  (`422` "Send the invoice To at least one person, not only CC").
- Remove is refused while a trip (not deleted) is for the site or has a stop marked as the site:
  "HQ is on 2 shuttle trips. Unmark it in Stop Details first".
- `422` "Name is already a site of this client" (any case).

_Source: `clients.md` § 2.1 Sites_

Add: `POST /clients`. Edit: `PATCH /clients/:id`.

```json
{ "client": { "kind": "company", "name": "St. Stephen's School", "uen": "T08GB0047K", "contact_name": "Mrs Lee",
              "billing_address": "20 Siglap View", "phone": "+65 6241 1243", "email": "transport@ststephens.edu.sg",

```

- `kind`: `company`, `individual` (name label "Full Name"; no UEN / contact), `transport_company` (Main Contractor).
- `uen` is upper-cased; `422` "Uen looks wrong. Examples: 53012345A, 201912345K, T09LL1234A".

  (`null` / empty unlinks it). `422` "<school> is already linked to <client>".
- **School Calendar** (only with a school): `school_calendar_id`, a calendar with `kind: school` (`422` "Pick a school calendar").
  It is the school's calendar: its holidays stop the school's buses (they re-sync in the background).
- Changing `kind` away from `company` unlinks the school.

put.description:
PUT /vehicle_teams/bulk { teams: [{ id?, name, color }] } — the whole Manage Teams window at once.

The whole window is saved at once:

```json
{ "teams": [ { "id": 1, "name": "East Depot", "color": "#004F59" }, { "name": "Coaches", "color": "#1E5631" } ] }
```

- A row with `id` renames or recolours that team; its vehicles move with it. A row without `id` adds a team.
- A team left out is deleted and its vehicles are left with no team. Ask first: "Delete East? Its 6 vehicles are left with no team".
- Two teams may swap names in one save.
- Errors (422): `"Give every team a name"`, `"Two teams have the same name"`.
- Response: the teams `[{ id, name, color }]`.

Colour swatches (front end): Teal `#004F59`, Sky `#2F7FA8`, Navy `#1F3A68`, Plum `#5B2A6E`, Rose `#B0306A`, Maroon `#8A1C2B`,
Amber `#B35C00`, Olive `#8C6D1F`, Forest `#1E5631`, Graphite `#33373D`.

post.description:
`POST /operators` / `PATCH /operators/:id`:

```json
{ "operator": { "name": "Hup Seng Coaches", "kind": "managed", "uen": "199801234D", "contact_name": "Mr Lim",
                "phone": "+65 6123 4567", "email": "ops@hupseng.sg",
                "payment_method": "bank", "paynow_uen": "199801234D",
                "bank_id": 1, "account_number": "0721234567", "account_name": "HUP SENG COACHES PTE LTD", "branch_code": null } }
```

- `payment_method` is the default: `paynow` (PayNow UEN card) or `bank` (Bank Transfer card). Both can be saved.
- PayNow UEN left empty uses the UEN. UENs are checked: `"Uen looks wrong. Examples: 53012345A, 201912345K, T09LL1234A"`.
- Bank details (when `payment_method` is `bank` or any bank field is given): bank, 6 to 14 digit account number, account name.
- The branch code is worked out from the account number; send `branch_code` only for banks with `pick_branch` / `enter_branch`
  (3.3). Errors: `details.branch_code: ["Branch code must be picked"]`, `["Branch code must be 3 digits"]`,
  `details.account_number: ["Account number matches no UOB branch (check the first 3 digits)"]`.
- Changing the bank clears the old branch code.
- External operators: `paynow_uen` (free text), `cost_per_trip`, `cost_per_day`, `valid_until`; no payment checks.

Delete: `DELETE /operators/:id`. Refused while it has buses: `"Remove the 2 vehicles of Hup Seng Coaches first"`.
Ask first when `routes_count > 0`: "Hup Seng runs 3 routes. Delete anyway?".

_Source: `fleet.md` § 3.2 Add / Edit_

get.description:
| Param | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ownership[]` | `own`, `managed`, `external` |
| `team_id` | A team id, or `none` for vehicles with no team (the No Team chip) |
| `q` | Search: plate, make, model, team, operator, today's default driver (own), operator driver on the bus, typed driver (external) |
| `sort` | `type` (default), `smallest`, `largest`. The pages sort by plate on the front end if they want |
| `page`, `limit` | Paging |

Each row has `plate, seats, make, model, tags, ownership, size_name, default_picture, photo, driver { id, kind, name, phone },
operator, vehicle_team { id, name, color }, insurance { insurer, ends_on, status }`.
The insurance text of a row: `status` `expired` → "Insurance expired", `due_soon` → "Insurance ends <ends_on>", `valid` → "Insured to <ends_on>",
`none` → no insurance line. `insurance` is always an object: with no current policy it is `{ "insurer": null, "ends_on": null, "status": "none" }`.

`meta.facets.teams` gives the team chips for the `ownership[]` picked (the team filter is not applied to it):

```json
"teams": { "all": 13, "none": 2,
           "list": [ { "id": 1, "name": "East", "color": "#004F59", "count": 6 }, { "id": 2, "name": "West", "color": "#2F7FA8", "count": 0 } ] }
```

Show a chip per team (with its colour dot), then **No Team** when `none > 0`. With no teams at all, show one chip "All Vehicles".

_Source: `fleet.md` § 1.1 List: `GET /vehicles`_

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open | `GET /vehicles/:id` |
| Save | `PATCH /vehicles/:id` `{ "vehicle": { plate, seats, make, model, year_made, registered_on, chassis_number, engine_number, coe_expires_on, road_tax_expires_on, tags (list or "Coach, VIP"), notes, photo (file), remove_photo, operator_id, vehicle_team_id, driver_name, driver_phone } }` |
| Add | `POST /vehicles` (same body) |
| Remove | `DELETE /vehicles/:id` |
| Vehicles page list | `GET /vehicles` with the filters of section 1 and `meta.facets` |

Log card details on the form (all optional, send `""` or `null` to clear):

| Field | Form label | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registered_on` | Registration Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `chassis_number` | Chassis Number | text, saved trimmed and upper case |
| `engine_number` | Engine Number | text, saved trimmed and upper case |
| `coe_expires_on` | COE Expiry | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `road_tax_expires_on` | Road Tax Expiry | `YYYY-MM-DD` |

The same fields come back on `GET /vehicles/:id`. A date that can't be read → 422 `{ details: { coe_expires_on: ["is not a valid date"] } }`.

While `plate_conflict` is true (the log card shows another plate), saving is refused until the plate is picked (14.3).

get.description:
View Details: what the driver shared (null until they share), with the NRIC / FIN masked unless reveal_id=true.

```json
{ "data": {
    "driver": { "...": "the row" },
    "kyc": { "email": "eric.pang@gmail.com", "address": "Blk 120 Jurong West St 52, #03-150, Singapore 640000",
             "date_of_birth": "1968-01-01", "age": 58, "nationality": "Singaporean", "residential_status": "Singapore Citizen",
             "id_label": "NRIC", "id_number": "S****567A", "id_revealed": false,
             "licence_class": "Class 4", "licence_qualified_on": "1993-01-01",
             "vocational_licence_number": "BD100000", "vocational_licence_expires_on": "2026-12-16", "vocational_status": "due_soon",
             "shared_at": "..." } } }
```

- `kyc: null` = the driver has not shared yet ("Shared from the Convoy Driver app once the driver accepts").
- The eye button: `GET /drivers/:id/details?reveal_id=true` returns the full `id_number` (`id_revealed: true`). Each reveal is logged.
- `vocational_status`: `expired` (red "Expired"), `due_soon` (orange "in N days", 90 days), `valid`.
- Only the driver can change these details (Driver app); there is no endpoint to edit them.

_Source: `fleet.md` § 2.4 View Details: `GET /drivers/:id/details`_

get.description:
GET ?status=pending|active|declined|past&q= — meta.counts per tab (search applied, tab not).

| Param | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Tab: `active` (default), `pending` (Pending Invites), `declined` (Declined), `past` (Past Drivers) |
| `q` | Name, or 3+ digits of the mobile |
| `operator_id` | Operator drivers only |
| `page`, `limit` | Paging |

`meta.counts` = `{ "pending": 1, "active": 8, "declined": 1, "past": 1 }` for the tab labels (search applied, tab not).

Row (both pages):

```json
{ "id": 7, "name": "Eric Pang", "phone": "+6592104100", "phone_display": "+65 9210 4100", "status": "active",
  "invited_at": "...", "responded_at": "...", "status_on": "...",
  "photo": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "thumb_url": "..." },
  "display": { "name": "Eric", "photo": null, "set_by": "Ops Admin", "set_at": "..." },
  "kyc_shared": true, "last_vehicle": null }
```

Own drivers add `vehicle { id, plate, since }` (default driver today, "Default driver since <since>"; null = "Not on a bus") and

delete.description:
Cancel invite (pending) / Delete (declined, past). Active drivers are removed first.

All are `PATCH /drivers/:id/<action>` (or `/operator_drivers/:id/<action>`) and return the driver.

| Tab | Button | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pending | Resend | `resend` |
| Pending | Mark Accepted / Mark Declined | `accept` / `decline` (until the Driver app answers, an admin records it) |
| Pending | Cancel invite | `DELETE /drivers/:id` |
| Active | View Details | 2.4 |
| Active | Assign Bus / Swap Bus (operator drivers) | Section 1.5 |
| Active | Remove driver | `remove` → Past Drivers |
| Declined, Past | Invite Again | `reinvite` (back to Pending, invite recorded again) |
| Declined, Past | Delete | `DELETE /drivers/:id` |

- **Remove** (own driver): the bus they drive today has no default driver from today, and any change that would have made them
  a default driver later is cleared too. Their bus is kept as `last_vehicle`. Confirm first: "Remove Tan? They lose access to your
  company in the Convoy Driver app and move to Past Drivers. PD1A will have no driver".
- **Remove** (operator driver): they leave their bus (`last_vehicle` keeps it).
- **Delete** keeps the record for history (runs they drove still show their name) but it leaves every list; the mobile can be
  invited again. Active drivers: 422 `"Remove Tan first. Active drivers move to Past Drivers"`.
- A button not allowed in the current state: 422 `"Tan is past, so this can't be done"`.

_Source: `fleet.md` § 2.3 Row buttons_

get.description:
GET /fuel_entries/vehicles?month= — a card per own vehicle (month cost, efficiency, cost per km, last entry).

One card per own bus:

```json
{ "vehicle_id": 7, "plate": "PD997M", "sub": "Toyota HiAce Commuter", "entries": 23, "month_cost": "1029.91",
  "fuel_efficiency": "9.0", "elec_efficiency": null, "cost_per_km": "0.31", "km": 9623,
  "last": { "date": "2026-11-18", "kind": "diesel", "kind_name": "Diesel", "quantity": "38.5", "unit": "L", "odometer": 49623 } }
```

Efficiency: `fuel_efficiency` km/L or `elec_efficiency` kWh/100km ("No measure yet" when both null); cost per km over the
bus's whole log; "Last <date> | <kind_name>" or "No entries". Clicking a card sets `vehicle_id` on the log.

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.4 Vehicle cards: `GET /fuel_entries/vehicles?month=2026-11`_

`fuel_entries#vehicles`

GET /fuel_entries?month=2026-11&kind=all|fuel|elec|def&vehicle_id= — the month's log, newest first.

| Param | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `month` | `YYYY-MM` (default this month). `meta.next_month: false` disables the › button |
| `kind` | `all` (default), `fuel` (diesel and petrol), `elec`, `def` |
| `vehicle_id` | One bus (also set by clicking its card) |

All entries of the month, newest first (no paging):

```json
{ "id": 41, "vehicle_id": 7, "plate": "PD997M", "date": "2026-11-09", "time": "07:42", "kind": "diesel", "kind_name": "Diesel",
  "unit": "L", "quantity": "45.2", "cost": "119.78", "unit_price": "2.65", "odometer": 10600, "full": true,
  "fuel_company_id": 1, "fuel_company_name": "Esso", "station": "Jurong West Ave 2", "note": null,
  "km_since": 400, "efficiency": "10.0", "odometer_back": null,
  "driver_id": 3, "driver_name": "Eric Pang", "created_by": "Ops Admin", "document_read_id": null,
  "receipt": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "name": "receipt.jpg", "size": 81234, "content_type": "image/jpeg" } }
```

Row text:
- Quantity `45.2 L` with `unit_price` per unit ("S$2.65/L"); Odometer with "+400 km" (`km_since`).
- Efficiency: `efficiency` + " km/L" (fuel) or " kWh/100km" (elec); none: AdBlue = empty, `full` = "First full fill",
  else "Partial fill". Full / Partial label from `full`.
- `odometer_back` set: the reading is lower than the one before (shown in orange, and in Needs a Look).
- Station: "<fuel_company_name> <station> | <note>"; By: "<driver_name> | By <created_by>". Receipt button when `receipt`.

How the server works out the numbers (for the How It Works text): efficiency is measured from one full fill to the next of
the same energy: km between the two readings divided by everything added since (partial fills in between included).
`driver_id` is the bus's default driver that day and follows changes to the default driver schedule.

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.1 The month's log: `GET /fuel_entries?month=2026-11`_

POST { fuel_entry: {...}, receipt (file) | document_read_id } → meta { filled, warnings }

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Blank form | `GET /fuel_entries/new?vehicle_id=` → `{ vehicle_id, date, time, kind (of the bus's last entry), full, last_odometer }` |
| Add Entry | `POST /fuel_entries` |
| Save Entry | `PATCH /fuel_entries/:id` |
| Delete | `DELETE /fuel_entries/:id`. Confirm "Delete this diesel entry of 9 Nov?" |

```json
{ "fuel_entry": { "vehicle_id": 7, "date": "2026-11-09", "time": "07:42", "kind": "diesel", "quantity": 45.2, "cost": 119.78,
                  "odometer": 10600, "full": true, "fuel_company_id": 1, "station": "Jurong West Ave 2", "note": "Card 4471" },
  "document_read_id": 88 }
```

- Receipt: multipart `receipt` (PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP), or `document_read_id` of a finished `fuel_receipt` read (8.3).
- `kind`: `diesel`, `petrol`, `def` (AdBlue), `elec`. AdBlue is never a full fill (`full` saved false).
- Odometer hint: "+N km since the last entry (last_odometer km)", orange when lower.
- 422: `vehicle` ("must be one of your own buses"), `date`, `quantity` (> 0), `cost` (≥ 0).
- Response `meta: { filled: ["kind", "date", "quantity", "cost", "station", "fuel_company", "vehicle"], warnings: [...] }`:
  "Receipt read: … Check each one before saving". Warnings: "The receipt shows PD777Z, but the vehicle picked is PD1A",
  "The company on the receipt, Cnergy, is not in the list. Add it in Fuel Companies",
  "The odometer is lower than the last reading of 10650 km. Check the number".

GET /fuel/kpis?month=2026-11&vehicle_id=

```json
{ "data": { "month": "2026-11", "spend": "18098.98", "spend_before": "17234.87", "spend_change_pct": 5,
            "fuel_litres": "6435.9", "kwh": "772.46", "fills": 75,
            "fuel_efficiency": "7.5", "elec_efficiency": "22.0", "measured": 84,
            "km": 40667, "cost_per_km": "0.45", "needs_a_look": 5 } }
```

| Tile | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| Spend <month> | `spend`; "+5% vs Oct 2026" from `spend_change_pct` (null: "No entries in <month before>") |
| Fuel | `fuel_litres` L; under it "<kwh> kWh charged" when kWh > 0, else "<fills> fills" |
| Efficiency | `fuel_efficiency` km/L, else `elec_efficiency` kWh/100km, else "N/A"; "Measured over <measured> full fills" or "Needs two full fills with odometer readings" |
| Cost per km | `cost_per_km` and "<km> km driven", or "N/A" / "Enter the odometer at each fill" |
| Needs a Look | `needs_a_look` (orange when > 0): "Unusual fills in the last 90 days" / "Nothing unusual" |

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.7 KPI row: `GET /fuel/kpis?month=2026-11&vehicle_id=`_

`fuel#kpis`

GET /fuel/usage?view=&key=&measure=&range=&zoom_from=&zoom_to= (see FuelUsage)

| Param | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `view` | `all` (default), `vehicle`, `driver`, `company` (By Vehicle / By Driver / By Company) |
| `key` | With a view: the vehicle, driver or fuel company id picked from the breakdown; `none` = no driver / company set |
| `measure` | `spend` (default), `fuel` (L), `elec` (kWh), `def` (AdBlue L), `km`, `eff` (km/L), `cpk` (cost per km) |
| `range` | `30d` (by day), `12w` (by week, from Monday), `12m` (default, by month) |
| `zoom_from`, `zoom_to` | Clicking a week or month bar: its first and last day (by day). "Back to 12 Months" drops them |

```json
{ "data": {
    "view": "vehicle", "key": null, "measure": "eff", "range": "12m", "zoomed": false, "by": "month",
    "period": { "from": "2025-12-01", "to": "2026-11-20" }, "before": { "from": "2024-12-01", "to": "2025-11-30" },
    "buckets": [ { "from": "2025-12-01", "current": null, "before": null }, { "from": "2026-11-01", "current": "8.2", "before": "8.4" } ],
    "total": "8.2", "total_before": "8.4", "change_pct": -2, "better": "higher",
    "rows": [ { "key": "7", "name": "PD997M", "current": "8.2", "before": "8.4", "change_pct": -2, "alerts": 2 } ],
    "drivers": [],
    "summary": { "title": "Worth a Look", "worth_a_look": true,
                 "text": "Spend is S$3975.00, up 12% on the period before. Fuel use is 8.2 km/L, steady against 8.4 before. 2 fills need a look, ..." } } }
```

- Chart: `spend`, `fuel`, `elec`, `def`, `km` as bars (this period beside the period before); `eff` and `cpk` as lines.
  `current` / `before` null = nothing measured in that bucket (gap in the line). The last bucket is the period so far.
- Totals: "<period> <total>", "<before label> <total_before>", change `change_pct`% coloured by `better`
  (`higher`: up is green; `lower`: down is green; null: neutral).
- The period before: 30 days / 12 weeks / 12 months earlier; a zoomed month against the month before; a zoomed week against
  the week before.
- `rows` (views other than all): every vehicle / driver / company with entries in either period, biggest first; `alerts` =
  open Needs a Look on it ("2 to check"). Clicking a row sets `key`.
- `drivers` (By Driver): `[{ driver_id, name, excess_pct, excess_pct_before, km, vehicles: ["PD1A"] }]`: fuel per km against the
  usual for the buses driven (each fill against that bus with other drivers, else buses of its size). Orange when
  `excess_pct > 10`. Fuel counts for the bus's default driver that day.
- `summary`: the card beside the chart (`title` "Worth a Look" / "All Normal", `text`).

---

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.9 Usage card: `GET /fuel/usage`_

get.description:
GET /trips/:trip_id/assignments?from=

```json
{ "data": {
  "as_of": "2026-10-30", "operator_cancel_rule": "done",
  "slots": [ { "key": "d1r0|2", "trip_run_id": 1, "run_key": "d1r0", "run_label": "07:45", "slot_no": 2,
               "assignee": "operator", "vehicle_id": 17, "plate": "PC7475L", "operator_id": 5, "operator_name": "Hup Seng Coaches",
               "pay_amount": "4500.0", "pay_basis": "month", "assignment_id": 1, "from": "2026-09-07" } ],
  "history": [ { "id": 1, "effective_from": "2026-09-07", "assignee": "operator", "operator_id": 5, "operator_name": "Hup Seng Coaches",
                 "vehicle_id": 17, "plate": "PC7475L", "pay_amount": "4500.0", "pay_basis": "month",
                 "slots": ["d1r0|2", "d1r1|2"], "by": "SimpleDrive Ops", "at": "..." } ]
} }
```

- `slots`: every run × vehicle slot with who runs it on `as_of` (`run_label`: "07:45" or "Return 17:30"). Non-shuttle trips have one key per vehicle: `trip|1`.
- `assignee`: `own`, `operator` (bus may be empty: operator named, bus not known yet), `none`.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Give ticked runs | `POST /trips/:trip_id/assignments` `{ effective_from, slots: ["d1r0|1", ...], assignee: "own" | "operator" | "none", operator_id, vehicle_id, pay_amount, pay_basis: "run" | "day" | "month" }` |
| Remove a history entry | `DELETE /trips/:trip_id/assignments/:id` (those runs go back to what was before) |
| If the Client Cancels a Run | `PATCH /trips/:trip_id` `{ "trip": { "operator_cancel_rule": "done" | "full" } }` |

Pay per day is shared over the slots of the entry; per month also over the month's run days (`operator_cost` on each run).
`effective_from` may be past the horizon: the entry is kept and the runs take it when those dates are added.

---

post.description:
POST /trips/:trip_id/route_list { document_read_id, joins, apply_from } — Apply From on a saved School Run.

1. `POST /document_reads` (multipart) `kind=route_list`, `file` (PDF, xlsx, csv, photo) → poll.
2. Review: `POST /route_lists/review` `{ document_read_id, joins: [bool per row] (optional), trip_id (when importing onto a saved trip) }`

```json
{ "data": {
  "meta": { "label": "AM 13", "session": "am", "school": "Red Swastika School", "school_address": "350 Bedok North Ave 3 469719",
            "start_date": "2026-11-09", "arrive_by": "07:20", "leave_by": null, "notes": "Attendant alights at Blk 120" },
  "joins": [false, true, false],
  "stops": [ { "name": "Blk 443A Bedok North", "time": "06:40", "address": "Blk 443A Bedok North 461443", "lat": null, "lng": null,
               "driver_note": "Blk 443A Shelter", "pickup_point_id": null, "postal_codes": ["461443", "462443"],
               "rows": [ { "index": 0, "name": "Lim Jia Hui", "class_name": "P3", "postal": "461443", "time": "06:40",
                           "phone": "91234567", "flags": [] } ] } ],
  "flagged": 2,
  "changes": { "added": ["Goh Mei"], "removed": ["Ali Hassan"], "changed": [ { "name": "Lim Jia Hui", "changed": ["time"], "before": { "time": "06:35" }, "after": { "time": "06:40" } } ] },
  "trip_attributes": { "kind": "school_run", "session": "am", "title": "Red Swastika School AM 13", "starts_on": "2026-11-09",
                       "days": [1,2,3,4,5], "end_mode": "never", "notes": "...", "stops_attributes": [ "stops with students_attributes" ] }
} }
```

- `joins[i] = true` = row i is in the same stop as the row above. Join Stop Above / Separate Stop = flip a value and call review again.
- `flags` per row: "No time", "Earlier than the row above", "No parent phone", "No postal code", "Also on <other School Run>".
  Checking postal codes against OneMap is done in the front end.
- Save Pick-up Point on a review stop: `POST /pickup_points` `{ "pickup_point": { name, postal_codes: [...] or "461443, 462443", lat, lng, note } }`;
  list `GET /pickup_points`; delete `DELETE /pickup_points/:id`. Review again to apply it.
3. Add to Trip:
   - New trip: put `trip_attributes` into the form (plus client, vehicles, price) and `POST /trips`.
   - Saved trip with students: `POST /trips/:trip_id/route_list` `{ document_read_id, joins, apply_from: "2026-11-09" }` →
     the current list becomes an Earlier List until the day before; returns the trip.
4. Earlier Lists: `GET /trips/:trip_id/route_list_versions` → `[{ id, name, valid_until, stops, students }]`.
5. Next 12 Months: `GET /trips/:trip_id/school_run_bill?from=` →
   `{ data: [{ month: "2026-11", runs: 13, no_school_days: 1, share: 0.9286, amount: "2228.57" }], meta: { total, empty_months } }`.

---

_Source: `scheduler.md` § 7.9 School Run: Import Route List_

post.description:
POST { trip: {...}, return_trip: {...} } — return_trip makes a two-way Ad Hoc / Charter trip.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Create | `POST /trips` `{ "trip": { ... }, "return_trip": { ... } }` → `201` `{ data: trip, meta: { return_trip: trip or null } }` |
| Save changes | `PATCH /trips/:id` `{ "trip": { ..., "lock_version": 0 } }` → `200` `{ data: trip }` |
| Delete | `DELETE /trips/:id` → `204` |

`return_trip` (Two-Way Trip, new Ad Hoc / Charter only): `{ start_time, end_time, stops_attributes, route_vias_attributes,
vehicle_slots_attributes, standby_attributes, return_billing }`. The rest is copied from the outbound trip; the return is
titled "… (Return)" and the two trips point at each other (`pair_id`). `return_billing` is worked out by the server when
every stop has a pin (two-way when every stop on the way back is within 200 m of one on the way there), else taken from the form.

Validation messages follow the trip form: "Pick the client", "Enter the pick-up point", "Enter the drop-off point",
"Enter how many vehicles are needed", "End time must be different from the start time", "Hours must be greater than 0",
"Wait minutes must be entered for an arrival", "The return starts before the outbound trip ends"...

_Source: `scheduler.md` § 7.2 Save_

post.description:
POST /rate_cards/quote { client_id, date, start_time, vehicle_type_id, km, extra_stops }

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Revenue by Vehicle / what each run earns on a date | `GET /trips/:id/prices?date=` → `{ data: [{ run, slot_no, amount }], meta: { date, total } }` |
| Corporate Shuttle: Price From Rate Card | `POST /rate_cards/quote` `{ client_id, date, start_time, vehicle_type_id, km, extra_stops }` |

Quote response (`km` = road distance from your route, for distance bands; `extra_stops` = stops between first pick-up and last drop-off):

```json
{ "data": { "card": { "id": 2, "name": "Corporate Contract Rates" }, "amount": "87.0", "missing": null,
            "lines": [ { "text": "One Way, Off Peak", "amount": "73.0" }, { "text": "1 extra stop", "amount": "14.0" } ] } }
```

"Use This Price" fills `price` with `amount` and `price_basis: "trip"`. `missing` explains a zero (no period covers the time, type not on the card).

_Source: `scheduler.md` § 7.6 Prices_

`rate_cards#quote`

POST /bookings/estimate { client_id, date, trip: {...} } — the trip card's estimate while editing.

`{ "client_id": 1, "date": "2026-11-05", "trip": { ...one trip as in the save body } }` →
`{ "data": { "amount": "318.0", "lines": [...], "without_rate": 0, "card": { "id": 1, "name": "Standard Rates" } } }`.
Nothing is saved. `without_rate` = vehicles with no rate (show "N without a rate"). The booking total in the form is the sum
of the trips' amounts.

Pricing rules: One Way / Airport = the period's trip rate at the pick-up time; Two Way = out (pick-up time) + back
(return time); Disposal = hourly rate × hours (+ per km after the free km on an Hourly + Distance card). Distance and
extra stops are charged on each one-way leg; a Two Way whose way back goes more than 200 m from every point of the way
there is priced as two one-way trips (`"Return, priced as a one-way trip"`, each way its own km and stops).

_Source: `trips.md` § Estimate while editing — `POST /bookings/estimate`_

post.description:
POST { booking_trip_id (omit for the whole booking), reason, requested_by_name }

A client asks to cancel the booking or one trip (from the Client Portal later; recorded here on their behalf). The booking
shows them in `cancel_requests`:

```json
"cancel_requests": [ { "id": 2, "booking_trip_id": 7, "trip_date": "2026-11-04", "reason": "Event moved", "requested_by_name": "Alex",
                       "requested_at": "...", "status": "open", "resolved_at": null, "resolved_by": null, "resolution_note": null } ]
```

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Record a request | `POST /bookings/:booking_id/cancel_requests` `{ "booking_trip_id": 7, "reason": "Event moved", "requested_by_name": "Alex" }` (omit `booking_trip_id` for the whole booking; name defaults to the coordinator) → 201 |
| Accept | `PATCH /bookings/:booking_id/cancel_requests/:id` `{ "decision": "accept", "note": "Told Alex" }` |
| Decline | `PATCH /bookings/:booking_id/cancel_requests/:id` `{ "decision": "decline" }` |

Accept cancels the trips (status `cancelled`); for approved trips their Scheduler runs not started yet are cancelled
(they show as Cancelled on the Scheduler), or the Scheduler trip is removed when it has no runs yet. A booking whose
trips are all cancelled shows "Cancelled" (Rejected tab). A resolved request can't be resolved again (422).

_Source: `trips.md` § Cancellation requests_
